docs.title: FAW Besturn X80 Knowledge Base
docs.text:
Community knowledge base for the FAW Besturn X80: fixes, part numbers and cross-brand alternatives, prices, specs, and maintenance — compiled from owner communities. Every fact is attributed to its original author with a link to the original message; this site organizes the community's knowledge, it does not claim it.

Where this knowledge comes from. The sources are Russian-speaking owner communities. Prices are for the Russian market (RUB) at the date shown next to each one, and shops named are Russian. Advice about frost and winter applies to Russian climate. Facts about the car itself (part numbers, procedures, faults) transfer to any market — verify prices and suppliers locally in Syria.

docs.title: Glossary
docs.text:
The owner communities are Russian-speaking and use Russian shop jargon. This page explains the terms that appear on the site.

Term Meaning Notes AKPP / АКПП Automatic transmission (автоматическая коробка передач) The X80 uses the Aisin-derived TF-61SN 6-speed automatic. MKPP / МКПП Manual transmission ШРУС (SHRUS) CV joint (constant-velocity joint) on the drive shaft Outer = at the wheel, inner = at the gearbox. ДВС The engine (internal combustion engine) ЭБУ / ECU Engine control unit ГРМ Timing drive (belt or chain and its tensioners) ГУР / ЭУР Hydraulic / electric power steering жабо (zhabo) Cowl panel — the plastic trim between the windshield and the hood, where the wipers sit Its drains clog and let water into the cabin — a frequent X80 topic. шумка (shumka) Sound deadening / noise insulation material мухобойка Hood deflector ("bug shield") сайлентблок Rubber-metal bushing (suspension arm / subframe bushing) стойка / амортизатор Strut / shock absorber рычаг Control arm (suspension arm) ступица Wheel hub (usually with the wheel bearing) колодки / диски Brake pads / brake discs помпа Water pump (coolant pump) сальник Oil seal (crankshaft, camshaft, axle seal) прокладка Gasket форсунки / свечи Fuel injectors / spark plugs катализатор / лямбда Catalytic converter / oxygen (lambda) sensor масложор Excessive oil consumption ("oil eating") рестайл / дорестайл Facelift (post-2019 restyle) / pre-facelift X80 подрамник / лонжерон / порог Subframe / chassis rail / sill (rocker panel) дворники / бачок Wipers / reservoir (washer or expansion tank) кулиса Gear shifter linkage фаркоп Tow bar (trailer hitch) ТО Scheduled service (maintenance visit, e.g. ТО-1, ТО-2) ОЖ / антифриз Coolant / antifreeze Drive2 / Drom / Avito / Ozon / Exist / Autodoc Russian car forums (Drive2, Drom) and online shops/marketplaces for parts пыльник Dust boot — the rubber bellows on a CV joint, ball joint, tie-rod end or shock absorber сапун Crankcase breather / PCV vent (engine or gearbox) отбойник Bump stop — the rubber buffer that limits suspension travel подкрылок Wheel-arch liner (inner fender plastic) печка Cabin heater (heater core + blower) ролик (натяжной / обводной) Belt pulley — tensioner or idler roller of the drive belt коленвал / шкив коленвала Crankshaft / crankshaft pulley (harmonic damper) опора двигателя / подушка Engine mount КПП Gearbox (any type; see AKPP / MKPP) рейка (рулевая) Steering rack наконечник / тяга Tie-rod end / tie rod (steering) шаровая Ball joint развал / схождение Wheel alignment — camber / toe суппорт Brake caliper подшипник ступицы Wheel (hub) bearing концевик Limit switch (door / hood / brake-pedal micro-switch) гофра Flexible pipe — exhaust flex section, or a corrugated hose/duct патрубок / тройник Coolant or air hose / T-fitting проставки Spacers — lift spacers (suspension) or wheel spacers молдинг / накладка / уплотнитель Trim strip / cover panel / weatherstrip seal магнитола / приборка Head unit (radio) / instrument cluster обманка Spacer/emulator that hides a fault — e.g. an O2-sensor "cheater" after catalyst removal ДАД / ДМРВ / ДПКВ / ДПДЗ Sensors — MAP (manifold pressure) / MAF (air flow) / crankshaft position / throttle position разборка Vehicle dismantler (breaker's yard) selling used parts вилка (рычаг) "Fork" — the community's name for the X80's curved lower control arm жаба / гастроном Community slang — "жаба" = cowl panel (see жабо); "гастроном" = any parts shop

docs.title: Aftermarket door handle covers — fitting and gluing
docs.text:
Tags: #aliexpress · #price

Prices and suppliers on this page are Russian-market (RUB, at the dates shown). Verify locally before relying on them in Syria.

Aftermarket door-handle covers from Chinese sellers (e.g. AliExpress) usually need fitting work: (1) inspect the piece — the plastic is hard/rigid; (2) file/sand the internal edges where the cover contacts the door-lock mechanism — use a proper file or a small circular saw, as basic home tools are inadequate; (3) remove the small screw from the door-lock trim to access the lock base; (4) test-fit multiple times while adjusting; (5) apply cyanoacrylate glue (Cosmophen CA-500 or similar super glue) using an insulin syringe, running a thin line around the perimeter only; (6) avoid dripping glue on the paint/clear coat. Installation requires patience — the final result should be a snug fit 123456.

Cover fell off — reattachment: the exterior door-handle chrome cover/trim can fall off in service (a known issue — some units arrive loose from the factory). Fix: use Cosmofene adhesive to reattach it. If the cover is lost or damaged, replacement parts are available on AliExpress (~12 days delivery); both the adhesive and replacement parts are inexpensive 78910111213141516.

Cosmophene gluing procedure (detailed): the decorative door-handle cover tends to fall off over time, especially after ice damage. Solution: clean the contact surface thoroughly, then apply Cosmophen (industrial cyanoacrylate sealant) with an insulin syringe for precision, running it carefully around the perimeter only, applying it only to the recess so it doesn't contact/damage the door-handle paint. The part is durable plastic and costs around 1,000 RUB (RU market, December 2024). Once glued, it holds securely through harsh weather 1718192021222324252627. ⚠️ Conflict: users debated additional bolts vs. adhesive alone; the community consensus settled on Cosmophene adhesive alone as the reliable solution.

Chrome door-handle cover ornaments (AliExpress): chrome-plated door-handle cover caps/clips for the X80 are available on AliExpress (link: https://sl.aliexpress.ru/p?key=L9MuriH), listed as "FAW Besturn X80 external chrome door handle clips/covers." Price with a 45% discount: 1,074 RUB (as of 2024-12-04). Multiple owners reported ordering successfully from this link 2829.

Trim-piece adhesive options — Cosmophen vs. cold solder: front door-trim pieces that fall off (door handles, trim clips) can be re-attached with either: (1) Cosmophen adhesive (confirmed to hold 1+ year), or (2) cold solder/cold epoxy (held 2+ years in one report). Both are cheaper temporary-repair alternatives to sourcing OEM clips 303132.

Door-handle loose/falling off — Kosmophen repair: the door handle housing (where the lock is located) tends to fall off, especially on the driver's door. Fix: order a replacement from AliExpress and reinstall using Kosmophen super-glue — this ensures the handle stays attached to the plastic overlay 3334.

Exterior door handle replacement — AliExpress sourcing: if the outer door handle breaks or becomes inoperable, replacement handles (chrome-plated) are available on AliExpress for roughly 825 RUB at a 45% discount (original ~1,500 RUB) (RU market, July 2024). Installation requires removing the door panel 35363738.

Door handle sourcing — multiple options and trim differences: the X80's complete exterior door-handle assembly is available from several sources: (1) KitZap — part number 5CA159410 for the left-front touchless/contact-sensor version, at kitzapchasti.ru; (2) OZON — complete assembly listed under FAW Pentium X80; (3) direct sellers (e.g. AutoCraft) selling non-touchless handles; (4) AliExpress for decorative/trim-only pieces. Handle design varies by model year and trim — luxury trims may include a contactless sensor, base trims are usually plain mechanical. Restyle (2019+) models may use a different handle design than pre-restyle; verify fitment before ordering 3940414243.

Chrome trim-only covers — AliExpress (2024 listing): FAW X80 chrome/silver decorative door-handle cover/clip pieces are available on AliExpress (item key waJesi0) for roughly 823 RUB (RU market, August 2024) with a 45% discount 44.

Touchless vs. standard handle identification: X80 door handles come in two variants: (1) standard mechanical, no finger sensor — common on base trim and pre-restyle models; (2) touchless/contactless with a capacitive finger sensor for keyless entry — found on luxury trim and some restyle versions. Touchless handles include a sensor tab under tape on the handle surface plus an extra wiring-harness connector. To identify your handle: look for the sensor tab under the tape at the handle end, and check for the additional connector cable. Restyle (2019+) models may use either variant depending on trim — verify your vehicle's original configuration before ordering a replacement 4546474849.

Door handle excessive play — repair rather than replace: X80 door handles can develop excessive play from wear — the handle feels loose with free movement before engaging the door latch. Often caused by a broken small mechanical stop pin (концевик), which prevents the handle from locking in the open position. Remedy without a full replacement: (1) remove the handle; (2) locate the broken stop pin; (3) replace the pin or repair with strong epoxy/industrial adhesive; or (4) shim the mechanism to restore proper tension. Full handle replacement is not always necessary for pure mechanical wear 5051.

Rear door handle/latch — replacement without panel removal: the rear door handle/latch can be replaced by unbolting it from the inside face of the door edge — the bolt is accessed from the door end/edge, so no door-panel removal is required for this job 52.

Replacement handle part number and write-up: an exterior door handle for the FAW X80 is listed on Ozon under article 5GA0568DX (November 2025) 53. A DRIVE2 write-up covers replacing the door handle yourself on a 2018 FAW Besturn X80 2.0 L; only the link was shared 54.

docs.title: Baggage-compartment and door-trim rust
docs.text:
Tags: #corrosion · #trunk · #conflict

Community members disagree on this topic — both positions are reported.

Baggage-compartment rust — mixed owner reports: multiple owners report rust issues in the X80 baggage-compartment area. One owner (2018 model, white) found rust under the door trim and inside the trunk lid after some time in service. Another owner (2017 model) reports rust appearing on the rear door under the glass. Several other owners report no rust issues despite normal use, suggesting variable factory quality control or storage/climate conditions play a role 1234. ⚠️ Conflict: reports are split — some owners (m6000, m6006, m6007) report rust; others (m6003 and a nearby unindexed report, m6004) report no rust despite similar ownership duration.

Rust under rear door trim — sealant/zinc treatment is temporary: rust found under the rear door trim can be treated with sealant and zinc coating, but one owner's experience is that the treatment is only temporary — the rust returns over time. A more thorough fix may require removing the lower door molding, but the community lacked a confirmed non-destructive removal technique at the time of this report and was actively seeking guidance 5.

Trunk/baggage water intrusion causing rust — under the spare tire: water can accumulate under the spare tire in the trunk, leading to rust formation — a known issue on the X80 (see the water-leak card for broader diagnosis of trunk water ingress). Preventive measures suggested: check trunk seals and consider additional sealant around the trunk perimeter. One new owner planned to address this proactively immediately after purchase 67.

docs.title: Ceramic coating application for exterior paint
docs.text:
Tags: #paint

Some advice here concerns sub-zero winters and is less relevant in a hot climate.

Ceramic coating (typically sold in 30 ml bottles) is applied to the body paint to enhance clarity and add glossiness. One 30 ml bottle is sufficient for a regular sedan, but the X80 requires a minimum of 2 bottles due to its larger surface area. Application method: spread the product evenly without rubbing — the recommended technique is compared to applying conditioner in laundry (light, even coverage rather than scrubbing). For winter, pair the ceramic coating with a hydrophobic treatment to add a water-repellent layer 1234567.

docs.title: Child safety lock — rear doors
docs.text:
Tags: #normal-behavior

Symptom that's actually normal: if a rear inner door handle doesn't open the door from inside (while the door still opens fine from outside), this is very likely the child safety lock engaged, not a fault.

Location and control: there is a small switch lever on the edge of the door (the door jamb, where it meets the frame) that toggles the child lock on/off for each rear door independently.

Behavior: when enabled, passengers cannot open that door from the inside — useful for securing children in the back seat. When disabled, the inner door handle works normally like any other door 123.

docs.title: Chrome-effect trim oxidation and cleaning
docs.text:
Tags: #trim

Plastic trim with a chrome-like coating develops brown spots and oxidation over time. Reported solutions, roughly in order of strength: (1) generic glass cleaner works for basic/light cleaning; (2) Mr. Muscle (Мистер Мускул) glass cleaner is more aggressive and suitable for heavier spots; (3) automotive chrome paste fills micro-cracks and gives temporary protection; (4) white (non-gel) toothpaste applied with a non-woven cloth works as a mild abrasive. Chrome-polish effects are temporary — visible spots indicate the thin chrome coating is wearing through to the plastic substrate underneath, so the underlying degradation isn't actually reversed by any of these treatments 123456789.

docs.title: Cowl panel drain holes — winter icing
docs.text:
Tags: #winter · #conflict

Some advice here concerns sub-zero winters and is less relevant in a hot climate.

Community members disagree on this topic — both positions are reported.

On the restyle X80, the right-side drain holes in the cowl panel/scuttle (жабо, under the windshield) appear sealed/blocked from the factory on at least some cars. One owner reports the holes on his car were indeed sealed on the right side; he drilled them open about two weeks prior (relative to the report) because, when blocked, a substantial ice slab builds up there in winter 12.

Conflict — possible reason for the factory sealing: a second owner questions whether the holes should be opened at all, reasoning that the factory may have sealed them deliberately to prevent water from entering the cabin through the heater box (печка) — i.e. the drain path could double as a water-intrusion path if left open. No resolution was reached in this exchange; the community has not confirmed which approach (drilled open vs. left sealed) is correct for avoiding both ice buildup and water intrusion 3.

docs.title: Cowl panel scuttle (жабо) — removal
docs.text:
Tags: #windshield · #wiper

The cowl panel/scuttle trim under the windshield (жабо, holds the wiper arms area and windshield-washer plumbing) comes off easily and quickly — about 5 minutes for the full removal. Procedure: (1) disconnect the windshield-washer hoses; (2) open the hood; (3) remove the plastic clips/pistons ("пистоны") from the top of the panel; (4) pull the panel down, then upward, to release it — check that it clears the lower spoiler area around the windshield base (one owner was not able to fully free this part); (5) disconnect the washer tubing on the left side — use caution, this tube is difficult to recover if it drops down into the body cavity; if lost, use a phone camera to help locate it 123.

docs.title: Custom X80 emblem/badge — sourcing and installation
docs.text:
Tags: #price

Prices and suppliers on this page are Russian-market (RUB, at the dates shown). Verify locally before relying on them in Syria.

Some advice here concerns sub-zero winters and is less relevant in a hot climate.

A custom X80 emblem/badge design is a popular personalization item among owners. Sourcing options: (1) locally, from craftsman Nikita Sergutsky in Omsk (contact via VK/Messenger) for around 2,000 RUB (RU market, April 2024); (2) AliExpress, a much cheaper alternative at roughly 5–6 RUB (pricing/shipping specifics unverified at that extreme end, but reported as-is by the community). Installation: apply with 3M double-sided tape on a clean, degreased surface. Typically installed in the badge area under the windshield 123456789101112.

Removal technique for grille/trunk emblems: emblems on the grille and trunk can be removed using a heat gun followed by fishing line (pulled horizontally between the emblem and the mounting surface). Some badging may instead use clip connections into the trunk lid rather than adhesive. Heat-gun application should be gentle to avoid damaging the paint or the plastic backing 131415.

Pre-facelift emblem dimensions (for custom ordering): known pre-facelift (dorest) badge dimensions: front emblem 14.8 × 8 cm, rear emblem 12.5 × 7.4 cm. Measure the existing badge or use these dimensions when ordering from a sign/graphics shop 16.

Custom badge creation via local advertising agencies: a popular sourcing route is a local рекламное агентство (advertising/signage agency): bring a cardboard template cut to match the existing emblem's size and shape, and the agency will produce a custom badge in any design/size, handling material selection and finishing themselves 171819202116.

Vinyl custom emblems — pricing and long-term durability: custom vinyl emblems (e.g. with personal initials) cost roughly 500–600 RUB plus ~300 RUB shipping (RU market, May 2026) when ordered online. Installation is simple and does not require a heat gun. Reported durability: one owner's vinyl emblem held up for 3 years and 500+ car washes with no visible degradation from frost or heat 222324252627282930.

Second Omsk-based custom-emblem maker (Telegram/VK): another custom-emblem craftsman, based in Omsk and reachable via Telegram and VK (https://vk.com/emblema), offers glue-on emblems: a 2 mm-thick large emblem costs 900 RUB (RU market, June 2024); a thicker replacement version costs 1,300–1,400 RUB. Orders require custom measurements and a sketch of the desired design 3132.

docs.title: Door check strap/limiter — sourcing
docs.text:
Tags: #door · #part-number · #cross-compatibility · #mazda-6-compat

Prices and suppliers on this page are Russian-market (RUB, at the dates shown). Verify locally before relying on them in Syria.

Reported issue: the driver's door does not hold/stay in an open position (no working check strap/limiter). A door limiter/strap is available from KitParts (kitparts.ru), around 1,500 RUB (RU market, March 2025) 12.

Cross-compatibility: a Mazda 6 (GG) repair kit for this part does not fit the X80 — one owner has one sitting unused after it failed to work. A CX-5 variant is reported to fit instead, though this wasn't independently confirmed by the reporting owner (secondhand information — "they say it fits") 3.

Mazda generation matters — Mazda 6 II–III (GH/GJ/GL) fits, GG does not: this is a generation-specific compatibility, consistent with the CX-5-fits/GG-doesn't-fit finding above. Door limiters/check straps from Mazda 6 II–III (2007–2017, bodies GH/GJ/GL) fit and function correctly, preventing door slamming with smooth damping. Limiters from the older Mazda 6 GG (2002–2008) do not fit 45678910.

Repair-kit version — full disassembly required, fragile parts: a repair kit for the limiter (rather than a full pre-assembled unit) is also cross-compatible from Mazda 6 II–III (GH/GJ/GL, part TYPE 14016), available on Ozon.ru. Installation requires removing the entire door panel to access the mechanism, removing the plastic shims, and inserting the kit's pins in a specific herringbone ("ёлочкой") pattern; clips are reused as needed during reassembly. The kit's plastic teeth are fragile — handle carefully, since they're prone to breaking, especially on a second attempt at repositioning 111213141516171819.

Door hinge limiter kits (4-door set) — also Mazda 6 II–III: door hinge limiter/gap-stopper kits (distinct from the check-strap kits above, though from the same donor generation) designed for Mazda 6 II–III (2007–2017) fit the X80 as a direct replacement without modification. Kits come as a 4-door set. Installation: remove the door panel, remove the door speaker, disconnect the old hinge limiter, install the new kit — about 30–40 minutes per door. These kits run tighter tolerances than OEM, so assembling with a vise is recommended for a proper fit 202122.

Door limiter/catch clip replacement — full procedure, sizing, and break-in: limiter/catch clips (the shock-absorbing part of the mechanism) commonly fail after 50,000–200,000 km, causing the symptom "door swings closed too easily / won't stay open." Fix: replace with Mazda 6 II–III door-limiter repair kits (Ozon listing: https://ozon.ru/t/dQ9CuRk or similar); Mazda 6 GG-II or CX-5-II variants are also reported to fit. Installation is easier with a vise for gently bending the clips, but can be done with a slotted screwdriver, hammer, pliers, and a pry bar. All four doors can be fitted. Sizing note: replacement clips sit slightly lower in profile than the original (13.23 mm stock vs. 12.75–13.6 mm for the aftermarket alternatives), but they still function correctly — new clips may click/squeak initially but typically break in over time 2324252627282930313233343536373839404142434445.

Squeak can persist after replacement — internal mechanism, not the pivot: even after replacing the limiter straps with Mazda 6 units and applying silicone, dry lubricant, or graphite-based lubricants, a squeak can return after roughly 6 months, because the noise originates inside the mechanism itself, not at the external pivot point where lubricant is normally applied. The fix in that case is to replace the entire pre-assembled limiter unit again rather than trying to service individual components 464748.

Cross-brand compatible limiters — Mazda CX-5/CX-9 (confirmed); Mazda GG (does not fit): factory FAW X80 door limiters can be replaced with Mazda CX-5 or CX-9 limiters. Mazda GG door limiters do NOT fit properly. Original FAW part number: 5CA058270. Mazda CX-5 limiters are an inexpensive alternative (available via an Ozon listing). Installation requires opening 4 metal clips per door with pliers/chisel, taking roughly 10 minutes per door. The stock design uses white rubber pads with a limited service life 49505152535455565758596061626364. The front-door limiter (ограничитель передней двери) 5CA058270 is listed at kitzapchasti; a zzap search for 5CA058270A was also posted, and the A suffix may be a different variant, so confirm with the seller 5365.

Door-limiter repair-kit pricing: Mazda CX-5 door-limiter repair kits are available on Ozon or AliExpress; price reference: approximately 1,500 RUB from AliExpress (RU market, May 2024). Manual installation takes 1–2 hours per pair of doors. Alternatively, some owners buy complete replacement limiters instead of repair kits 665467.

Mazda 6 GH/GJ/GL limiters install without removing the door card — update to the GG compatibility note above: Mazda 6 GH (2007–2017) door limiters, particularly GH/GJ/GL body-code variants, can be installed on the X80 without removing the interior door card, per owner Eduard, who confirms GH/GJ/GL limiters install like OEM parts. ⚠️ Conflict/refinement: this nuances the "Mazda GG does not fit" note above — earlier Mazda 6 GG (1st gen, 2002–2007) limiters do work but require door-card disassembly first, whereas GH/GJ/GL versions fit more easily without that step; one source (Александр Марощук) notes the GG versions need internal door work, while another (Эдуард Янонис) reports GH/GJ/GL fitting more readily 6869707172.

Squeaking limiter — plastic-spacer remedy (stiffer door as trade-off): some Mazda door-limiter replacements squeak once installed. One owner (Сергей Елисеев) resolved this by installing limiter versions with plastic transparent spacers instead of metal-only designs. This reduced the squeak, but the doors became noticeably stiffer to close — his wife needed both hands to close them afterward 737470.

Additional confirmation — TYPE 14016 kit reported after limiters go loose: another separate owner report corroborates the Mazda 6 (II–III, GH/GJ/GL) TYPE 14016 repair-kit cross-compatibility noted above, after the factory door limiters had become loose and barely held the doors open ("родные практически не держут") 757677.

docs.title: Door limiter worn bushings cause loose doors
docs.text:
Tags: #door · #bushings · #mazda-6-compat

Prices and suppliers on this page are Russian-market (RUB, at the dates shown). Verify locally before relying on them in Syria.

Worn plastic bushings inside the door limiters (ограничители — the arms that stop the door at each open position) cause excessive door movement and a poor closing feel; the door frames rattle when closed 1.

Fix: replace the limiters on all four doors as a kit — a Mazda 6 part was used for compatibility. Installation is fast, about 30 seconds per door with simple tools. The replacement kit includes lubricant, but the included dry lube dries out quickly; use graphite or silicone grease instead 12.

Repair-kit alternative — Ozon, Mazda 6 GG 2002-2008: instead of a full limiter swap, a door-limiter-strap repair kit for Mazda 6 (2002-2008 GG generation) fits the X80 driver's door; the Ozon listing part reference is 767099455. Installation takes about 30-40 minutes per door and requires a vise — the limiter mechanism cannot be disassembled by hand. Procedure: remove the door panel (several screws and clips), disconnect the speaker, then disassemble the limiter in a vise. The original limiter straps are fragile and prone to squeaking; ceramic-coated or rubber-lined replacement straps last longer than the stock design 3.

Bushing replacement in a vise: a door check (ограничитель двери) can also be repaired by replacing its bushings in a vise, about 30–40 minutes per door; the parts fit like originals, and the extra gaskets in the kit did not fit but were not needed 45. Another member says the check mechanisms of the Mazda 6 GG (2002–2008) are almost identical, so the whole unit can be swapped; a 4-door repair kit (TYPE 14016) is listed for Mazda 6 GH/GJ/GL (2007–2017) 6. The GG claim disagrees with door check strap/limiter — sourcing, where Mazda 6 GG limiters are reported not to fit.

docs.title: Door and wheel-arch molding clips
docs.text:
Tags: #molding · #clips · #part-number

Prices and suppliers on this page are Russian-market (RUB, at the dates shown). Verify locally before relying on them in Syria.

General clip replacement procedure: door molding ("накладка") clips are replaceable without full door-card removal. Procedure: (1) carefully pry/remove the molding — some adhesion from double-sided tape; (2) replace the damaged clips; (3) reattach the molding with new double-sided tape (2-sided foam tape commonly used). Reference: Drive2.ru user "k404k" documented the full procedure with the dual-tape method. This prevents plastic trim breakage 1234.

Fastening details and part numbers: front door molding uses both double-sided tape and mechanical clips for fastening. Lifan door molding fits the X80 with minor adjustment. FAW part number FC016888502 covers the molding clips. Generic WRT-type clips from Wildberries or Opel-sourced clips can substitute, though Opel compatibility is unclear. Wheel-arch molding uses 4 unique proprietary clips that are difficult to source 567891011121314.

Lada Priora door-panel clips (SKU confirmed): door-panel retaining clips sold on Wildberries under SKU 163460312, originally listed for Lada Priora, fit the X80's door panels. These are prone to breakage during removal — buy spares before starting a job. Anti-squeak tape is recommended alongside installation; rubber-lined clip variants are also available 15.

Sourcing hard-to-find arch molding clips — auto paint suppliers: arch molding trim clips (крепления молдинга арок) commonly break on the X80. When exact OEM clips can't be found on the usual online marketplaces, local auto paint suppliers (малярка) — shops that stock body-repair consumables — often carry various generic clip types that can substitute 16171819.

Cargo (rear/trunk) door trim clip compatibility: the cargo-door (rear/trunk) trim piece (накладка двери багажника) uses clips that can wear or break. A Nissan part 909901KA0B (clips, pack of 10) was suggested as an alternative, but several owners report these do not hold well on the X80. Trim pieces with clips already attached are available on Chinese parts sites for around 2,700 RUB (RU market, October 2025), but fitment varies. Note that the original clips are part of a complete trim assembly that includes the clips pre-mounted — they are not sold separately from the factory trim 2021222324.

Door window top-edge gasket (уплотнитель) — shrinkage and replacement: door window top-edge gaskets (уплотнители на двери, where the glass enters at the top) shrink over time, causing rattling in the mirrors and possibly glass rattle. Replacement gaskets are available; price approximately 1,200 RUB (RU market, December 2025) for a single door gasket (part example: art. 68135, front-left) via automotive-dismantler/marketplace sites like drom.ru. Only front and rear gasket variants may be readily available — front-left and front-right gaskets differ and are not interchangeable 25262728293031. ⚠️ Conflict/note: front-left and front-right door gaskets use different parts; pricing and availability may vary by position.

Door panel trim clips — Lada/Priora cross-compatibility: Lada Priora (Приора) door-panel clips fit the X80's door cards perfectly. Available on Wildberries, part #163460312, at approximately 100 RUB (RU market, January 2026) for a 30-piece pack. Clips from a Lada Tazik/Granta are also mentioned as compatible. Single-clip replacement cost is minimal when repairing torn or broken door panels 32333435363738.

Sill/body trim fastening clips — OEM part code: plastic clips that hold the sill trim and adjacent body panels: part code 5CA051SJ4. These are commonly broken during door and sill disassembly work and should be pre-ordered when planning interior work that involves removing those panels 3940.

Rear door trim clips and fasteners — additional sourcing options: beyond the Lada/Priora cross-compatible clips above, plastic trim clips and metal fasteners for rear door panels specifically are available from: (1) Ozon, searchable under "Мазда клипсы обивки" ("Mazda trim clips") with multiple variants; (2) auto-parts stores that keep physical samples on hand for matching by eye 414243.

Dorestyle door/window trim molding — clips detach, sourcing difficult, Mazda 6 cross-fit suggestion (unconfirmed): some X80 dorestyle (pre-facelift) trim moldings have an issue with their clips falling off or becoming loose over time — one owner found their molding had detached entirely. Replacement sourcing is difficult; AliExpress has some options. One suggestion from the community: check a Mazda 6 (2014 model) for a similarly-shaped molding — external shape looks similar but fitment is uncertain; the suggested approach was to purchase and test, with the option to return if it doesn't fit 4445464748.

docs.title: Door panel seam separation — warranty repair
docs.text:
Tags: #door-panel · #warranty · #dealer · #low-confidence

One owner reported door panel separation — insufficient sealant between the outer and inner door panels degraded over time, causing the seam to open. The dealer warranty repair involved: disassembly from both the interior and engine-bay sides, resealing the panel joint, and reassembly. The owner noted this disassembly is a convenient opportunity to add sound-deadening material to the door while it's already open 123.

docs.title: Door panel — removal, tweeters, and water drainage
docs.text:
Tags: #door-panel · #clips · #removal

Prices and suppliers on this page are Russian-market (RUB, at the dates shown). Verify locally before relying on them in Syria.

Removal procedure: (1) remove the door-handle overlay trim (it hides screws); (2) carefully pop the panel from the bottom, unsnapping the plastic clips — these frequently break; (3) avoid pulling near the window gasket/seal. To reinstall: insert clips into their pockets and snap into place from the bottom. Replacement Lada Priora clips (Wildberries SKU 163460312) are more durable than OEM, with rubber buffers — plan for some clip breakage during the job either way 1234567.

High-frequency tweeters: the door panels have tweeter placeholders on the upper door. Stock fitment varies by trim level — luxury trims may have working tweeters, mid-range trims may have non-functional units, base trims have blanks only. Tweeters can fail internally (a broken wire inside the connector) and can be repaired by soldering, or upgraded with 1" aftermarket units; thermoglue is used for fitment 89101112.

Water inside the door / drainage: water accumulating at the bottom of the door panel after removal is normal drainage from the weatherstripping — it should exit through drainage holes around the bottom perimeter of the door, so finding water there indicates the drainage system is working, not failing 1314. Broken plastic mounting clips can be repaired with cyanoacrylate (superglue): apply glue, sprinkle baking soda on the wet glue to harden it, then apply glue again for a strong joint; cosmophene/ cosmofen adhesive is an alternative that also works. Green clip fasteners are the standard color; yellow variants are also seen. The trim clips are generally strong and difficult to remove 1516171819.

Door speaker crackling — oxidized contacts: crackling from the door speakers when the cabin is heating up, disappearing once warm, indicates oxidized electrical contacts (speakers are prone to oxidation in this vehicle). Fix: remove the door trim, inspect the speaker connectors for corrosion, and clean the contacts. Water ingress (e.g. from fall rain accumulation) makes it worse. The stock cabin speakers themselves are durable, but the contacts need maintenance 2021.

Door speaker replacement — Mazda 3 5x7 compatibility: the standard oval speakers on the X80 are 5x7 inches, the same size as Mazda 3 factory speakers. Recommended aftermarket option: Hertz 5x7 speakers, ~3,000 RUB per pair (RU market, circa 2021–2022; reported November 2024). Users report good performance from this upgrade 22.

Removal time and connector fragility: door panel removal is straightforward and normally takes about 10–15 minutes with proper technique — the OEM speakers become visible/accessible once the panel is off 23. Time can vary a lot by conditions: removal has taken as little as expected for someone with steady hands, but up to half an hour for others, and cold weather stiffens the plastic and makes clips more likely to break — one owner broke a mounting clip during a low-temperature (+5°C) autumn removal, and a separate owner broke one that was wedged in so tightly it was hard to extract even with pliers, and simply left it out rather than force it back in. Expect one or more connectors/clips to potentially break if handled carelessly; the panel still reinstalls fine with a broken clip or two, just slightly less securely 232425.

Confirming report — clips, cold-weather brittleness, and speaker upgrade payoff: a separate speaker-upgrade project independently confirms several points above: door-panel fastener clips (plastic "pistons") are standard and available as a universal pack on Ozon; warm-weather removal is markedly easier than cold, since the plastic becomes brittle and prone to cracking at +5°C or below; Lada Priora (ВАЗ Priora) plastic clips are confirmed as compatible replacements for any clips broken during the job. The resulting sound-quality improvement from the aftermarket speaker upgrade was reported as substantial 26272829303132333435.

Door bottom panel plastic trim removal: the plastic trim on door bottom panels is held by clips and double-sided tape; the trim can break during removal. Gentle removal method: use a hairdryer/heat gun to warm the adhesive before pulling — this preserves the clips better. Full removal may require removing the door panel and speaker assembly first. Always remove carefully or risk breaking the clips 3637383940.

Driver's-side door panel removal — quick reference: (1) remove the decorative cover from the door handle; (2) unscrew the bolts behind the handle; (3) remove the decorative cover from the door lock lever; (4) unscrew the bolt under that cover; (5) carefully peel off the panel — it uses clips. Reference: a Drive2 article by "Фаб" on door soundproofing (shum-isolation, part 1) covers the same steps in more depth 414243.

Driver's door panel removal — clip sequence and spare-clips tip: further procedural detail confirming the quick reference above: use clip-removal tools to unclip fasteners around the panel perimeter — avoid removing the handle and sill trim completely. The panel unclips from the bottom first, then lifts upward off the upper rail. Prepare spare clips before disassembly, since breaking clips during the job is common (consistent with the clip-fragility notes above). A video tutorial exists in the community showing the proper unclipping sequence. The panel can be removed without disconnecting power if the electrical connectors are handled carefully 444546.

Front door panel removal — screw locations confirmed (short reference): two bolts are located under the overlay of the large door handle, plus one more bolt under a cap in the door-opening-handle recess. After removing those three fasteners, pull sharply from the bottom to unsnap the clips, then lift slightly and pull the panel out from under the handle to the side. Confirming report: with careful, gentle work the clips come off intact — nothing complicated about the job 47484950.

docs.title: Door replacement — cost and fitment issues
docs.text:
Tags: #door · #price · #fitment · #part-number

Prices and suppliers on this page are Russian-market (RUB, at the dates shown). Verify locally before relying on them in Syria.

Door replacement cost in Russian shops: a complete door replacement (new door + paint + labor) costs approximately 60,000 RUB in Russian body shops (October 2025). Breakdown (RU market, October 2025): door alone ~40,000 RUB; paint ~6,000 RUB; labor ~15,000 RUB. Repairing the original door instead costs approximately 30,000 RUB (RU market, October 2025), but requires filler/putty and may affect resale value 123.

Chinese reproduction door fitment issues: one owner imported a Chinese-reproduction replacement door for a repair and found it problematic — the door required multiple adjustment attempts (3+ mechanics) but could not be properly aligned. Recommendation from that experience: source an original door from the salvage/used-parts market instead of installing a new Chinese reproduction door 45.

Pre-facelift vs. post-facelift rear-door fitment — not interchangeable: pre-facelift (pre-2020) and post-facelift (2020+) rear doors have significantly different shapes and are not interchangeable. Post-facelift doors feature an embossed texture instead of an overlay on the upper section. Tail-light (фонари) housings also differ in shape and height between the two generations, with different connector configurations. Mixing generations results in poor fitment and alignment issues 67891011. See the trunk latch/lock card for a related report on collision-damage frame deformation blocking the door lock and the cost of a full China-sourced door replacement (~59,000 RUB plus labor; RU market, January 2026).

OEM door panel pricing and availability — extremely rare/expensive (May 2026): original FAW Besturn X80 door panels are extremely rare and expensive on the Russian secondary market. Pre-facelift example: a rear-right door (FAW part 5CA072020) listed on Moscow Avito at a multiple-fold higher price than equivalent Mazda 6 or Mercedes door panels. One buyer monitored listings for ~1 year with only sporadic availability. Both front and rear doors occasionally appear on Moscow Avito from a single seller. Supply is critically constrained; many owners resort to Mazda 6 parts as an alternative despite the fitment complexity noted elsewhere on this card 12131415161718.

Rear/tailgate door part numbers — reference list (various generations): several rear/tailgate door part numbers were shared independently over time; listed together here for reference, since terminology ("rear door" vs. "5th door"/tailgate) sometimes overlaps in the source chat: - 5CA162020M1 — reported both as a general "trunk/tailgate door" part number and, in a separate post from the same source, explicitly labeled the rear door (restyle) part. These may be the same part described two different ways, or reflect inconsistent labeling in the retailer listing — verify against your specific generation before ordering 192021. - 5CA162020M2 — rear door (pre-restyle/dorest) 2223. - 5CA073020M3 — rear-left door (pre-restyle/dorest); priced at 52,650 RUB (RU market, August 2024) via KitZapchasti 24. This is a separate part-number family from the rear-right door panel (5CA072020) noted above, and from the trunk-latch mechanism part numbers covered on the trunk latch/lock card.

Body part fitment and quality when ordering replacements — a general buying lesson: consistent with the Chinese-reproduction door problems above, when ordering any replacement body part (not just doors — e.g. fenders too), cheap Chinese "original"-labeled parts often have poor fit, are warped or misaligned, and don't match OEM dimensions. New genuine parts from verified suppliers fit better and require less adjustment. One owner (Igor) ordered body parts from a verified supplier ("Vasily") with proper fitment, while an earlier attempt with cheap Chinese knockoffs did not align into the panel gaps correctly. Recommendation: source from verified suppliers even if more expensive 2526.

docs.title: Door squeaks and creaks — hinges and boot cover fixes
docs.text:
Tags: #door · #squeak · #window · #rattle

Prices and suppliers on this page are Russian-market (RUB, at the dates shown). Verify locally before relying on them in Syria.

Door hinges: doors creak/squeak when opening. Fix: (1) clean the hinge with WD-40 to remove moisture and corrosion; (2) apply a proper lubricant — silicone grease works better than the dry graphite lubricant included with some door-limiter kits, which dries out in heat. Specific recommendation: Molykote 111 silicone lubricant (rated -40 to +260°C), which works well with door limiters 12345.

Door boot cover (обшивка): squeaking/creaking from the door boot trim can be fixed by (1) removing the trim panel and applying silicone spray to the contact points, or (2) using an anti-squeak compound ("антискрип"), sold on Ozon. Both fixes confirmed effective by community members 6789.

Door glass rattle at high volume: the driver's-side window glass rattles/vibrates at high music volume, creating an annoying noise — affects multiple X80 owners. Possible causes: window-seal degradation or glass mounting tolerances. Temporary workaround: drop the window down slightly, which reduces vibration. A more permanent fix involves door-panel disassembly and applying sound-deadening material, but this may only partially resolve the issue 1011121314.

Rattle from poor-quality door trim sound damping: a common rattling sound in the cabin at idle or low speed comes from poor-quality sound damping material installed inside the door panels, which vibrates. Diagnostic: pressing the door trim inward while the engine idles stops the noise temporarily, confirming the trim is the source. Fix: remove the door trim, clean off the old adhesive, and apply proper anti-squeak adhesive tape along panel edges or under the rubber trim seals 1516171819. Note: a separate report also links interior rattle/vibration felt in the pedal/clutch area at idle or in traffic to worn engine mounts — replacing the mounts eliminated that particular vibration and noise entirely 18.

docs.title: Weatherstrip tape — dust and noise reduction
docs.text:
Tags: #door

Prices and suppliers on this page are Russian-market (RUB, at the dates shown). Verify locally before relying on them in Syria.

Adhesive weatherstripping tape (3M brand or equivalent, available on OZON) can be applied around door, hood, and trunk perimeters to reduce dust ingress and wind noise. Different tape variants exist for different locations (door, trunk, hood, roof). Separately, existing factory rubber seals can be maintained by treating them with silicone (spray or gel) rather than replacing them — one owner reports the factory seals are fine once treated this way. Installation is a DIY job: clean the area, then apply the tape along the door-frame (or hood/trunk) edges; one owner applied it herself around doors, trunk, and hood, and reports less dust/dirt ingress and quieter door closing afterward 12345.

docs.title: Electric mirror adjustment — disable methods
docs.text:
Tags: #mirror · #low-confidence · #conflict

Some advice here concerns sub-zero winters and is less relevant in a hot climate.

Community members disagree on this topic — both positions are reported.

Electric mirror adjustment can reportedly be disabled via two methods: (1) remove the battery/connector at the mirror; or (2) disable it through the launcher app by accessing comfort-module settings. Relevant for owners who want manual-only mirror control (low-confidence report — not independently verified) 12.

Disabling automatic mirror-fold on door lock: to stop the mirrors from auto-folding when the car locks, close the car with the door lock button, then immediately open the rear door with your other hand while the car is still in the process of locking — the goal is to catch the moment the mirrors are folding and interrupt the sequence by opening the door. This may take several attempts to time correctly. Once achieved, mirrors stay unfolded whether the car is locked or opened, and the effect persists through winter driving 34. ⚠️ Conflict/gap: one owner (Алексей) reports success with this method; another (Konstantin) asks whether it can be reversed back to auto-fold, but no verified reversal procedure has been documented in the group 56.

Disable auto-fold via battery disconnect (with re-enable steps) — resolves the gap above: to disable the auto-fold mirror feature, disconnect the negative battery terminal for 15 minutes; once reconnected, the mirrors stop folding automatically on lock. To re-enable auto-fold, manually fold/unfold the mirrors 3 times using the mirror-control button — this re-teaches the comfort module the auto-fold behavior 7.

Related: the variant of the door trick (lock with one hand, open and quickly close the rear door; works on both mirrors) and the cut-the-motor-wire / StarLine A63 options are in [Side mirror assembly — folding motor failure]](../body-exterior/side-mirror-assembly-and-folding-motor.md).

docs.title: Electric trunk opener — compatibility and pricing
docs.text:
Tags: #trunk · #price · #conflict · #low-confidence

Prices and suppliers on this page are Russian-market (RUB, at the dates shown). Verify locally before relying on them in Syria.

Community members disagree on this topic — both positions are reported.

Several owners investigated adding a power/electric trunk (tailgate) opener to the X80 in February 2026. Reported price range (RU market, February 2026): 25,000–35,800 RUB. Candidate donor options discussed: the FAW X40 power-tailgate kit (~31,800 RUB, RU market, February 2026), and the Mazda CX-5 (2017–2026) power-tailgate kit. The critical fitment factors identified are: the 540mm inter-center strut distance (matching the X80's factory strut mounting spec), the compressed (retracted) length of the actuator struts, and the lift height/travel. ⚠️ No community consensus on fitment was reached — multiple owners researched the options but no one confirmed a working installation; outcomes reportedly differed between owners who tried cross-platform kits, so any of these options requires individual verification before purchase 12345.

DIY cross-platform assembly workaround (unconfirmed/experimental): no pre-assembled power trunk lock with electric drive exists for the X80 on any market (Ozon, AliExpress, China direct, etc.), as of May 2026. A proposed DIY workaround combines: (1) trunk struts from a VW Tiguan (first-gen, ~53 cm length — mechanical fitment verified elsewhere on this card), plus (2) the electric lock/solenoid unit from a Lada Granta (the electric drive unit exists as a donor part, but its mechanical fitment on the X80 is unknown). The Granta lock connector's compatibility is also unknown. Status: experimental, not yet field-tested on an X80 678910111213141516.

docs.title: Removing factory badging/letters from bodywork
docs.text:
Three community-reported methods for removing factory badge letters (e.g. model-name lettering) from the bodywork: 1. Heat + peel: heat the letter with a hair dryer or heat gun while slowly peeling it off with a plastic scraper, then clean the residual adhesive with spirit (isopropyl-type solvent). 2. Thread pull: pull the letters off using thick nylon thread (drawn behind the letter, similar to removing old auto glass), then polish the area with a machine polisher and compound to remove adhesive residue. 3. Warm-weather timing: attempting removal during hot summer weather makes the adhesive softer and the letters easier to remove.

The factory adhesive is very strong in all cases; residual tape/glue must be heated and scraped clean, then wiped with spirit as a final step 12345678.

Reinforcing report — string-pull method: an earlier report describes the same thread/string-pull technique (method 2 above) for the rear FAW badging specifically: stretch a string/thread under the letters to cut through the adhesive tape evenly, then clean off the remaining residue with solvent/rubbing alcohol. No special tools required 91011.

docs.title: Plastic fender lip guard — tape-mounted installation
docs.text:
Tags: #fender · #installation · #low-confidence

Installation method: plastic fender lip guards (protective trim along the fender opening edge) attach using either 3M tape or Cosmofene adhesive. No drilling or clips are involved — it's a purely adhesive-mounted accessory.

Aesthetic result: the guards provide a clean, finished appearance along the wheel-arch edge, visible in installation photos on a white X80.

Durability — unconfirmed: whether the tape/adhesive bond survives repeated car washes over time is uncertain — no long-term durability report is available yet, so treat this as a cosmetic mod with an open question on longevity 123.

docs.title: Front fender molding — part number and clips
docs.text:
Tags: #fender · #molding · #part-number · #clips

Prices and suppliers on this page are Russian-market (RUB, at the dates shown). Verify locally before relying on them in Syria.

Part number: the front-left fender molding part number is 5CA15004502 (for the NEW/restyle X80), available from multiple online retailers including kitzapchasti.ru, autocraft-kzn.ru, and kitzap.ru 12.

Common failure — molding flies off: the front fender molding frequently falls off / "flies off" during driving — this is a common failure reported by multiple owners, not an isolated defect. Root cause: weak or inadequate retention clips that don't hold the molding securely under wind load and vibration 31.

Fitment varies by model year: front fender moldings differ between pre-facelift and facelift models — facelift-version moldings are wider, and attachment-point spacing also differs between the two generations. Confirm which generation's molding is needed before ordering 456789.

Rear fender molding: the right rear fender molding also has its own specific part number, visible on the trim piece's own marking (photo on file, useful for matching a replacement) 10.

Wheel-arch molding (fender trim) — separate part, pre/post-restyle part numbers: plastic wheel-arch molding trim (крыло молдинг) is available separately for the X80. Part numbers differ between pre-restyled (дорест, ending in 0) and post-restyled (рест, ending in 1) versions. Restyle part number: 5CA15005502 (~1,430 RUB, RU market, January 2026). Available from AliExpress, Wildberries, and Russian auto-parts shops (e.g. Kitparts). Verify the vehicle's trim year from the VIN before ordering 11121314151617.

Wheel-arch molding — additional pre/post-facelift part numbers (do not cross-order): further confirmation that pre-facelift (дорест) and facelift (рест) wheel-arch moldings use different part numbers and are not interchangeable, for both front and rear moldings. Pre-facelift example: 5CA05004602 (confirmed дорест). Facelift version: 5CA15004602 (marked as NEW). Always verify the vehicle's facelift status before ordering 181920212223.

Reinforcing pair — 5CA05004602 and 5CA05004502: an earlier community report lists the same 5CA05004602 front/restyling arc-molding part number alongside a companion number, 5CA05004502, for the (likely paired left/right or front/rear) molding set — consistent with the pre-facelift/facelift split documented above. Available at aftermarket suppliers and auto-paint shops (малярка) in Russia 2425.

Body arch molding — 2026 price update and dealer-order lead time (reinforcing report): further confirmation that arch moldings differ between pre-restyle (dorest) and restyle and are not interchangeable (forcing fitment damages both parts). Restyle part number 5CA15004502 (matching the front fender molding number above) is priced at 4,800 RUB (RU market, May 2026), available only via factory order through dealers/suppliers (e.g. "Vasily"), with a 1.5–2 month delivery time. Both front and rear arch moldings are affected by this incompatibility 262728293031323334.

Rear-right arch moulding 5CA05005602 (pre-restyle numbering): an Emex listing shows the rear-right arch moulding (арочный молдинг заднего правого крыла) of the X80 as 5CA05005602 at 2,006 RUB per piece (RU market, February 2026), 2 in stock, 4-day delivery 35. Front and rear mouldings differ between pre-restyle and restyle, so do not mix the numbering. The restyle arch moulding is a factory special order at about 4,800 RUB (RU market, May 2026) with a 1.5–2 month wait 3334.

docs.title: Front bumper removal procedure
docs.text:
Tags: #bumper · #removal

Front bumper removal: (1) remove the trim pieces from the fenders first — these use tight clips, be careful not to break them; (2) remove all bolts/ screws around the bumper (top, bottom, and sides); (3) disengage the clips between the fender and the bumper; (4) carefully separate the bumper from the vehicle. Note: the bumper is one piece, not three — the visible trim accents/inserts are separate pieces attached to it, not bumper sections 12.

docs.title: Front fender liner — material and durability
docs.text:
Tags: #hvac · #price · #part-number

Prices and suppliers on this page are Russian-market (RUB, at the dates shown). Verify locally before relying on them in Syria.

OEM front fender liners are felted material, not plastic — durability depends heavily on climate/road salt: FAW X80 front fenders use a felted (fabric-like) OEM liner material rather than plastic. Durability varies sharply by region: in high-salt-exposure regions (e.g., the Urals, where "Ilyetsk salt" is used on roads), the felted liners become waterlogged and delaminate within just 3–5 years of regular driving. In milder climates (Moscow, central Russia), the same OEM liners have lasted 6–7 years on 2019-model-year cars. Alternative: once the felt liner fails, owners can replace it with an aftermarket plastic liner (DIY or professional install) instead of sourcing another felt OEM unit 123456.

Front splash-guard prices: front-left splash guards (брызговик) were quoted at 700–900 RUB and the front right at about 2,000 RUB (RU market, June 2024); the gap was not explained. The right part is listed as 5CA05184002 on zzap and in a Kazan autocraft listing 78. For rear liners and aftermarket mud flaps see splash guards and mud flaps.

docs.title: Front fender longeron — collision repair
docs.text: After a front collision affecting the longeron (frame rail), the damaged longeron itself can be straightened and reset into position — but the stamped-steel bracket ("гнездо") that mounts the front headlight assembly to the longeron must be replaced with a new part rather than reshaped, since it cannot be reliably straightened after damage. Diagnosing exactly what needs replacing versus what can be repaired requires unibody/collision-repair expertise, not a general mechanic 12.

docs.title: Fuel filler cap rubber seal — replacement
docs.text:
Tags: #seal · #gasket

Failure mode: the rubber sealing gasket on the fuel filler cap can tear from use over time, similar to other rubber seals on the car.

Sourcing: a replacement seal is available on the KitZap marketplace.

Removal caution: removal of the old gasket is difficult due to adhesive — the seal is bonded in place, so expect to work carefully to avoid damaging the surrounding filler-neck plastic while prying/scraping the old material off 123.

Fuel filler door lock — removal procedure: (1) remove the round black cover on the door edge; (2) remove the hex bolt with a socket; (3) extract the lock-rod clip carefully — these clips resist removal; (4) withdraw the lock assembly along with the key cylinder. Installation reverses the procedure 4.

docs.title: Fuel filler door freezing shut in winter
docs.text:
Tags: #winter

Some advice here concerns sub-zero winters and is less relevant in a hot climate.

X80 owners parked outdoors in winter report frequent ice/snow accumulation on the wheel arches and fuel-door area, making the fuel door difficult to open. The issue is common across the community and affects vehicles with felt material on the rear arches. Primary mitigation: clean the fuel-door area immediately upon arrival, before ice can set. Silicone spray on the seals and edges gives limited improvement. The problem is most severe during heavy snowfall or freeze-thaw cycles 12345678910.

docs.title: Headlight assembly — removal and repair
docs.text:
Tags: #headlight · #part-number

Removal procedure: (1) remove the front bumper (significant disassembly); (2) remove the headlight bracket bolts; (3) unplug the connector. The right-side headlight is more accessible to remove than the left 123.

Sourcing note: replacement headlight lens covers are sometimes available as a separate item, but sourcing an original OEM cover alone (rather than the whole unit) is difficult — one owner who only cracked the cover on the right headlight could not find the cover sold separately 4.

DIY patch repair (cracked housing): one owner patched a badly damaged left headlight housing using silicone plus cyanoacrylate (superglue) as a temporary fix, intending it to last only until they got home. The patch ended up lasting 6+ months, with the housing still functioning, no moisture inside, and the seal holding 3.

Aiming/adjustment screw location: the horizontal beam-aim adjustment screw is on the headlight housing itself — on the right side of the left headlight, and on the left side of the right headlight 56.

Uneven beam pattern after bulb installation — check bulb orientation before suspecting the housing: uneven headlight beam distribution (one lens pointing right, the other up/down, or one beam higher than the other) is often caused by incorrect lamp/bulb orientation during installation rather than a headlight-body defect. Bulbs like TORCH and NGK iridium types have specific orientation marks that must be aligned vertically. Rotating the lamp 180 degrees often corrects the beam pattern without requiring headlight replacement — worth checking before assuming the housing/aiming mechanism itself is at fault 78.

Glare — bulb colour vs beam aim (opinions differ): one member with 6000 K headlights with lenses says he sees no problem once they are adjusted 9. Victor says he squints even at 4300 K and that the issue is the beam pattern rather than the colour 10. A third member says that if the headlights are aimed properly, they should not blind other drivers 11.

docs.title: Headlight lens restoration — polishing
docs.text:
Tags: #headlight

X80 headlight lenses are plastic, not glass. Yellowed/fogged lenses can be restored by progressive wet-sanding: (1) 800-grit sandpaper + water; (2) 1000-grit sandpaper; (3) 2000-grit sandpaper; (4) 3000-grit sandpaper; (5) pink/sapphire compound polishing pad — a rotary polisher is recommended. Result: clear, restored light output (able to see the road clearly instead of dual dull reflections). A modern alternative to clear-coating is polishing followed by applying a protective film, since the film provides better long-term UV protection than a fresh clear coat 12.

Protective film installation — confirmed independent report: confirming the film-protection alternative noted above, a separate owner independently reports applying a protective ("armor"/бронеплёнка) film to the headlights. Installation is straightforward on a clean, dry surface and requires no headlight removal 3.

Root cause of yellowing is internal, not just surface oxidation — UV coating treatment mixed results: pre-restyle headlight lenses yellow due to UV degradation of the polycarbonate. The progressive polishing sequence (600 → 800 → 1000 → 1500 → 2000 grit) removes the surface layer but deep yellowing persists in many cases — the root cause is degradation of the polyurethane coating inside the plastic, not just surface oxidation. Partial solution: apply a UV-protective clear coat (preferably one with a UV filter) after polishing, but results are variable if the yellowing is internal — some owners report success with the clear coat, others report minimal improvement. The most reliable outcome reported: accepting yellowing as cosmetic once function isn't impaired, or replacing the headlight outright 4567891011. ⚠️ Conflict: disagreement on UV clear-coat effectiveness — some owners suggest trying it, while others had headlights fully replaced after a failed restoration attempt.

Sun-exposure (not usage frequency) drives yellowing — protective film as prevention: headlight lenses yellow and lose clarity primarily from sun exposure, rather than from frequency of use. A clear protective film applied preventively is recommended to slow this. The problem accelerates with intense sunlight exposure and vehicle age 1213.

Prevention + restoration options, consolidated: (1) prevention — polish the headlights and immediately apply a protective film; one owner reports this held up well for an extended period; (2) restoration option A — apply epoxy primer with hardener, wire-brush any oxidized areas with a rust converter, then repaint; (3) restoration option B — replace with new headlights sourced from China, reported by owners as functionally identical (including the lamps) and often cheaper than a full restoration attempt 1415.

docs.title: Hood deflector/visor (мухобойка) — fitment
docs.text:
Tags: #fitment · #restyle

Hood deflector/visor (мухобойка) geometry differs between pre-facelift (дорестайл) and facelift (рестайлинг) models — facelift versions have different cutout/underside contours. A pre-facelift visor requires slight bending/fitting adjustments to install on a facelift model. One owner sourced a visor from an official dealer and still needed on-site fitting — advised to check fit before purchase. Toyota Prado visors are reported to sometimes fit but this is not guaranteed 1234567.

docs.title: Hood-edge rubber seal — fitment issue and rattle
docs.text:
Tags: #hood · #seal · #noise

Rubber seals/gaskets at the hood edge (at the fender/wing area, near the hood latch) can shift or fall off, causing a noticeable noise/rattle over bumpy roads and speed bumps. A similar seal exists on both sides of the hood; if one is missing, the noise increases noticeably. The part should be factory-installed and is available through OEM channels, but exact part identification is difficult — no confirmed part number was found in the community discussion 12345678910111213.

docs.title: Hood flutter at highway speed — adjustment
docs.text:
Tags: #hood

The hood (капот) can exhibit flutter or a wave-like motion at highway speeds, especially when passing large trucks. This is typically not a serious safety issue but indicates loose hinge adjustment 12. Fix: have an official FAW dealer adjust and tighten the hood hinges, and check the perimeter weatherstripping/seals (уплотнитель) around the hood 3. If only vibration occurs without visible hood movement ("petaling"), the cause may be primarily the seal, which may need replacement or repositioning 4.

docs.title: Hood edge molding/trim — part numbers and availability
docs.text:
Tags: #part-number

Prices and suppliers on this page are Russian-market (RUB, at the dates shown). Verify locally before relying on them in Syria.

The hood edge molding/trim (капота молдинг) — the black plastic strip that runs along the hood's front edge — has genuine FAW Besturn X80 part number 5CA050750A09 12. It can be damaged or torn off in driving (e.g. by insect impact at high speed) 3. Available from kitzapchasti.ru and other online parts suppliers; installation is straightforward 4.

A later report lists two variants of the (chrome/silver) trim piece with different part numbers — confirm which is needed before ordering: - 5CA050750A09 — silver, typically special-order 5. - 5CA05075019 — silver, available in stock 67.

Detachment and reattachment (weak factory fasteners): the hood molding — including the piece mounted between the headlights — is prone to detaching due to weak factory fasteners/mounting brackets. Reattachment options, from least to most durable: (1) adhesive sealant (герметик) — least durable; (2) two-component epoxy glue combined with screw reinforcement; (3) superglue + baking-soda paste, spot-welded with a soldering iron to secure staple hooks — options (2) and (3) hold up better than plain sealant 8910111213.

Pre-facelift part number confirmed, color variants: for the pre-facelift X80 the hood molding part number is confirmed as 5CA050750A09. Aftermarket replacements with a red accent stripe are available on AliExpress and Ozon; the factory-original plain black version is also available 13141516.

Hood molding — part number 5CA05075019 (Autocraft, availability gap): FAW Besturn X80 hood molding (молдинг капота), part number 5CA05075019, available from Autocraft (autocraft-kzn.ru). As of December 2025, the part was temporarily unavailable from the original supplier; a community member looking to purchase it contacted the shop directly by phone 171819.

Pre-restyling hood molding — additional suppliers (2013–2016 models): for pre-restyling FAW X80 (2013–2016), the same part number 5CA05075019 is also available from kitzapchasti.ru and kitparts.ru, priced from 1,963 RUB and up (May 2024 pricing). Can be ordered online, but the community recommends verifying with a reputable supplier before full payment 2021.

Double-sided tape as a quick temporary fix (reinforcing report): an earlier report on the same detachment issue (pre-facelift model, 2013–2018, part 5CA05075019) confirms double-sided automotive tape as a viable temporary re-attachment method when the molding comes loose, ahead of ordering a replacement part (₽1,963+, RU market, as of March 2024, available from Kitzap, Farpost, and other suppliers) — consistent with the fuller fastener options documented above 22232425.

docs.title: Hood — part number and flutter fix
docs.text:
Tags: #hood · #part-number · #price

Prices and suppliers on this page are Russian-market (RUB, at the dates shown). Verify locally before relying on them in Syria.

Part number and sourcing: the hood part number is 5CA152310-#M3 for the FAW Besturn X80F (restyling model). Available from kitparts.ru at approximately 51,837 RUB as of June 2025, and also from kitzap.ru 123.

Hood flutter/vertical play at highway speed (100+ km/h) — adhesive seal fix: the hood can exhibit vertical play and a "floating" motion at speeds above 100 km/h. Root cause: the hood's upper and lower panel layers are not bonded together — only the outer skin panel moves, flexing independently of the inner reinforcement. Fix: apply a special auto-grade sealant between the two layers and clamp them together for 24 hours to bond them and prevent flexing. The curved foam edge seals can also be adjusted via their rubber inserts for a tighter closure. Some owners reported the flutter persisting even at 150+ km/h before sealing; after sealing, the issue is reported as completely resolved 4567891011.

Used/private-seller hood pricing — prices escalate on inquiry (Dec 2025): as an alternative to the OEM part above, a pre-restyle hood sourced from a private seller was found listed at 16,000 RUB (RU market, December 2025); after the buyer called to inquire, the seller raised the price to 24,000 RUB. The buyer then found an alternative listing at a better price, but that price also rose — to 26,000 RUB (RU market, December 2025) — once contacted. Take listed used-market prices for the hood as a starting point only, not a firm quote 12.

Emergency hood alternative — Mazda CX-5 (unconfirmed for long-term use): a Mazda CX-5 hood can fit the FAW X80 as a replacement hood (e.g. after minor collision damage). One owner sourced a CX-5 hood for 7,000 RUB (RU market, December 2025) from a salvage yard; it required slight modification (a bulge had to be worked out) but closed properly and was functionally adequate as a temporary/emergency repair. ⚠️ Low confidence: direct long-term fitment is not confirmed by the community 1314151617181920.

Hood vibration/shimmy at high speed (185+ km/h) — thin-metal design, distinct from the 100+ km/h floating issue above: separately from the vertical-play/floating fix above, owners report the hood visibly vibrates/shimmers at speeds above 185 km/h, attributed to the thin sheet-metal hood design. The vibration is first noticeable from around 110 km/h but becomes pronounced only at 185+ km/h. Partial mitigation: adjusting or removing the rubber hood support stops (резиновые упоры спереди капота) may reduce the vibration's severity. Sound insulation does not fully eliminate the issue — this is treated as a design limitation rather than a maintenance failure, i.e. even a well-maintained/properly-sealed hood (per the adhesive-seal fix above) may still shimmer at these very high speeds 2122232425262728.

Mazda CX-5 hood fitment confirmed on facelift X80: a community member reports the Mazda CX-5 hood fits the facelift (post-2020) X80 cleanly — the bolt mounting points and latch alignment are compatible, and the hood mounts without modification. This adds confidence to the emergency-fitment report above (which required minor bulge-working on a pre-facelift/unspecified car): on the facelift specifically, fitment appears clean. The exterior shape difference from the factory hood is visible but the swap remains functional 2930313233.

Rattling/vibration — reinforcing report attributing it to a factory sealant defect: a separate report describes the same underlying issue (hood vibrates/rattles at highway speeds) as caused by defective Chinese sealant/adhesive used during factory assembly between the hood reinforcer and the upper panel — consistent with the "panels not bonded" root cause described above. Fix, matching the adhesive-seal method above: remove the hood, clean out the old sealant residue completely, and re-seal with a proper flexible-curing automotive sealant. Treated by the reporting owner as a common manufacturing defect on affected units 343536373839.

Pre-restyle hood numbers: for a pre-facelift X80 the original hood is 5CA052310M2 and the analog is 5CA052310M1; the base number 5CA052310 without a suffix is also a hood. The thread used this to answer a pre-facelift parts request 4041.

docs.title: Hood gas struts — Volkswagen Golf VI alternative
docs.text:
Tags: #hood · #gas-strut · #part-number · #mazda-6-compat

Prices and suppliers on this page are Russian-market (RUB, at the dates shown). Verify locally before relying on them in Syria.

Volkswagen Golf VI (2008–2012) hood struts as a cross-fit option (Feb 2026): the "RIGINAL"-brand hood gas strut (амортизатор/упор капота) made for the Volkswagen Golf VI (2008–2012), OEM reference 5K0823359C, was shared as a compatible option, sourced via an Ozon listing. Caution: a second owner who bought this part reports the holding force is weak — the strut does not hold the hood open with the same firmness as expected, suggesting this cross-fit is usable but not a fully equivalent replacement for a strong original strut 12. See also the trunk lid gas struts card for the separate (and better documented) Volkswagen Tiguan-sourced trunk strut alternative — hood and trunk struts are different parts and not interchangeable with each other.

docs.title: Hot zinc coating for panel corrosion treatment
docs.text:
Tags: #corrosion · #price

Prices and suppliers on this page are Russian-market (RUB, at the dates shown). Verify locally before relying on them in Syria.

Process. Professional hot zinc coating ("горячее цинкование") removes active corrosion from a body panel and applies a protective zinc-powder coating under high pressure and high temperature. Procedure: (1) existing corrosion is stripped from the panel using a high-pressure spray; (2) zinc powder is then applied and fused to the bare metal surface under heat/pressure, creating a durable protective layer.1234

Sourcing. This service is not a standard body shop offering — owners report finding it via classified listings on Avito, searching for shops that advertise "жучки" (rust spot) treatment specifically.3

Comparison to alternatives. Hot zinc coating is considered by the community significantly more reliable than electrolytic zinc-plating methods for treating extensive/active rust, particularly on structural panels like the hood. One owner who does electrolytic zinc coating themselves in their home garage acknowledged that the hot/pressurized method is superior, even though the DIY electrolytic method remains a viable lower-cost option for minor spots.1234

Use case. Applied to hood and other body panel sections showing corrosion before repainting — treated areas are photographed pre-paint to document the corrosion was addressed at the metal level, not just cosmetically covered.56

docs.title: Lamp housings — part numbers and prices
docs.text:

Prices and suppliers on this page are Russian-market (RUB, at the dates shown). Verify locally before relying on them in Syria.

Upper (third) stop light 5CA151580: listed at about 9,515 RUB on Kitparts (RU market, July 2024), and also on Ozon and kitzap 1. Removing the repeater from the rear spoiler is covered in component locations.
