Right daytime running light 5CA05179Z: a Kitz Zapchasti listing for the right daytime running light (ходовые огни правые) of the FAW X80 NEW carries part number 5CA05179Z. It was posted in answer to a question about a boomerang-shaped right fog or running light; it is a running light, not a fog lamp, so check the fit before ordering 3.

For headlight removal and repair see headlight assembly.

docs.title: License plate frame — correct orientation for alignment
docs.text:
Prices and suppliers on this page are Russian-market (RUB, at the dates shown). Verify locally before relying on them in Syria.

The license-plate mounting bracket is often installed upside-down from the factory, positioning the plate lower than intended with a black trim piece visible above it. Correct installation: flip the bracket 180° so the trim piece (which contacts the boot lid) sits below the plate, not above. This raises the plate to proper center alignment on the rear panel and hides the trim hardware 12345.

Square vs. rectangular factory plate holder (restyle): the post-restyle X80's rear door comes with a square-format license-plate holder from the factory. A rectangular/standard Russian frame is also available and some owners prefer it for appearance; fitting it requires a frame adapter. Owners report differing aesthetic preferences — some find the factory square frame looks odd on the vehicle 678910.

Chinese-standard hole-spacing frames — preferred over adapters: the X80 needs license-plate frames designed for Chinese-standard mounting-hole spacing, not the European standard. The community recommends buying black universal frames matched to this spacing directly — e.g. the ARS brand (~1,690 RUB, RU market, December 2025) on Ozon, or the LBDV auto brand on Wildberries — instead of using original frames with adapters. Original-frame-plus-adapter combinations cause vibration and rattling noise (дребезжать); frames with correctly-spaced Chinese holes mount cleanly with no rattle and the plate sits properly aligned 11121314151617.

Another Chinese-spec adapter option (2-pack, rear plate): further confirming the Chinese-hole-spacing recommendation above, a specific 2-pack black adapter-frame kit for Chinese-spec plate mounting is available on Ozon at an affordable price — reported to stop the rear plate from rattling, consistent with the anti-rattle benefit of correctly spaced frames noted above. Link: https://ozon.ru/t/GczzszJ 181920.

docs.title: Side-mirror heating — availability by trim
docs.text:
Tags: #mirror · #trim

Some advice here concerns sub-zero winters and is less relevant in a hot climate.

Heated side mirrors are available on all X80 trim levels, including the base trim — confirmed by an owner with a base ("бомж") model who has working mirror heating 1. Mirror heating activates together with the rear-window defrost/heating button — there is no separate switch for the mirrors 2.

Warmth is not immediate: heating can take roughly 5 minutes before it's noticeably warm to the touch — one owner reported still feeling mirrors "cold" shortly after activation but confirmed real warmth after about 5 minutes, and recommends checking by hand rather than judging by feel alone right after pressing the button 345.

Freezes over at highway speed despite heating (cold weather): heated mirrors can still freeze/ice over at highway speeds in cold weather (-17°C and below) even with the heater enabled — the mirror-heating wire element only provides a temporary defrost, and wind plus driving speed cause it to refreeze quickly. This is reported as expected winter behavior in general (not X80-specific); running the rear-window/mirror heater helps but doesn't fully prevent it 67.

docs.title: Splash guards / mud flaps — fitment
docs.text:
Tags: #fitment · #restyle · #part-number

Prices and suppliers on this page are Russian-market (RUB, at the dates shown). Verify locally before relying on them in Syria.

Factory mud guards (подкрылки) are smooth plastic without integrated clip holes. Aftermarket splash guards (брызговики) typically mount via clips through existing holes and/or bolts. The restyle X80's mud-guard design differs from pre-restyle — splash-guard geometry and attachment points may not match between model years, so check compatibility with your generation before buying. Properly fitting X80 splash guards feature a bracket/angle at the bottom for a lower-body attachment point — guards without this bracket can leave a visible gap and lack proper attachment 12345678.

Rear mud flaps — TOTEM plastic replacements: the original felt/cloth rear mud flaps deteriorate after about 110,000 km, curling and shedding. Plastic replacements (TOTEM brand, part number TOTEM.62.16.004) are available for the right-rear position from Kitzapchasti.ru, autochehly.ru, and mirdopov.ru — multiple retailers stock these. Once the felt guards become unusable, the plastic upgrade is practical for higher-mileage vehicles 9101112131415.

Spare-wheel/fender-liner rubbing fix: a spare wheel ("докатка") with offset (ET 45) fits the X80 fine. The front fender liner has a protruding lip designed to cover welded seams — this lip can catch on the tire during turns, scrubbing the inner fender. Resolved by properly securing the lower fastener when reinstalling the fender liner; the rubbing occurred on the inner side of the liner near the weld-seam protector 16.

Rear mud flaps — Autofamily part: Autofamily part NLF.62.16.E13 (polyurethane, 2-piece kit) works well as rear mud flaps on the X80, available on Yandex Market. Universal rubber mud flaps also fit but require drilling additional mounting holes beyond what's pre-drilled — one owner needed extra holes for a longer universal rubber set to seat properly 171819202122232425262728. The material should be flexible rubberized rubber, not hard plastic — one owner has run a rubberized (not plastic) set for 4 years successfully 25.

Rear brake dust cover/splash guard — Frosch part: model Frosch NLF.62.16.E13 (also written NLF6216E13 — same catalog number family as the Autofamily rear mud flap above) fits X80 2018+ models. Flexible rubber/soft material lets it fold if struck by the tire, but a rigid curb strike while parking tightly can still damage the guard if clearance is tight. Available at online retailers and local auto-parts shops, often cheaper than ordering through Ozon 29.

Rear wheel-arch mud flap material (factory felt vs. rust risk): OEM rear wheel-arch mud flaps are pressed felt-like material (прессованный войлок) on both the outer and inner sides. The felt saturates with water during rain and becomes soft, then dries hard again — this cycle traps moisture against the body metal underneath, contributing to rust formation over time. Aftermarket plastic alternatives are available on Yandex Market for 3,000+ RUB; it's unclear whether the aftermarket plastic fitment matches OEM exactly or needs modification 30313233343536.

TOTEM wheel-arch liner part numbers (full set, all 4 corners): plastic wheel-arch liner covers (подкрылки) with TOTEM part numbers: TOTEM.62.16.001 (front left), TOTEM.62.16.002 (front right), TOTEM.S.62.16.003 (rear left, with sound-damping), TOTEM.S.62.16.004 (rear right, with sound-damping — same family as the rear TOTEM part noted above). Price ~1,150 RUB per piece (RU market, June 2025), available on Ozon and other retailers. Pre-2017 models use the felt/wool version; newer models use plastic. Sellers often list outdated prices on their own sites, so verify current pricing before ordering 3738394041.

Plastic mudguard availability — discontinued domestic production: Russian-made plastic rear mudguards (подкрылки из пластика) have been discontinued from local production. Current availability: (1) original felt/wool mudguards — still available from the FAW factory and authorized dealers; (2) Chinese aftermarket plastic versions — available on AliExpress, Yandex Market, Drom, and other platforms, but at a significant price premium over the original felt option; (3) some regional dealer stock may still exist (e.g. one owner in the Rostov area found front-and-rear sets available as combined units). Chinese retailers often fail to clearly differentiate between similar-looking products, so confirm exact fitment before ordering. Front mudguards are sometimes available separately from rear 424344454647484950515253545556.

Front mud flaps sold as a pair only (2017 model): front mud flaps (брызговик) for the 2017 X80 generally available only as a pair from vendors, though some sellers may offer individual units 575859.

Front fender splash guard — sourcing failure and unconfirmed Mazda 6 cross-fit suggestion: sourcing issues for the front fender splash guard were reported by multiple users — one plastic-parts supplier returned the buyer's money after 1 month without being able to fulfill the order. Community suggestion: a Mazda 6 (2014 model) splash guard may share a similar shape, but cross-compatibility is uncertain and worth testing before committing to a purchase 606162636465.

KITZAP vs. KITZAPCHASTI — retailer sourcing distinction: when sourcing rear mud flaps for the 2017–2021 X80 (noting that pre-facelift 2017–2018 and facelift/restyle 2018–2021 fitment may differ, so verify compatibility with your generation before buying), community feedback distinguishes between two similarly-named retailers: KITZAP carries more original (OEM) parts, while KITZAPCHASTI mostly carries aftermarket analogues 6667686970.

Rear plastic fender liner (mudguard) — part numbers: OEM part numbers for the rear plastic fender liners (подкрылки): right fender is 5CA0561H1, left fender is 5CA0561J1. Generic aftermarket alternatives are available from online retailers 71. The left one is also listed on Ozon (November 2025) 72.

docs.title: Chameleon color-shifting paint — rear glass
docs.text:

Chameleon (color-shifting) coating/film can be applied to the X80's rear windows/glass only — front windows must comply with GOST transparency standards, which rules out the chameleon effect there. Rear windows and the tailgate glass can show a color-shifting iridescent effect depending on the viewing/light angle. One owner showcased their car with this treatment on the rear glass. docs.title: Paint color codes — location and known values
docs.text:
Tags: #paint

Prices and suppliers on this page are Russian-market (RUB, at the dates shown). Verify locally before relying on them in Syria.

The car's paint color code is located on the door jamb or the driver-side pillar specification plate. Color shops use this code to mix matching paint for repairs 1234.

Known codes reported by owners: - A4D — Arctic White, for 2018+ FAW X80 models 56. - 32V — Agate Red, factory spec for certain model years 2. - A4D (Arctic White, Acrylic) is also catalogued under paint code RF1000-1; this white is reported prone to fading over time, so professional color-matching is recommended for touch-up/repair work rather than assuming an off-the-shelf match 7891011. - 7В KNIGHT BROWN metallic pearl xerallic — nominal/documented standard color code, also identified as "Coriander 790" in a separate reference (a previous Lada Granta owner recognized the same shade). In practice, professional painters rarely rely on the code alone — they typically pull a reference part (e.g. the fuel filler door or a bumper section) and match by physical shade/tone/sample rather than trusting the code number, since a physical color-chip match is more reliable 1213. - 41v — a soul-red shade, used from approximately the 2018 model year onward as the standard factory finish for red units 141516. - 41V — independently corroborated: FAW-CAR's official name for this code is "Soul Red" (solid, not metallic), listed by a seller as used across 2014–2023. A touch-up correction pen for chips/scratches in this color is available via Ozon 17.

Finding your color code — fuel-door label method: to determine the X80's exact paint color code, remove the fuel-filler door cap/cover and check the color label on its interior surface — the label states the factory paint specification for exact matching 1819.

Knight Brown touch-up paint — sourcing (Nov 2025): a base + clear-coat touch-up kit for the FAW Besturn X80 brown/Knight Brown color is available in a 40 mL size from the CarBase supplier. One owner ordered it via Ozon, which was ~100 RUB cheaper than WildBerries for the same kit (Nov 2025, RU market). An alternative aerosol option is SKULL Aerosol Enamel "Coriander" metallic (520 mL) — but since it's a straight color coat, a separate clear coat must be applied afterward for durability 2021222324.

Factory red = Mazda V32 "Agatred": after trying to color-match X80 red against Chinese-market swatches and doing test spray-outs, one painter found the correct match was much simpler — the X80's factory red is identical to Mazda color code V32 (Agatred). This lets owners source matching touch-up/repaint paint from Mazda-parts suppliers rather than FAW-specific channels 25. This appears to be a different/updated reference to the same red covered by code 41v above — cross-check both codes against a physical color-chip match before ordering paint.

Additional factory color codes and no dashboard badge confirmation: further confirming the fuel-door label method above (no dashboard color badge exists on the X80), the following FAW factory color options were additionally reported: 38P LIGHT SILVER (metallic), B06 FLASH RED (pearl) — in addition to the 32V Agate Red, 7B Knight Brown, and A4D Arctic White codes already listed above. As with the other colors, Mazda paint codes are also usable for color-matching on red variants 262728293031.

Knight Brown touch-up kit — additional confirmation (March 2026): a 40 mL base + clear-coat touch-up kit specifically for 7B KNIGHT BROWN is available on OZON, confirming/matching the November 2025 sourcing note above — recommended for small chips and scratches 32.

Touch-up kits — practical application results and metallic-paint limitations: touch-up kits (FixPaint Double brand or similar) are available on Ozon and Wildberries. One user reported that a 7B-brand paint matched perfectly, while metallic paints from other kits are impossible to apply evenly with a brush — for proper metallic color correction, professional painter application is recommended. Small touch-ups in inconspicuous areas work adequately with brush-applied kits; full door repainting is often necessary for visible areas 33343536373839.

A7 "Huanying Black" — pre-facelift black code: for the black pre-facelift (2012–2017) Besturn X80, the reported paint code is A7 "Huanying Black" (Oley paint type). This is in addition to the red (32V "Agate Red", restyled 2018+) and other codes listed above; codes for white and other colors are also in circulation but reported as prone to variation — custom color matching is recommended when replacing body panels 4041424344.

docs.title: Paint decontamination — water-stain and iron removal
docs.text:
Tags: #paint

Water-stain removal — Aliumax. For maintaining light/white paint specifically, the Aliumax product was reported to effectively remove water stains (hard-water spotting) from the body.1234

Metallic particle (iron fallout) removal — DETAIL IR Iron. DETAIL IR Iron (500 mL) removes embedded metallic particle contamination from body paint and wheels — the effect was described as especially visible on a white car, where metallic contamination shows up clearly against the light paint after a two-phase wash-and-dry.1234

Application and storage notes. Apply IR Iron after a rinse-and-dry wash on a clean, cool surface (not in direct sun/heat). Storage caution: the product should be kept with its cap sealed in a cool location — one owner reported the cap failing after the bottle sat in a hot trunk over summer, causing the product to leak.1234

docs.title: Body galvanization and panel corrosion
docs.text:
Tags: #corrosion · #restyle · #paint

Galvanization is not uniform across the body: doors and hood are galvanized (zinc-coated, "цинк") on the X80, confirmed by multiple owners 12. The tailgate/trunk lid (дверь багажника) is a known exception — not galvanized on at least some cars, which several owners independently identified as a weak point for corrosion 345. Corrosion patterns vary significantly between individual vehicles depending on climate, maintenance, and how the car is kept — some 2018–2019 cars show no meaningful rust after 100,000+ km, others develop reddish rust spots ("рыжики"), especially on door edges and around the tailgate/5th door 67. ⚠️ Conflict: one reply in the chat says the body is galvanized but the doors and fenders are not, which contradicts the doors-galvanized reports above (the original question is not preserved) 8.

Tailgate chrome-trim corner corrosion — a recurring "Restyling" weak point: multiple owners report rust/corrosion appearing specifically at the tailgate corners, where the chrome trim meets the body panel around the rear window glass frame. Paint oxidation and rust form beneath the chrome trim at both bottom outer corners of the tailgate. Root cause: weak clear coat combined with the tailgate's non-galvanized (bare steel) construction 91011121314151617181920521.

Conflict — generation difference: one owner reports "all restyle [facelift] cars have this problem" with corner corrosion appearing, while a pre-facelift (2017) owner with 7 years of ownership reports the car is "fully galvanized, zero corrosion" 2223. This is consistent with the broader galvanization-coverage reports above and suggests the pre-facelift generation may have had more complete factory galvanization than the restyle generation, though sample sizes are small.

Preventive measures: regular inspection of the tailgate corners and trim junctions; apply protective wax/sealant at trim junctions; monitor for trapped moisture under the chrome trim.

Broader galvanization assessment: main chassis protected but quality declined vs. Soviet-era process: the X80 body is described as selectively galvanized — the main chassis is protected, but doors, fenders, and the hood lack zinc coating (this conflicts with an earlier report above stating doors and hood ARE galvanized — may reflect generation differences or inconsistent assessments). Pre-facelift has better galvanization than facelift. Modern cold-galvanizing (per current TU/ТУ standard) is inferior in quality to the old Soviet hot-dip galvanizing process (per GOST/ГОСТ standard) — "market economy" is cited as the reason for the shift. Corrosion appears under chromed edges and at uncoated panel joints. For comparison: a Dongfeng AX7 suffered complete rust failure within just 2 years, despite marketing claims of "excellent body protection technology" tied to its being co-manufactured with Citroën in China — doors were repainted or fully replaced under warranty, and engine-bay-side hoods were uniformly brown (rusted) with no galvanization at all; the X80 by comparison appears to have at least some protection, even if reduced from earlier standards 24252627828293031323334353637.

Rear-door rust susceptibility — variation by color and assembly batch: rear door panels show rust issues on some units, with variation reported by both paint color and assembly factory (the Kaliningrad factory specifically mentioned). Brown-colored cars appear particularly prone to rust on panel edges and under chrome trim; white and red colors reportedly show better corrosion resistance. The issue may correlate with paint-adhesion quality or a material batch difference from manufacturing 383940414243. ⚠️ Conflict: the color/rust correlation is unclear — one owner (38730) reports no rust complaints on red cars, while another (38728) reports heavy rust on a brown car despite Kaliningrad assembly.

Roof added to the known non-galvanized panels; general paint-quality complaint: consistent with the tailgate/trunk-lid exception noted above, the roof is also reported as not galvanized on the X80 chassis — otherwise the chassis is galvanized. Separately, community reports indicate generally poor paint quality (ЛКП) as an ongoing issue affecting the vehicle. Options discussed for paint protection: liquid glass coating or vinyl wrap 444546.

Trunk door (5th door) interior weld corrosion — common failure point: rust around the trunk-button area on the inside of the trunk/5th door is a common X80 failure point, distinct from the tailgate-corner chrome-trim corrosion above. Location: interior welds where two body panels are joined together. Progression: rust first appears as a coating beneath the sealer, then spreads outward. Treatment option: inject Mowil (a rust-preventative product) into the interior seams from the inside. A full replacement fix requires cutting and re-gluing the window glass plus new moldings — which can themselves leak. Most FAW X80 owners reportedly experience this to some degree; by comparison, other Chinese-market cars in the same class (Geely Emgrand, Lifan) were reported as worse 474849505152535455.

Zinc coating coverage — roof and trunk lid confirmed NOT zinc-coated despite marketing claims (reinforcing report): further confirmation, consistent with the roof/trunk-lid exception noted above: the roof and baggage/trunk (5th door) are not zinc-coated on the X80, contrary to marketing claims — only the external side panels receive zinc coating. The hood, by contrast, is zinc-coated and shows visibly better rust resistance when exposed 56575859.

docs.title: Removing iron-oxide brake-dust spots from paint
docs.text:
Tags: #paint · #corrosion · #cleaning

Prices and suppliers on this page are Russian-market (RUB, at the dates shown). Verify locally before relying on them in Syria.

Some advice here concerns sub-zero winters and is less relevant in a hot climate.

Brake dust creates rust-colored iron-oxide particles that land on the paint and "bloom"/stain it from the outside — especially visible on white cars. First-time owners are often surprised by how bad it looks 1.

Routine cleaning: use an iron-oxide/tar remover spray — e.g. Grass Disk Cleaner Super, 600 ml, ~471 RUB (RU market, March 2025) — once a year, typically after winter. This is described as sufficient for normal buildup 123. A cheaper household alternative some owners use successfully is toilet-bowl cleaner ("Туалетный утёнок") applied as a chemical cleaner rather than physical scrubbing; avoid alcohol-based cleaning, which doesn't work as well 45.

For persistent/stubborn spots — rust converter: a stronger option is a rust-converter product (e.g. Zinkary, ~500 ml for ~471 RUB on Ozon, RU market, March 2025). Apply with gloves and a cotton swab, spot-treating only the affected areas — first degrease and dry the surface, then apply the converter/ lacquer, then wipe carefully. Work in dry, warm weather 36.

Safety warning — rust converter can damage paint if misapplied: one owner reported using a rust converter under the chrome trim on the hood of a previous car, then driving — airflow blew the still-wet liquid out from under the trim, and it left corrosive streaks running down the hood to the windshield and onto the trunk, eating into the clear coat/paint. Avoid contact with chrome trim and other delicate surfaces, and make sure the product is fully dry/cured before driving, especially near trim edges where wind can carry residual liquid 7891011.

docs.title: Plastic bumper repair — hot-air welding
docs.text:
Tags: #bumper

Damaged plastic bumpers (material: PP/ABS/PC/PUR) can be repaired without full replacement. Method: (1) degrease and clean the damage area; (2) cut a V-shaped groove along the crack; (3) use a hot-air tool (строительный фен, heat gun) with a flat electrode or a plastic rod matching the bumper's material; (4) weld both sides of the crack; (5) sand/grind the repair smooth; (6) repaint if needed. Correct material identification is required first — check the existing bumper's material marking. This method was successfully demonstrated on a KIA Rio PP bumper that lasted 7+ years afterward. Multiple mounting-point ("ushi"/lugs) breaks can also be repaired this way 12345.

docs.title: Front radiator grille — removal and reinstallation
docs.text:
Attachment. The front radiator grille attaches to the bumper with clips at the bottom and self-tapping screws at the top — a mixed fastening method, not clips-only or screws-only.123456789

Clearance. The distance from the radiator itself to the grille is approximately 10 cm.123456789

No special tools needed. The grille can be removed and reinstalled without special tools — release the bottom clips, then remove the top self-tapping screws (or vice versa when reinstalling).123456789

Real-world failure case. One owner's grille came loose (along with the bumper) after a front-end impact, since the clip attachment at the bottom is not a fully rigid connection — worth checking grille/bumper clip condition after any front collision even if damage looks minor.123

docs.title: Radiator grille — pricing and fitment
docs.text:
Tags: #price · #restyle · #cross-compatibility

Prices and suppliers on this page are Russian-market (RUB, at the dates shown). Verify locally before relying on them in Syria.

Restyle (facelift) grille pricing: an X80 restyle radiator grille costs approximately 12,000 RUB (RU market, January 2026) 1.

X40 grille — not a direct fit: the FAW X40's grille is cheaper (~6,000 RUB, RU market, January 2026), but it is not a direct fit on the X80 — the upper trim and bumper mounting points differ, risking fitment problems if substituted 234.

Pre-restyle grille — cheaper on the used market: a pre-restyle grille is much cheaper when sourced from Avito classifieds (used-parts listings) than buying new. It's physically similar in appearance to the restyle grille but structurally incompatible with restyle-model mounting points 234.

Visual differences between generations (how to tell them apart): (1) the restyle grille is more angular/blocky with a wider lower section due to the new bumper design, while the pre-restyle grille is narrower with a softer curve; (2) the restyle grille has 3–4 thick horizontal chrome bars versus a finer mesh/different chrome pattern on pre-restyle; (3) the restyle grille has a thicker chrome frame that connects to the headlight line as one unified design. Many Avito sellers incorrectly list X40 grilles under X80 part numbers — a side-by-side photo comparison shows the mislabeled X40 grille is visibly narrower than the genuine X80 restyle grille 56789101112131415. ⚠️ Conflict: buyers cannot rely on marketplace part-number labels alone — physical fitment must be verified before purchase, since sellers regularly confuse X40 and X80 grilles.

Changan Finix 35 grille — cross-model adaptation: a Changan Finix 35 grille can be adapted to fit the FAW Besturn X80 by trimming it to fit the X80 frame — the Finix grille naturally shares the same bend shape as the X80 frame from fender to fender. Custom welding may be required to mount it to the X80 frame 1617181920.

Radiator grille badge part numbers by facelift: the front radiator grille badge (with FAW lettering) has different part numbers by model year: pre-facelift (dorest) = 5CA051731; facelift (rest) = 5GA05173102. Owners report needing to replace it when cracked by road debris 2122. A Kitz Zapchasti listing for the front FAW Besturn X80 emblem, 5CA051731, was also linked in reply to a question about the front badge 23.

docs.title: Rear bumper trim — replacement process and part pricing
docs.text:
Tags: #bumper · #part-number · #price

Prices and suppliers on this page are Russian-market (RUB, at the dates shown). Verify locally before relying on them in Syria.

Replacement process: rear bumper damage often involves only the lower trim/overlay rather than the full bumper. Removal: (1) remove two bolts and screws holding the trim; (2) carefully detach the plastic clips using plastic trim tools (not metal, to avoid damage); (3) gently unclip from the remaining retaining fasteners. Heating the area with a fan or hot water can soften the plastic for easier clip release. Assess the damage carefully before ordering parts 1234567891011.

Part pricing (RU market, December 2024): lower decorative trim/overlay part 5CA05039116 — approximately 5,000 RUB; full rear bumper part 5CA050221AE1 — approximately 3,000–10,000 RUB depending on model year/condition; lower bumper section part 5CA150231A02 — variable pricing. Trim-overlay-only repairs cost ~5,000 RUB; full bumper replacement ranges ~3,000–10,000 RUB (RU market, December 2024) depending on damage extent. Check kit-zapchasti.ru for exact specifications and availability 11.

docs.title: Rear washer not spraying — troubleshooting
docs.text:
Symptom: the rear washer motor runs (audible) and the electrics test fine (fuses checked), but no fluid actually sprays from the rear nozzle 1.

Troubleshooting checklist, in the order the community recommends checking: 1. Confirm the washer-fluid reservoir actually has fluid in it 2. 2. Check whether a hose has disconnected somewhere in the line 23. 3. Check for a clogged/blocked nozzle 2. 4. Start with the cabin-to-door tube transition — inspect the tubing at the point where it crosses from the cabin into the door/tailgate for cracks; a cracked tube in this transition can leak all the washer fluid internally before it ever reaches the nozzle. Look for visible wet spots/stains as a diagnostic clue 34. 5. Alternatively, a tube may have simply popped off its connection at the transition or at the nozzle fitting, rather than being cracked — check both possibilities 4.

Recommended starting point: begin inspection at the cabin-to-door/tailgate transition area specifically, since that's the most commonly cited failure point for internal leaks in this system.

docs.title: Roof rails and cargo rack fitment
docs.text: CS35 Plus cargo racks can be fitted to the X80's roof rails, but they require modification: the X80 has a triangular roof-rail cross-section that does not match the standard rack mounts. One owner cut approximately 50mm and 80mm off the rack ends to get proper fitment, and recommends additional modification to improve mounting security beyond the basic cut. Cosmetic downside: the protruding mount covers look unfinished after the modification 1.

docs.title: Roof rack load capacity — rating vs. real use
docs.text:
Tags: #price · #conflict

Prices and suppliers on this page are Russian-market (RUB, at the dates shown). Verify locally before relying on them in Syria.

Community members disagree on this topic — both positions are reported.

Factory rating: a dealership told one owner the maximum roof load is 30 kg 12. This is echoed for crossbars separately, with a factory spec of roughly 50–60 kg for crossbar-mounted loads 3.

Conflict — real-world use well above the factory number: multiple owners report routinely carrying much more without issue: 60 kg cargo box 4, ~80 kg of boards 5, and up to "100 kg, load confidently" per community consensus, while avoiding sharp cornering above that load 6. On Ozon reviews for aftermarket crossbars, owners report 95+ kg in personal use, with some reviews describing 100–110 kg carried without problems 7. The dealership's conservative 30 kg figure is likely set for liability reasons rather than reflecting a hard mechanical limit.

Recommendation: stay under ~100 kg total load, avoid high-speed operation (roughly 130 km/h or less), drive slowly/cautiously with a large load ("very slowly and not far" was one report for long 6-metre items) 8, and brake/corner gradually since the load raises and shifts the centre of gravity.

Aftermarket crossbars — sourcing and pricing: aluminum crossbars from Chinese sellers on Ozon run about 3,300 RUB with ~1 month delivery, or about 4,500 RUB with faster Russian-domestic shipping (2025 prices) 910.

Roof panel flexibility — separate from crossbar load-capacity question: distinct from crossbar/rack ratings above, the X80's roof panel itself is notably flexible and soft, bending noticeably under moderate weight. Concern was raised about roof strength specifically under roof-rack loads, but reports indicate a light cargo item (e.g. a ~40 kg boat) with a properly-attached rack causes no visible damage. Not recommended for concentrated point loads or for standing/climbing on the roof 1112131415.

docs.title: Rustproofing materials — Pushsalo vs. Movil
docs.text:
Tags: #corrosion

Pushsalo (пушсало): does not fully harden/cure — stays soft/tacky indefinitely. Consequence: attracts and accumulates dust, which eventually falls off, and the coating can visibly leak/drip if the car sits in hot sun. Lasts roughly 2 years maximum before needing reapplication. Best suited for hidden cavities and subframe/tube areas rather than exposed panels 12345. No strong odor reported, though one owner noted a mild smell that fades over time and isn't noticeable with the AC running 6.

Movil (Мовиль): hardens/cures, giving longer-lasting protection than Pushsalo. Recommended specifically for door cavities and other hidden body cavities — one owner cautioned it should be used only there and not on broader panel areas 7. A zinc-enriched Movil formulation ("состав мовили с цинком") is described as especially effective ("ядерная вещь" — extremely potent) — apply carefully and wipe off excess immediately, since cured residue becomes very difficult to remove later 89101112. Because the X80's rocker panels/sills, underhood area, and lower door interiors are already sealed with factory sealant, Movil can also be applied to sills, under the hood, and inside door bottoms 7.

For visible/exposed areas (wheel arches, rocker panel bottoms): use a formulation with rubber/caoutchouc content rather than plain Movil or Pushsalo — described as the underside/arch/sill spec 13. If the body is free of existing corrosion, a dedicated anticorrosive spray product (brand mentioned: BODY) is preferred over pushsalo for those areas 14.

If corrosion is already present: don't just coat over it. Recommended process: clean/strip the rusted area properly first, apply an epoxy primer, then apply anticorrosive spray-can coating and let it fully dry — coating over unaddressed rust is not durable 15.

Interior cavity treatment and existing corrosion: applying vibration- damping sheets under the seams plus sound-deadening ("шумка") on top works well on a new (rust-free) car. If corrosion is already present, this combination is largely pointless and short-lived — the rust needs to be 100% eliminated first, only then does sound-deadening/vibration treatment make sense 16.

Sound-deadening substrate prep — same principle as above, restated: a separate, later report reinforces the same point independently: applying sound-deadening material ("шумка") improves comfort but requires proper substrate preparation — apply an epoxy primer to bare metal first, then apply the sound-deadening on top. Applying sound-deadening directly to cold, bare/unprimed metal causes adhesion failure and rust to develop underneath the material over time 17.

docs.title: Side mirror assembly — folding motor failure
docs.text:
Tags: #mirror · #part-number · #price

Prices and suppliers on this page are Russian-market (RUB, at the dates shown). Verify locally before relying on them in Syria.

Some advice here concerns sub-zero winters and is less relevant in a hot climate.

Part number and pricing: left mirror part number 5CA16918X#E1, listed on kitparts.ru. A full replacement mirror is expensive — a new complete mirror costs around 20,000 RUB (RU market, May 2025) 12.

Motorized folding failure — worn plastic gears: the power-fold mechanism fails when its internal plastic gears wear down and develop play/slop. Symptoms: a loud grinding/whirring noise ("вжик") followed by complete failure of the fold function. One owner's mirror worked normally all winter, then stopped folding once the weather warmed up — suggesting temperature/lubrication-related wear can surface seasonally rather than failing gradually and predictably. A repair kit for the gears is mentioned as existing, but a full mirror-assembly replacement is often more practical than attempting a gear-level repair 34.

Disabling automatic mirror folding in winter: to stop mirrors from auto-folding in cold weather, two approaches are reported: Option A — cut the motor wire inside the connector (the same connector controls both heating and the fold motor, so identify the correct wire carefully); Option B — install an alarm system (e.g. StarLine A63), which prevents the automatic folding behavior as a side effect. If folding isn't disabled, a workaround is to apply silicone spray regularly to the folding mechanism and to activate the heated mirrors before arriving at the destination, to prevent ice buildup from locking the fold mechanism. One owner reports using a StarLine A63 alarm with no folding issues 567891011121314.

Left mirror fails to fold only in cold weather: separate report — the left mirror fails to fold when locking the car with the factory alarm specifically in cold/fall weather, but works reliably in warm seasons, consistent with the thermal/lubrication wear pattern above. Likely thermal contraction affecting the motor mechanism; debris in the gears can also prevent folding in some cases, and manual disassembly + cleaning may restore function temporarily 1516171819. Conflict: one owner reports the opposite seasonal pattern — folding works only in summer and stops once autumn begins 18, while another reports the reverse of that too 19 — the temperature relationship is not consistent across cars.

Trick to prevent mirrors from auto-folding when locking (no disassembly): stand at the center of the car, press the lock button on the driver door with one hand while simultaneously opening the rear door with the other hand, then close the rear door quickly to catch the moment before the lock completes — this consistently prevents the mirrors from folding on both left and right sides, without cutting any wires or disassembling anything. The trick was discovered by accident (a rear-door passenger closed the door right as the driver locked the car) and confirmed to work by repeating it several times 2021222324. Conflict: one user reports this trick only works in winter, suggesting a possible temperature or mechanical sensitivity 25.

Disabling automatic mirror folding on door lock: the door-interrupt method (Алексей: works; Konstantin: asks how to reverse it) and the battery-disconnect method with its re-enable steps are described in [Electric mirror adjustment — disable methods]](../body-exterior/electric-mirror-control-disable.md) 26272829.

Mirror-element disassembly for internal repair (left mirror): to service the mirror internals: pry the mirror glass element gently with plastic tools (not metal) from the edges, working in a warm environment (~room temperature) to protect the fragile plastic. The core assembly is held by two hex-torx screws under the mirror element; plastic liftoff tools are needed to separate the plastic housing, and the assembly must be rotated carefully — protective clips hold it together and require delicate separation. After accessing the interior, disconnect the heating wires and the turn-signal-repeater bulb, then reassemble in reverse. This job benefits from a 2-person team and prior experience; cold temperatures make the plastic brittle, so use a heat source or a warm garage. Replacing just the repeater bulb element is the most common repair; a full mirror replacement is often cheaper than attempting an internal mechanism repair 30313233343536373839404142434445. ⚠️ Note: the reporting author mentions photo evidence of this repair was later deleted, and recommends less-experienced DIYers use a professional service given the fragile plastic and complex clip system.

Turn-signal repeater bulb replacement — requires internal mirror- element removal: replacing the turn-signal repeater bulb inside the side mirror requires removing the mirror glass element from the inside — it cannot be accessed from outside only. The snap fasteners holding things together are delicate and risk breaking. Recommended to do the job in a warm garage with two people, or via professional help. Parts (including for older/20-year-old X80s) are readily available through auto-parts catalogs 464748495051525354. Separately, the mirror's turn-signal repeater bulb itself can be replaced without excessive difficulty once the back panel is removed — again best done in a warm environment to avoid cracking brittle cold plastic; parts available from Chinese suppliers (Kitzip/Kitparts) and Russian retailers 555657.

Electric mirrors unresponsive in cold or on low battery: side mirrors may fold or freeze in position (fail to respond to the fold/ unfold control) when battery voltage is low or in extreme cold. Fixes: (1) manually assist the mirror fold/unfold gently, without forcing it; (2) spray WD-40 under the mirror-housing access hatch; (3) restore full battery charge. Mirrors typically recover normal function once the car warms up and battery power is restored 58596061626364656667686970.

Auto-fold ratchet sometimes fails to fully latch: separately from the gear-wear failure above, owners report the power mirrors' automatic fold/unfold function sometimes doesn't latch fully — one or both mirrors fold or extend only partially, with the internal ratchet mechanism failing to catch completely. This affects convenience rather than safety. The auto-fold function itself cannot be easily disabled without removing interior panels and disconnecting the wiring harness (see [the disable methods card]](../body-exterior/electric-mirror-control-disable.md) for the battery-disconnect method) 717273.

Turn-signal repeater removal — detailed step-by-step: repair procedure for a failed side-mirror turn-signal repeater (повторитель поворота), most often caused by corrosion: (1) remove the mirror completely from the door; (2) at home, in a warm environment, press the bottom of the mirror element to create a gap at the top, then grip and pull the mirror element toward you to release its retaining clips; (3) carefully pry off the painted protective cap; (4) unscrew the micro-bolts to access the repeater element; (5) replace the repeater bulb/LED. Alternative first step: check the power supply at the door-panel connector before disassembling, in case the fault is wiring rather than the bulb itself. The assembly is delicate — the mirror element can crack if forced 747576777879.

Turn-signal repeater — sealed unit, part 5DA069182, and mirror-clip removal trick: separately, the mirror turn-signal repeater/side-marker light is confirmed to be a sealed, non-repairable unit — the entire repeater assembly (not just the bulb) must be replaced if it fails. Left-side part number: 5DA069182, priced from 2,745 RUB (RU market, March 2026) at autonomia.pro (the cheapest source found by one owner). Mirror removal tip: the mirror housing is held by clips — gently heat it first to soften the clips, then insert fingers into the gap that opens at the top of the mirror and pull outward 808182838485868788.

Pre-facelift mirror part numbers — mirror element vs. full assembly: for pre-facelift (дорест) cars, the mirror element only part number is 5CA16912Z; the full mirror assembly with housing (left side) is 5CA56918X. When buying a used mirror on Avito, verify condition carefully before purchase — some listed units are fire-damaged (from heated-mirror wiring faults) 89909192.

Mirror folding asymmetry is by design, not a defect: multiple owners report the mirrors don't fold symmetrically — the right mirror fully retracts while the left mirror doesn't fully close. Community analysis concludes this is not a defect: the mirrors are mounted at different initial angles, and when both fold through the same uniform rotation angle, the asymmetry naturally persists. This affects both pre-facelift and facelift models 9394959697.

Driver's mirror element removal — screwdriver tab-release trick: to remove the driver's-side mirror element (glass/element only, not the whole housing): rotate the mirror element to the right (or left) to expose the mounting tab, then use a thin, long screwdriver to press on that tab and carefully pop the element free. This is a quick technique for addressing a loose or rattling mirror element without a full disassembly 9899.

docs.title: Sill and hatch paint blistering — sandblast repair
docs.text:
Tags: #paint · #corrosion

Symptom: owners report paint blistering ("цветение") on the rear hatch and on the sills (порог), with rust underneath the trim. One owner took the cladding (накладка) off the door-edge area and found weld spatter and corrosion beneath it, which he blames on poor factory processing; a photo shows a grey sill with the trim strip removed, several blisters and two rust holes around the door-slot cut-outs 12. His rear hatch also bubbled, and he repainted it after a dent 2. Another owner had paint chips plus a number plate fitted wrongly so that it rubbed through the paint, and sent two sills and the hatch for painting 34. See also galvanization and panel corrosion and baggage-compartment and door-trim rust.

DIY repair (sandblast and zinc): the first owner stripped the blistered paint by sandblasting with a compressor and a blasting gun (bought about two years earlier for another car), warning that a lot of abrasive still flies around 56. He then applied a zinc coating (цинкование) on the bare spots as a temporary measure and planned to prime the next day 78. The photo shows a sill after blasting, with the bare spots coated in pale grey zinc, not yet primed or painted 7.

docs.title: Lower sill protectors — removal and clips
docs.text:
Tags: #clips · #corrosion · #part-number

Prices and suppliers on this page are Russian-market (RUB, at the dates shown). Verify locally before relying on them in Syria.

Lower sill protectors on the X80 can be removed for cleaning/inspection. Attachment: (1) clips along the sides of the sill — Mazda-compatible replacement clips are available on Ozon; (2) screws underneath the front and rear wheel-arch areas 12.

What to expect underneath: upon removal, expect accumulated dirt and point/spot rust (oxidation) on the sill surface hidden by the protector — one owner who removed theirs found noticeable grime plus spot corrosion starting. This indicates the sills should be periodically inspected and treated (rust conversion/protective coating) rather than assumed clean just because they're covered 345.

Recommendation: inspect sill protectors periodically for moisture accumulation underneath and clean/treat as needed, rather than leaving them installed indefinitely without a check.

Sill corrosion bubble — a common durability issue on 2019+ models (sand-scratch mechanism): especially on 2019+ model years, corrosion bubbles develop on the driver's door sill (lower door edge where the door meets the rocker panel). Root-cause mechanism: sand/debris gets trapped under the factory paint finish and scratches the coating; salt water and moisture then penetrate through those scratches, causing corrosion from the inside out. The corrosion bubble expands yearly if left untreated. A secondary location for the same failure mode: the trunk-lid corner near the rear fender (also observed on a 2019 model). Repair sequence: remove paint/corrosion down to bare metal, apply a zinc coating (hot-dip galvanizing is most effective), then acid-etch primer, acrylic primer, and topcoat 67891011.

Body panel corrosion under the rear-door sill trim (related report): corrosion also develops specifically under the trim/molding of the rear door sills (the bottom edge of rear doors), creating rust spots that become visible from outside once the molding is removed or lifts. This is a known issue affecting multiple vehicles — when examining a used X80, inspect under the molding, not just the visible painted surface 121314151617.

Factory sill protective film — inconsistent application (a manufacturing-quality gap): the factory-applied protective film on door sills (пороги), intended to prevent scratches and rust, was found to be present on most doors but missing specifically on the driver's-side door sill on some units — resulting in visible rust/discoloration (orange/brown spots) exactly where the film wasn't applied. Multiple owners independently reported the same driver-side-only gap, pointing to a manufacturing quality-control inconsistency rather than an isolated defect 1819.

docs.title: Splashguard/mudguard installation
docs.text:
Tags: #diy

Aftermarket splashguard/mudguard kits include a metal bracket that attaches to the fender well, secured with self-tapping screws (саморез).1234567

A first-time installer needed clarification on the fastening method because the fender-well opening felt loose and didn't seem to give the screw anything solid to bite into. The clarified procedure: the metal bracket clips/mounts onto the wheel-well liner (подкрылок), and the self-tapping screw goes through the bracket into that liner — the bracket itself is what provides the anchor point, not the bare fender opening.867910

docs.title: Sticker removal from glass — no-heat methods
docs.text:
Tags: #windshield · #glass

Two effective methods for removing stickers/decals from windshield or other glass without using heat: (1) anti-sticker spray (Антискотч brand) — spray it on and wait a few minutes, then the sticker/adhesive lifts off easily; (2) blade-scraper method — a razor/blade scraper works safely on glass because glass is harder than the steel blade, so it won't scratch the surface. For large stickers, the spray method is considered safer to avoid any scratching risk 12345.

docs.title: Tailgate hinge rust on new vehicles
docs.text:
Tags: #corrosion · #warranty

A 2020-model X80 with only 19,000 km developed rust on the tailgate hinges, particularly reported on white-colored vehicles — white paint appears more susceptible to rust formation at this spot. Fix/prevention: apply a zinc-based treatment followed by a Movil (Mövil) protective coating to the hinges; preventative maintenance is reported to extend hinge life by 2+ years. Tailgate repainting is covered under warranty when the rust is reported to the dealer 1234.

docs.title: Tow hitch — certification status and installation
docs.text:
Tags: #towing · #legal · #part-number · #conflict

Prices and suppliers on this page are Russian-market (RUB, at the dates shown). Verify locally before relying on them in Syria.

Community members disagree on this topic — both positions are reported.

The X80 owner's manual states towing is NOT RECOMMENDED (not explicitly prohibited). The car is not certified for trailer use per the manufacturer's ID plate — the towing-load line is left blank. The AUPA (CVT/automatic) transmission is not rated for towing per some reports. Recommended load: under 200 kg of cargo, though practical users report carrying 200–300 kg periodically without issues 1234.

Installation: the Sheriff model 3951.12 tow hitch is available aftermarket; installation requires cutting/modifying the gray plastic bumper cover — there is no OEM pre-drilled bumper mount, so the bumper must be removed for fitment 567.

Legal status in Russia: installing an unapproved tow hitch voids some warranties; traffic police may require inspection/certification. Some owners have installed one after the warranty period expired without issues 8910.

Conflict: the manual says towing is NOT RECOMMENDED; some owners interpret this as "not prohibited" and install a hitch anyway. There is also a transmission debate — one user claims the AUPA transmission is not certified for towing, while another notes that American-market AUPA-equipped cars tow routinely. General recommendation from the thread: assume the unofficial mod voids warranty, and install at your own risk, ideally after the guarantee period ends 278.

Tow-hook installation — manual and automatic transmissions: a tow hook can be installed on both manual and automatic-transmission X80s. Installation takes roughly 2 hours: it requires removing the bumper and replacing the stock bumper reinforcer with the tow-hook unit; a coordination/adapter module must also be installed for the electrical connections (lights). Both manual and automatic owners report successful installs, though some recommend not towing heavy loads on the automatic 1112131415.

Sheriff 3951.12 — capacity and suppliers: the Sheriff 3951.12 tow hitch for the FAW Besturn X80 offers 1.2-ton capacity. Available from multiple retailers including OZON (ozon.ru) and specialized tow-hitch (farkop) suppliers. Installation by the owner is feasible given basic mechanical ability 1617.

Sheriff 3951.12 — professional install confirmed: a Sheriff 3951.12 tow hitch was installed by a specialist installer (ES-FARKOP.RU, professional tow-hitch installation service) and confirmed as a fitting option for the X80 181920.

⚠️ Conflict — does installation require bumper removal? A separate report describes the Sheriff 3951.12 fitting into the factory mounting points without modifying the vehicle body, with no bumper removal required — only unclipping the bumper's lower section — and states the supplier provided a factory certificate confirming no structural changes were made. This directly contradicts the installation note above (which describes cutting/modifying the bumper cover with no pre-drilled OEM mount). The discrepancy may reflect different hitch models, model years, or installer technique; verify with your specific kit/installer before assuming either method 2122232425.

Tow hitch reduces ground clearance: an owner with a tow hitch installed reports less comfortable off-road driving due to reduced ground clearance — the vehicle scrapes on uneven terrain where it previously cleared without the hitch fitted. This is noted as a known trade-off of aftermarket hitch installation 26.

Manufacturer's passport sheet for article 3951.12: the Russian passport sheet shared for the X80 hitch (тягово-сцепное устройство, ТСУ — towing hitch) lists a permitted total trailer mass of 1,200 kg, a vertical load on the ball (вертикальная нагрузка на шар) of 50 kg and a net weight of 16.07 kg, for cars built from 2013. The hitch is stated to comply with GOST 28248-89, OST 37.001.299-93 and TU 4591-001-64264699-2012, with a 12-month warranty from the date of sale 18. Its installation steps are: (1) remove the bumper; (2) trim the bumper to the cut diagram "Рис. А" (cut dimensions 60, 100 and 210 mm); (3) remove the bumper reinforcement (усилитель бампера); (4) install brackets "18"; (5) join brackets "17" and "16" to brackets "18"; (6) attach the bar (штанга) "1" to the brackets; (7) trim the bumper to fit; (8) fit the hook (крюк) and the socket box (подрозетник); (9) wire the electrical equipment 18. This sheet calls for removing and trimming the bumper, so it supports the first installation note above rather than the no-removal report 18.

Fastener torque from the same sheet: the parts list uses DIN bolts M8x30, M10x30, M12x1.25x40 and M12x1.25x70. Tightening torque by thread: M6x1.0 = 9.8 N·m; M8x1.25 = 24.0 N·m; M10x1.5 = 47.0 N·m; M12x1.75 = 81.0 N·m; M16x2 = 157.0 N·m. The table gives M12 as 1.75 pitch while the parts list uses M12x1.25 bolts, so check the pitch on the actual hardware before torquing 18.

docs.title: Towing capacity — factory status unclear
docs.text:
Tags: #towing

Not factory-rated for towing. The FAW X80 is not factory-rated for towing a trailer. One owner (Victor) checked the door-jamb weight-specification plate and found no towing capacity listed, confirming towing was not part of the OEM design requirements12.

Aftermarket tow bar — unapproved modification. Installing any aftermarket tow bar — regardless of whether one is available on the market — would constitute a non-approved modification outside the manufacturer's specifications, since no factory towing capacity exists to engineer against12.

Real-world experience — significant power loss under load on hills. Consistent with the "not factory-rated for towing" finding above, one owner reports a concrete experience of the performance cost: significant power loss under load, especially on uphill grades. Without a trailer, the car can hold 4th gear on a hill it's climbing; with roughly 350kg of load, it can only manage 3rd gear. The vehicle clearly feels the performance degradation with added weight — a real-world illustration of why towing/heavy loading isn't factory-supported3.

docs.title: Trailer hitch installation cost and legal status
docs.text:
Tags: #price · #legal

Prices and suppliers on this page are Russian-market (RUB, at the dates shown). Verify locally before relying on them in Syria.

Trailer hitch cost: 8,600–9,500 RUB (via Ozon; RU market, July 2025) 12. Wiring harness with control module: 1,800 RUB (RU market, July 2025) 3. Professional installation labor: 5,000 RUB (RU market, as of July 2025) 45.

Legal note: the hitch is not certified in the vehicle's OTTS registration, so owners may face a 500 RUB fine (RU market, July 2025) and a 10-day removal order from traffic police; enforcement varies significantly by region and individual officer — some tolerate it entirely, and one owner reported driving 10 years with an unapproved trailer hitch without any issues 678.

Conflict: legal tolerance varies widely — some officers fine and issue removal orders, others overlook it completely; one owner successfully avoided a fine on a different vehicle by showing stamped installation paperwork 910.

Installation cost (St. Petersburg, RU market, April 2026): A Sheriff-brand tow hitch was installed for 22,000 RUB all-in (about 3 hours of labor); the owner has tested it towing a trailer 11121314. Note on trailer registration: when the trailer's previous owner has since died, registering the inherited trailer becomes bureaucratically complicated — check local regulations before assuming a straightforward transfer 11.

Earlier community thread on legal status (2024): The X80 was never certified for tow-hitch (ТСУ) installation under Chinese or Russian type-approval, but many owners install aftermarket hitches anyway 1516. Enforcement is inconsistent by region: traffic stops in Tolyatti, Chelyabinsk, and Vologda resulted in no citation even when officers noticed the hitch 17, while Irkutsk is reported as actively enforcing the prohibition 18. One community tip: if there's no fire extinguisher in the car, officers are more likely to dig further and notice the hitch; if a fire extinguisher is present, they reportedly tend not to bother checking 19.

docs.title: Trunk chrome trim — clips and water sealing
docs.text:
Tags: #trunk · #clips · #water-ingress · #part-number

Prices and suppliers on this page are Russian-market (RUB, at the dates shown). Verify locally before relying on them in Syria.

Some advice here concerns sub-zero winters and is less relevant in a hot climate.

Rear window trim clip removal technique: to remove the rear window trim (the plastic accumulation strip along the glass edge): pry down from the top clips first — the trim is held by two steel spring clips on each side. Pull/twist each clip outward, against the window-frame direction, to disengage it. Clips can break if forced incorrectly 1234.

Water intrusion into the trunk from broken chrome-molding clips: water accumulates in the trunk, collecting 3+ liters overnight after rain. Root cause: broken clip-fasteners (клипсы) on the chrome molding fail to grip the rubber weatherstripping to the door, letting water flow under the chrome trim. Fixes, from most to least permanent: (1) permanent — replace the chrome molding with a new one that includes replacement clips; (2) temporary — seal the clip-fastener holes with sealant; (3) experimental — substitute similar Geely clips if available. Note: glass sealing is not the source — the window is glued with a lap-joint design; water collects under the glass and flows through the broken clip holes into the trunk 56789101112. ⚠️ Conflict: some community members proposed the water enters via the glass seal or under-door paths, but Victor's video evidence and analysis indicate the primary source is the broken clip-fasteners, not the glass seal.

Trunk weatherstrip compatibility issues: a trunk weatherstrip seal purchased online (likely via Ozon) showed a design mismatch with the X80's rear-door gap — the strip is wider than the gap and its narrow edges don't sit flush. Users advise caution; previous attempts on other vehicles failed due to water/snow delamination. Alternative approach: install an aerodynamic spoiler to redirect water spray away from the rear glass instead of relying on the aftermarket weatherstrip 13141516171819202122. ⚠️ Conflict: users disagree on weatherstrip effectiveness — some claim glued seals hold for a year, others report immediate delamination under winter conditions.

Rear hatch chrome trim: OEM clips unavailable separately: the chrome decorative trim under the rear hatch window glass has factory-proprietary clips that are not sold as separate parts and have no aftermarket alternative. Repair requires replacing the entire OEM assembly (part 5CA050940) with its integrated clips, at around 2,400 RUB (RU market, November 2025). Water can accumulate if the old trim is reused instead of being fully replaced. Supplier: Vedro.pro 232425262728.

Chrome trim sealing — roofing sealant application: to prevent water leaks on chrome trim after replacement, apply a bituminous roofing sealant (standard roofing type, not the bitumen-additive version) along the seal between the glass and the body 29303132.

Trunk lock-surround overlay clips — part numbers: the trunk lock surround overlay (накладка на багажнике) uses 8mm automotive plastic clips. Part numbers: FC016888502 (plastic fixer/фиксатор пластиковый) or FQC00156392 (plastic piston/пистон пластиковый). Generic 8mm clips are also available on Ozon and other retailers; exact FAW part numbers may vary by batch 33343536.

Detaching trim piece — adhesive fix and timing: a common trim piece (~2,000 RUB part, RU market, February 2026) that falls off. Solutions reported: Cosmofene super glue, window-glass sealant (one owner reports it lasting 4 years), or a Cosmofene + baking soda mixture applied with a syringe needle for precision. It's recommended to wait for warm weather (above 0°C) rather than attempting the repair in cold conditions 373839404142.

Rear chrome molding corrosion — full removal and repaint procedure: the chromium-plated trim below the rear window (rear/5th-door edge) corrodes from the inside out due to trapped water/moisture under the molding clips, visible as brown/rust spots on the outer surface. Repair procedure: (1) carefully pry off the molding by unclipping the plastic snap-fit fasteners (a Nissan clip, part 909901KA0B or similar, sold in 10-packs on Ozon, is a possible substitute — true FAW clip availability is low; note two clips often break during removal, as they're fragile); (2) clean rust stains off the surface with a wire brush or diamond pad, removing loose oxidation; (3) apply acid-etch primer (2 coats, allow full inter-coat drying per label instructions — skipping drying time or applying coats too thick means the whole primer job must be redone); (4) apply acrylic/polyurethane top coat (3 coats), sanding between coats for a smooth finish; (5) reinstall the molding with fresh clips, using silicone/sealant at the joint to prevent water re-entry. Material sequence: clean → acid-etch primer (2×) → acrylic primer (3×) → top-coat color — do not skip the acid-etch step. Early-stage corrosion (small spots on an intact shiny surface) is easier to fix than advanced corrosion (where the paint has already bubbled). The molding itself can also be sourced used from Avito/drom.ru, typically 2,000+ RUB for molding plus clips together 43444546474849505152535455565758596061626364656667686970. A member warns that this clip needs firm pressing in and a sealant, otherwise water gets into the trunk 7172.

Water intrusion under rear-door molding — perpetually wet foam pads: separate from the clip-hole leak path above, the foam rubber pads positioned under the rear-door molding stay perpetually wet due to the drainage design, causing localized corrosion ("кариес" — cavities). One community member's planned fix: add 1mm rubber gaskets plus transparent sealant to improve moisture management. This affects vehicles at various ages and needs preventive attention 73747576.

Water leaking through the top gap of the trunk lid: a separate leak path — water entering the trunk through gaps at the upper edge of the trunk lid, distinct from the clip-hole path above. Fix: apply a black waterproofing sealant (construction-grade, the type used for gutters) along the upper gap of the trunk lid. The owner initially tried sealing under the molding first, which was ineffective, and only found success once sealing the top gap specifically. Water was also entering through side-molding perforations and soaking the spare tire — up to 1 liter of water after a rain event 7778798081.

Factory drain-gutter redesign — some production runs fixed this: a factory modification changed the trunk drain gutter/channel (патрубок слива) at some point in production. Owners of newer X80s report this updated design does not suffer from water accumulation in the trunk after rain, suggesting an engineering fix was implemented. The exact change/cutoff point is unclear, but the fix appears effective where present 8283.

Water ingress in trunk and side cargo pockets (unresolved, low confidence): water seeps into the trunk and side cargo pockets during rain or car washing; source not identified — requires further investigation to locate and seal the specific entry point(s) 84.

docs.title: Trunk floor reinforcement using plywood (DIY)
docs.text:
Tags: #trunk · #diy

The factory trunk floor is weak and can sag or crack under load, especially in the area over the spare wheel well — an owner asked the community how others had reinforced it.1

DIY fix. Cut a sheet of 18mm plywood to the shape/perimeter of the trunk floor (matching the spare-wheel area specifically, since that's where the floor gives way) and lay it in as a reinforcement layer over the factory floor.23 This is a simple, commonly-done modification among X80 owners that prevents floor deformation under cargo weight.23

Counter-report — plywood also cracked: another owner's original trunk floor panel over the spare-wheel well cracked in two places; he replaced it with plywood, and the plywood cracked too. The video shows the trunk with the spare-wheel well (red plastic cover), tools and a tyre 456. A single sheet over the well may therefore not be enough on its own; consider a thicker or supported panel.

docs.title: Trunk latch/lock — diagnosis and replacement
docs.text:
Tags: #trunk · #part-number · #alarm

Prices and suppliers on this page are Russian-market (RUB, at the dates shown). Verify locally before relying on them in Syria.

Some advice here concerns sub-zero winters and is less relevant in a hot climate.

Symptom — trunk won't lock when the alarm is armed, but opens fine by button while armed: first try wiggling the latch's small mechanical "flag" lever — sometimes it just needs to be moved to seat correctly. If that doesn't fix it, the latch needs replacing. A physical knock on the left side of the latch was reported to "temporarily" force it closed as a workaround, but is not a fix 12345. As a temporary measure until parts arrive, some owners tie the trunk lid closed with a strap to stop it popping open over bumps 6. Wiring corrosion from cabin/trunk moisture can also cause this fault — check and clean the contacts under the driver's seat, since one owner's identical symptom turned out to be a dirty connector in that harness, not the latch itself 7.

Replacement part source: a direct replacement trunk latch (замок двери задка) is available at kitzap.ru, plus other Russian parts suppliers 8. On the restyle-2020 trunk latch specifically, one owner reported difficulty getting the part through official dealers after two units failed; a Lada Granta trunk latch was used as a compatible substitute, though the Granta part lacks the electric actuator, so remote/button release from the alarm does not work with it — manual key/mechanical release only 910.

Trunk-button (electric opener) troubleshooting sequence: if the trunk's electric-open button (электрический открыватель) stops working: (1) test the button with a multimeter for continuity — press the button and check for continuity/tone; if it passes, the button itself is fine; (2) check the connector (фишка) for oxidation/corrosion and clean it with fine abrasive (sandpaper) if needed; (3) if the connector is corroded, try bridging it with a jumper wire to see if the lock mechanism responds; (4) inspect the wiring inside the trunk's corrugated conduit (гофра) for breaks, especially where the conduit enters the trunk opening; (5) check all relevant fuses for continuity. If all of the above check out, replace the connector or wiring harness. Note: the factory lock mechanism has built-in travel limits and fuse protection 11121314151617181920212223242526272829303132333435363738.

Trunk-button alternatives and common failure point: two additional data points on trunk-button reliability: (1) a Lada (ВАЗ) 2110 trunk-open button works as a mechanical/budget alternative if the OEM button fails outright; (2) the connector-with-wire (фишка с проводом) is a frequent failure point on the X80's trunk-button circuit specifically — consistent with the connector-corrosion troubleshooting step above. OEM trunk buttons are available from dealers (one community member keeps stock in his shop); the Lada alternative is positioned as a budget/emergency option rather than a long-term fix 3940414243444546.

Cleaning oxidized trunk-button contacts — often a permanent fix: an intermittent trunk lock button (inconsistent open/close) was resolved by carefully disassembling the button, cleaning the green oxidized contacts with electrical contact cleaner and contact conditioner — contacts returned to normal operation. This avoided needing to replace the entire assembly and can be a permanent fix, not just a temporary one. If replacement does become necessary, a complete handle+button unit is available on AliExpress for ~3,000 RUB (RU market, August 2025)

47484950.

Trunk lock repair via full contact cleaning (earlier, corroborating report): another owner independently reports the same permanent-fix approach: when the trunk lock becomes inoperable/unreliable, disassembly and cleaning restores function — (1) remove the trim panel; (2) disconnect all connectors on the lock assembly; (3) remove the mounting hardware; (4) clean all electrical contacts; (5) reassemble and reconnect. After cleaning, the lock becomes reliable again, though it may still occasionally need multiple attempts before consistent operation returns. Intermittent trunk-lock failure is a recurring symptom that this cleaning procedure resolves 515253.

Trunk door sensor shows "open" when the door is actually closed: separate fault from the latch/button issues above — the trunk-door sensor (distinct from the latch mechanism itself, which works fine) reports the door as open on the dash even when it's closed. Diagnostic steps used in the community: (1) close the latch while the trunk is open and check whether the sensor responds; (2) try mechanically forcing/snapping the sensor closed with a flat tool (e.g. a screwdriver) to see if the reading changes; (3) check whether the sensor is normally-closed or normally-open with the door shut, since this affects how to interpret its readings; (4) inspect for a loosened sensor body behind the trim, or wire breakage inside the harness 545556575859606162.

Trunk door sensor diagnostic — isolate sensor vs. wiring/ECU by unplugging it: to further isolate the fault, remove the latch and unplug the sensor's connector completely. If the dashboard still shows "open" with the connector unplugged, the fault is in the wiring harness or ECU logic, not the sensor itself; if the indicator changes state when the connector is unplugged, the sensor or latch mechanism itself is at fault 636465.

Trunk door lock — part number 5CA162310A, Granta cross-compatibility: FAW Besturn X80 rear/trunk door lock part number is 5CA162310A, available at kitzap.ru. Cross-compatibility confirmed with the Lada Granta rear door lock, though it requires modification to fit (see below) 66. The same lock is listed for the Bestune X80 by a parts shop as the tailgate (задка) door lock in October 2025 67.

Granta door lock modification for X80 fitment: a Lada Granta rear door lock fits the X80 mechanically but needs adaptation: (1) file down the lock's "dog"/locking pin (using a file/rasp — "напильник") so it doesn't interfere with surrounding parts; (2) install two M6 bolts as spacers to achieve proper alignment and prevent the lock rattling against the plastic trim. During installation you'll notice the "собачка" (lock pawl) interferes with fitment — that's expected and is what the filing step addresses 68697071.

Electric trunk lock total failure — wiring diagnostic and alternate Granta part number: separately, a complete electric trunk-lock failure (no clicking sound, hazard-light indicator blinks, neither the button nor the remote works — only the manual release lever functions) was traced to a possible broken wire inside the rubber hose/grommet routing the harness to the trunk; check that wiring first. A Lada Granta trunk latch assembly, part 21900560601010 (~2,000 RUB, RU market, January 2026), was used as a working replacement — consistent with the Granta cross-compatibility noted above, though under a different catalog number. Installation notes: the electrical connector pins are fragile and bend easily when mating the connector, and the plastic lock lever/pawl may need filing to fit the X80 opening 72737475767778798081.

Trunk-open button replacement — correct sequence to avoid a fiddly connector: two independent reports on replacing the electric trunk-open button (part sold e.g. via mastergtr.ru, link: https://mastergtr.ru/faw/faw-besturn-x80f/knopka-otkry-vaniya-bagazhnika-dlya-faw-besturn-x80-new). The correct sequence to avoid fighting with the small connector inside the confined door cavity: (1) remove the old button first; (2) pull the connector out through the hole in the trunk door so it's accessible outside the door; (3) snap/connect the new button to the connector while it's outside the door; (4) only then insert the connected button assembly into the door hole. Doing it in the wrong order (trying to mate the connector while it's still inside the door, then fishing the button back out to reconnect it from outside) wastes about an hour of fiddly, frustrating effort 828384.

Trunk sensor false "open" signal specifically in freezing temperatures: a related but distinct symptom from the general "shows open when closed" sensor fault above: in sub-zero freezing weather, the trunk-lid sensor shows the door as open on the dashboard (with lights staying on) despite the lid being physically closed. This variant specifically affects the limit-switch (концевик) contact and is tied to cold temperatures. Solutions reported: (1) adjust the sensor's mounting bracket with a hammer/bolts underneath, using a star wrench to reposition it; (2) test by disconnecting the sensor wires and shorting the contacts — if the warning clears, the issue is the sensor; (3) apply thick 3M tape to the contact point on the door (one owner reports this worked for 2 years before the tape thickness wore down); (4) contact cleaning may help; (5) replace just the microswitch, not the full lock assembly. Warm weather temporarily resolves the symptom on its own 85868788899091929394. ⚠️ Conflict/note: multiple solutions are proposed (bracket adjustment, tape, microswitch replacement); thermal expansion/contraction of the sensor mechanism is the likely common root cause across reports.

Collision-damage frame deformation blocking the lock — repair options and cost: after a collision impact to the trunk/rear area, even slight frame deformation can prevent the door lock from seating and closing properly (lock internals are visible under the door's interior trim, requiring trim removal to inspect). Solutions: (1) straighten the frame with a spot welder plus paint — roughly 37,000 RUB (RU market, January 2026); (2) adjust or disconnect the lock sensor as a temporary workaround. Professional service is recommended; a full door replacement is expensive (a new door sourced from China runs roughly 59,000 RUB plus labor; RU market, January 2026). Separately, on door sealing: if the rib-stiffening structure is damaged, replacement is preferred over straightening to avoid future rust, since zinc plating on X80 doors is insufficient protection on its own 9596979899100101102103104105106107108109110111112113114115116117118119120121122123124125126127128129130131132133134135136137138139140141142143144145.

Trunk latch button-area corrosion — cosmetic, not critical: separate from the functional lock issues above, the trunk latch button area commonly shows rust spots in the bottom corner where the button is located, reported on many X80 examples. This is a cosmetic issue (does not affect latch function) — treatable by covering with stickers or touch-up painting. It's regarded as a factory-quality issue seen widely across the model, considered acceptable/expected for a Chinese-market vehicle by the community 146147148149150151.

docs.title: Trunk lid gas struts — replacement and fitment
docs.text:
Tags: #trunk · #hood · #gas-strut · #part-number · #price · #cross-compatibility

Prices and suppliers on this page are Russian-market (RUB, at the dates shown). Verify locally before relying on them in Syria.

Some advice here concerns sub-zero winters and is less relevant in a hot climate.

Trunk lid support gas struts are easy to replace as a DIY job. New struts should be "primed" by pressing on them several times before installation to activate/charge them. After correct installation, the trunk opens smoothly with one hand and rises automatically to full height 1234.

Universal 2-piece gas-lift kit (hood/tailgate): a generic gas-lift set ("Универсальный Газлифт", 2 struts) sold on Ozon for the FAW Besturn X80 (2013–2020) installs in ~10 minutes and holds the hood or tailgate open without manual propping 567.

Trunk struts — Mapco 91948 and cheap alternatives: Mapco part 91948 is a commonly used trunk strut for the X80. Many budget aftermarket struts fail quickly, especially in winter — they open only partially and lose pressure, requiring manual assistance to fully raise the boot lid. Price range observed: 2,700+ RUB depending on supplier (2024). Quality varies significantly — some units stop working within months in winter. Sourced via Ozon/AliExpress 8910111213141516. ⚠️ Conflict: community members report both successful long-term use and rapid failures of cheap struts, particularly in winter — quality is inconsistent between batches/sellers.

Hood struts — XIANGSHANG-MY273: available on Ozon for the FAW Besturn X80 (2013–2020), fits both dorestyle (pre-facelift) and restyle (facelift) models. Price varies significantly between buyers — some report 2,700 RUB (RU market, April 2024), others higher 910171819. ⚠️ Conflict: price discrepancy on Ozon is unresolved — debate over whether it's due to region, account age, or loyalty tier.
