Tailgate strut winter weakening: tailgate gas struts/dampers frequently weaken in cold weather, causing the lid to fall unexpectedly. Problem manifests starting around -7 to -15°C. Several owners report needing replacement after 2–3 winter seasons; replacements sourced from Ozon 20212223.

VW Tiguan I cross-compatibility (confirmed working): Volkswagen Tiguan I (2007–2016) trunk struts/dampers fit and work on the X80 — one owner installed them in autumn and reported normal operation through winter 242526. MILES CB00013 trunk damper: ~874 RUB (RU market, November 2024) 26.

VW Tiguan gas spring 8195068 5N0827550E — length mismatch: this specific VW Tiguan part (514 mm) does not fit optimally on the X80 trunk — it is about 16 mm too short versus the OEM X80 strut length of 530 mm. Some users report weak opening force after about a week of use. A Mazda 6 GG spring cross-reference has similar fitment issues when longer than OEM 2728293031323334353637. ⚠️ Conflict: user "Keras" reports the 8195068/5N0827550E works perfectly, while others report weak opening or weakening after one week — likely batch variance (defective units or different sourcing), not a uniform incompatibility.

Ford Mondeo cross-compatibility (workaround): Ford Mondeo trunk struts are longer than OEM by about 2–3 cm. Workaround: swap the upper mounting points left-right to shift the attachment point ~3 cm backward, allowing the longer strut to fit 34.

Rear trunk/hatch damper replacement procedure: (1) prop the trunk open with a stick; (2) disconnect one damper from its lower mounting; (3) do not fully extend/deploy the new damper before mounting it — only extend to the length needed to attach it, to avoid damage and difficulty retracting; (4) install the new damper; (5) repeat for the second damper if replacing both. Newly installed dampers can be very strong and cause hard opening at first. Tip: adding sound-deadening material (e.g. "Вибру" 4mm + "Барьер" shielding) under the trunk lining adds weight and smooths the motion. Replace both dampers together to avoid imbalance/uneven closing — though one owner replaced only one initially because the new units felt too powerful 3839404142434445.

Hood gas struts — sourcing is harder than trunk struts: the X80 uses long-type hood gas struts (не короткие), not the shorter variant common on other cars. Mainstream retailers (Ozon and similar) frequently have long lead times (2+ months) with cancelled orders due to supply-chain issues — one owner's Ozon order for a "universal" strut marketed for FAW Besturn X80 (2013–2020) was still undelivered after 2 months. Other suggested sources: kitzap.ru, or the "Медео" community group. Community discussion doesn't have widely-documented stroke length/force (Newton) specs for correct hood struts, making blind ordering risky; sourcing from salvage yards may be an alternative 464748495051525354555657585960. A separate AliExpress listing specifically for FAW X80 2013–2019 (including the facelifted version) sells gas-assisted hood struts for 2,719 RUB (26% discount; RU market, as of March 31, 2025); one owner confirmed the struts from this listing work on a facelifted car 6162.

Hood gas strut dimensions (measured, aftermarket): total opening length 75 cm; deployed rod length 34.5 cm (with hinge); sleeve + hinge length 40.5 cm; retraction gap when the hood is closed ~10 cm. Mounting uses a proprietary hood bracket system; Ozon listings for these struts typically include the mounting hardware, with an install time of about 10 minutes 6364656667.

Conflict — strut force rating (500 N vs. 600 N): there is debate over whether a higher-force strut (600 N, mentioned separately for trunk-lid struts) affects winter operation. One user reports the 600 N strut was too hard to close, while the 500 N strut "works well year-round" — suggesting 500 N is the better choice for the X80's hood/trunk unless a stronger lift is specifically needed 6364656667.

Volkswagen Tiguan trunk strut — preferred cross-compatible alternative: Volkswagen Tiguan trunk/boot gas struts fit the X80 trunk lid and are reported as a preferred alternative to factory struts. Specific part: FENOX A906024 (VW Tiguan strut), ~1,780 RUB (RU market, May 2025) on Ozon, confirmed working well after installation. The Tiguan spec was chosen over generic alternatives (e.g. from Chevrolet) for more consistent year-round performance 68697071.

FAW X80 2013–2020 universal 2-piece hood-strut kit — additional listing confirmation: a second Ozon listing specifically for the "FAW Besturn X80 2013–2020" hood struts (2-piece kit, item teME4d5) was independently reported. ⚠️ Conflict: this report states the Volkswagen Tiguan strut (part 5N0827550E, Ozon item vIW8QW2) "confirms fitment compatibility" as an alternative — which conflicts with the length-mismatch finding above (514mm vs. the X80's 530mm OEM length, ~16mm too short). Likely explanation: batch/seller variance in what's shipped under that Ozon listing, or a difference between hood struts and trunk struts being conflated under the same VW part number — treat the Tiguan 5N0827550E as unconfirmed/inconsistent pending more reports 727374.

Trunk/boot bumpers (dampers) — part C10062877-OZYSTD828: separate from the gas struts, rubber trunk-lid bumpers/dampers are available on Ozon under part code C10062877-OZYSTD828. They hold the trunk door securely and properly closed, complementing (not replacing) the gas struts; an installation kit is included 75767778.

Tiguan struts fail at -25°C; Opel Zafira B alternative works at -20°C: trunk-lid gas struts sourced from a VW Tiguan failed at -25°C and did not recover in milder winter temperatures (still weak at -9°C). Recommended alternative: Opel Zafira B model, specifically TRIALLI GS 2123 (sourced via an Ozon listing), works reliably down to -20°C but is heavier (610N force) — described as overpowered for a quiet trunk, causing extra noise. An Espace II strut (also 610N) was tested and found similarly heavy/noisy. The original OEM struts had already failed at a -15°C threshold before either alternative was tried 7980818283.

OEM spec and additional cross-brand alternatives: OEM standard spec: 515mm inter-center distance, 10mm rod diameter, 22mm tube diameter, 470N force; OEM units are expensive (3,352 RUB per piece, RU market, February 2026). The Tiguan alternative noted elsewhere on this card has 525mm centers (fits normally) and 580N force (works well but opens slower in winter). Additional cross-compatible parts: MILES CB00050; MASUMA T8619 (from Tiguan, 22mm tube / 10mm rod); MASUMA T8150 (from Nissan Murano, 550N, for a stronger opening force). Cheap Tiguan-sourced struts (~700 RUB each, RU market, February 2026) last only about 1 year 84858687888990919293949596979899100101102103.

VW Tiguan trunk struts — price and seasonal-replacement caveat (reinforcing report): VW Tiguan 1 gas-assisted trunk struts (brand UporySPB) work as a replacement for the X80's trunk struts. Cost: 1,200–1,600 RUB per pair (RU market, April 2026). They provide significant assist, reducing the manual force needed to open the trunk — but, consistent with the Tiguan cold-weather weaknesses noted above, this cheaper sourcing option requires seasonal (yearly) replacement, typically each winter 104105106107108.

Trunk gas strut OEM spec — additional cross-reference confirmation: additional confirmation of the OEM spec noted above: 53 cm length, 470 N (~470 Nm equivalent holding force as commonly described by owners) holding force, 515mm center-to-center mounting distance. Also cross-compatible: BMW X5 (E53) struts match these specs. A Geely Coolray electric trunk actuator fits the X80's trunk mounting bolts directly, enabling conversion from manual gas struts to an electric trunk actuator without bracket modification 109110111112.

Hood gas struts — threaded-rivnut installation method (upgrade over factory clip mount): power/gas-filled hood struts sourced from Ozon require custom installation for maximum reliability, since the factory mounting point is a fragile plastic clip-on system. Recommended install method: (1) remove the factory plastic clip; (2) locate the pre-existing hole used for the hood's factory soundproofing pad; (3) drill that hole out to M6 size; (4) insert an M6 threaded rivnut; (5) install a ball-head bolt into the rivnut. Struts installed this way are firm — expect to learn a slightly different technique for closing the hood — but do not leak/weaken after installation. Installation time: 1–2 hours 113114115116117118119120.

Hood struts with rivnut mount — one-month in-service review: after one month of use, hood struts installed with the M6 rivnut method (above) are stiff — especially in cold winter weather, to the point that manual support is needed when opening the hood (it won't stay up on its own from head-height alone) — but otherwise effective. Positive: no leaking, no rattling, seals stayed intact, panel gaps remained stable. Negative: the hood doesn't close on the first attempt due to the strut firmness; workaround is adding hood soundproofing weight, or learning the specific closing technique needed. Overall verdict: good durability, with the caveat that closing technique takes some adjustment 121122.

docs.title: Trunk lid molding-to-glass gap — factory specification
docs.text:
Tags: #trunk · #molding · #normal-behavior

The normal gap between the trim molding and the glass on the trunk lid is approximately 5 mm (±1 mm). Multiple owners confirmed this is factory specification, not an assembly error — the gap ensures proper water drainage and prevents the seal from binding 12345.

Trunk window chrome trim — part numbers and clip sourcing: the chrome trim/molding around the trunk window is held on by multiple clips — per the FAW parts catalog, 8 clips total (one owner counted 7 physically on their car, though the catalog's last column lists a quantity of 8). Part numbers: 5CA050940 — the molding body itself (reportedly sold without the retaining clips); 5CA050943 — a related part, exact identity uncertain; FC0150629 — likely the number for the side molding (may also apply to the rear/trunk molding, unconfirmed). The factory retaining clips are not sold separately through official channels. Community-sourced alternative: Nissan and Infiniti clips have been reported as a suitable substitute — one owner referenced a Drive2 build-log (bortzhurnal) from a black X80 owner who successfully used these clips. A parts-catalog ZIP file (with FAW X80 diagrams) has been shared within the group's media 6789101112131415. Removing the molding to treat rust underneath and reattach it is a reasonable idea in principle, but is complicated in practice by the lack of available replacement clips 12.

docs.title: Trunk lid panel thinness — denting and care
docs.text:
Tags: #trunk · #gas-strut · #conflict

Community members disagree on this topic — both positions are reported.

Multiple owners describe the X80's trunk lid sheet metal as thin — one owner compares it to foil ("как из фольги") — and report that it dents inward ("проминается") simply from the normal act of closing the trunk, not from any impact 1.

Gas struts help, but the choice of strut brand matters: one owner fitted trunk-lid gas struts sourced from a VW Tiguan; with those installed he now closes the lid only by pressing on the trunk emblem (rather than pushing on the panel generally), yet the lid still visibly dents — "a real sore point" ("прям беда печаль") 2. A second owner asked whether the Tiguan struts were genuine/OEM or the Marshal aftermarket brand, noting that Marshal struts he tried held worse than his old original struts after only 3 weeks 3. The first owner confirmed his struts were indeed Marshal, and — despite the brand's poor showing elsewhere in strut discussions — reported his own pair held up fine, describing them as very stiff/tight ("тугие капец") 4. ⚠️ Conflict: the two owners' experience with Marshal struts directly disagrees — one reports rapid failure (worse than OEM within 3 weeks), the other reports his own Marshal struts holding up well — consistent with the batch/quality-variance conflict already documented for aftermarket struts generally (see the trunk-lid gas struts card).

Care recommendation: given the thin panel, close the trunk gently and support your hand on the emblem/latch area specifically rather than pushing on the general panel surface, to minimize denting risk 245.

docs.title: Trunk lid struts — part numbers and alternative
docs.text:
Tags: #trunk · #gas-strut · #part-number · #mazda-6-compat

Prices and suppliers on this page are Russian-market (RUB, at the dates shown). Verify locally before relying on them in Syria.

Some advice here concerns sub-zero winters and is less relevant in a hot climate.

Symptom: the trunk lid stays become weak or stop holding the lid open.

Replacement pneumatic (gas) struts, OEM: 5CA063620A (right side), 5CA062620A (left side) 12.

Alternative: Ford Mondeo struts sourced from AliExpress work, with one modification — the Mondeo struts are 2cm longer, so the upper mounting holes need to be swapped between the left and right sides during installation. The longer struts give better opening height and a more positive self-closing action than the originals 13. One owner who fitted AliExpress Mondeo struts reports the tailgate now lifts with a light touch and opens about 10 cm higher, and says the OE struts are weak, especially in winter 4.

Second alternative — Volkswagen Tiguan I (2007–2016 / 2007–2011) gas struts. Marshall-brand damper, part MGS2565, sold on OZON, is a direct compatible fit; installation is a simple spring-for-spring swap 56789101112131415161718. Compatibility confirmed by multiple owners with successful installation 141618.

Caution — Marshall durability. Victor reports the Marshall-brand struts are weaker than alternatives; other brands may last longer 14. This was confirmed by a real failure: a Marshall MGS2565 strut (VW Tiguan fit) seized/locked after only two months of use, requiring a temporary prop to hold the trunk lid open 1920.

VW Tiguan I gas struts — genuine VW part number, pricing, winter deflation pattern: cross-referencing the Marshall MGS2565 fitment already on this card, the underlying genuine Volkswagen part is 5N0827550A (VW Tiguan I, 2007–2016) — Marshall MGS2565 and similar aftermarket variants are cross-fit copies of this part. Typical cost: 500–1,100₽ per piece on Ozon. Community experience reinforces the durability caution above: these struts generally hold well, but can lose pressure/deflate during harsh winters (below −20°C) — in cold climates, plan on replacing them roughly annually rather than expecting multi-year service. Quality is variable across units/sellers: some fail within weeks (consistent with the Marshall seizure case already documented), others last around a year 2122232425262728293031.

Added sound-deadening weight overwhelms stock struts — Fenox A906024 and Marshal as stronger alternatives: applying sound-deadening material to the trunk/cargo lid adds enough weight that the OEM struts can no longer hold it open reliably — a common trigger for needing stronger replacement struts, distinct from the winter-cold-related weakening documented elsewhere on this card. Fenox A906024 was recommended as a more powerful replacement, but one owner who installed them reported disappointment: they lift initially but then "barely pull" and stop supporting the lid properly. That owner switched to Marshal-brand struts instead, describing them as lifting "more or less evenly" — a clear improvement over Fenox, though still not fully reliable in winter: even the Marshal struts only half-open the lid in freezing temperatures, requiring manual assistance to fully open it. A separate owner who installed a different (unspecified) stronger strut reported it holds the lid but doesn't lift it — "not bad for the price" was the verdict. General takeaway echoed here: all gas struts, including upgraded ones, underperform in cold weather — this reinforces rather than contradicts the -20°C degradation pattern already documented on this card 323334353637.

Conflict on sides: kitzap listings for the rear door (tailgate) gas struts give the opposite assignment — 5CA062620A for the right side and 5CA063620A for the left — while the comment above gives 5CA063620A for the right and 5CA062620A for the left. Check the side with the seller or against the old strut before ordering 382.

Tiguan listing numbers and Yeti caveat: an Ozon listing of Tiguan trunk struts bundles the numbers 5N0827550A, 5N0827550D, 5N0827550 and 5N0827550E as a possible cross-reference, but fit is not confirmed 39. A reply recommending 5N0827550A for the X80 trunk warns that Yeti and Tiguan struts differ in specification and advises reading reviews first 4041.

docs.title: Wheel-arch liner clips — fragility and sourcing
docs.text:
Tags: #clips · #part-number

Prices and suppliers on this page are Russian-market (RUB, at the dates shown). Verify locally before relying on them in Syria.

Fragility warning: the plastic clips and mounting brackets used for the X80's wheel-arch liner (podkrylok) are fragile and prone to breaking during removal. If you plan to remove a wheel-arch liner for any maintenance, buy replacement clips beforehand — original clips frequently break during removal, and you don't want to be stuck without spares mid-job. The clips are square-shaped plastic pieces; separately, the mounting tabs/ears ("проушины") on the moldings themselves also commonly break off — one owner found the liner comes away in your hands with the clips still lodged in the wheel arch, mounting hardware and all 123.

Removal technique matters: the X80's arch clips release by being pushed from the inside — if you instead pull/pry from the outside, they're likely to break. The square-type clip specifically is described as durable under normal load (no stress in that direction) but the mounting ears in the moldings are the weak point 23.

Sourcing replacement clips: the clips are Mazda-branded parts, available at Ozon and at car-parts markets/marketplaces generally 45. AliExpress also carries compatible/clone clips, but shipping is slow and unreliable — reported delivery times of 1–2 months, with at least one owner's separate AliExpress order (for hood struts) never arriving after 2 months 467.

Same fragility issue on rear fender guard clips: consistent with the warnings above, the fastening clips (referred to as "pistons"/пистоны) used on the plastic rear fender guards (подкрылники) are also fragile and prone to breaking during removal. Take extra care during installation to avoid damaging the plastic clips when inserting them back into their mounting points 891011.

Rear liner panels themselves — not available new: separate from the mounting clips, the rear plastic wheel-arch liner panels (подкрылники) themselves are not available new from suppliers at all — only used/salvage parts are on the market. This is a known supply gap: listings sometimes appear online for new units, but they turn out not to actually be in stock when contacted 121314.

docs.title: Window deflector installation
docs.text:
Tags: #installation · #part-number

Prices and suppliers on this page are Russian-market (RUB, at the dates shown). Verify locally before relying on them in Syria.

Window deflectors can be installed on the X80 without any special modification 1. Fit is good on the passenger side, with a tight seam 2. On the driver side, the deflector may need a slight angle adjustment at one corner for a perfect fit 2. Overall installation is straightforward and reduces wind noise at highway speeds 3.

Correct part number and aftermarket fitment warning: the correct part number for FAW X80 window deflectors is FAW1315011, compatible with 2013–2022 model years. Warning: some aftermarket part numbers (e.g. Cobra Tuning F11018) do not fit correctly on post-2018 models — the deflector overhangs the mirror bracket by 2–5 cm. The FAW1315011 deflector with factory FAW branding fits correctly. Price range: 1,190–1,300 RUB (RU market, August 2024) from Russian suppliers 4567.

docs.title: Autopilot window marks — long-term durability
docs.text:
Tags: #window · #low-confidence

"Autopilot" brand window marks (likely an electrochromic or UV-reactive window tint/marking product) installed in 2018 showed minimal visible wear by 2024, with only small cracks developing on the front glass. The rear glass remained in pristine condition. The materials appear durable, though the owner was uncertain whether a protective treatment would help extend their life further, and no specific maintenance method was identified 1234.

docs.title: Windshield frame edge — chip/rust protection and repair
docs.text:
Tags: #windshield · #corrosion

Prices and suppliers on this page are Russian-market (RUB, at the dates shown). Verify locally before relying on them in Syria.

The windshield frame edge (especially the area above the windshield) is prone to chipping and rust. Two approaches, which can be combined:

Repair/touch-up (for existing rust or chips): (1) degrease the surface; (2) apply a rust converter with zinc; (3) apply an anti-corrosion primer; (4) paint with a matching color using a thin brush — small touch-up bottles with brush applicators are available, but an artist's fine brush works better than the bundled applicator for precision work 1.

Preventive protective film/trim (to avoid future chips): a T-shaped protective trim/film for the windshield edge is available — one owner sourced it from AliExpress (T-shaped, applied ~3 years ago, still holding up well); a specific listing is also sold on Ozon.ru under "Защита от сколов, ржавчины для FAW Besturn X80 2018-" (chip/rust protection for FAW Besturn X80 2018+), priced around 3,000–5,000 RUB. Reported lifespan: 3+ years with good appearance retained. Installation requires a clean, dry surface and can be done DIY without removing the windshield. A third option mentioned is a general protective/"armor" film applied to the edge area 2345.

docs.title: Windshield replacement — seal and sealant sourcing
docs.text:
Tags: #windshield · #seal · #part-number · #price · #rain-sensor

Prices and suppliers on this page are Russian-market (RUB, at the dates shown). Verify locally before relying on them in Syria.

Some advice here concerns sub-zero winters and is less relevant in a hot climate.

Windshield replacement requires a rubber seal. According to a body shop consulted by an owner, the seal is not model-specific — a generic seal can be used 12. Standard silicone or polyurethane sealant/adhesive is used during installation, with the cost included in labor 3. If additional sealing is needed beyond the standard installation, a polyurethane sealant can be specified 4. No specific OEM part number is required for the seal — work with a glass-installation specialist who can source an appropriate one 56.

Windshield part number and pricing: OEM windshield part number 5CA063900. Multiple variants exist, with pricing ranging 6,000–14,000 RUB (RU market, January 2025) depending on features (e.g. with/without rain sensor) 7891011.

Rain sensor windshield options: restyle-version windshields are available with or without an integrated rain sensor; the sensor itself is transferable between windshields. Suppliers list both options separately — "without rain sensor" is a common, cheaper aftermarket choice 121314.

Replacement timing in cold weather: whether to replace a cracked windshield before travelling north in winter, or wait until spring, came up repeatedly. Key points: glass replacement is normally done in a garage/box where the car sits 2–3 hours for the sealant to cure; temperature swings (e.g. 0°C to -10°C) can cause an existing crack to spread from thermal stress; if water/dirt gets into a crack, a repair (rather than replacement) becomes ineffective. Recommendation: replace proactively before cold weather if a crack is growing, since the spider-crack pattern can spread rapidly with temperature swings 15161718192021222324252627282930.

Chip/crack repair vs. replacement cost: small chip repair (sealant/glue applied to stop propagation) costs about 500 RUB per 10 cm of crack length (RU market, November 2024). Full windshield replacement with labor runs approximately 9,000 RUB (RU market, November 2024) 223132. A later report of a 2-chip repair job priced it at 1,500 RUB (RU market, November 2024), higher than the base 500 RUB rate — pricing varies by service provider 3334.

Additional OEM part numbers: 5CA063900 — non-original, Russian manufacture; 5CA263900 — original, with more realistic (higher) pricing than the non-original 5CA063900 listing suggests. Non-original glass is widely available from online parts retailers; original glass can be sourced through specialized parts catalogs 35363738.

KMK brand — most common aftermarket windshield in Russia: KMK (manufactured in Borovskoye, Nizhny Novgorod region) is the most widely installed aftermarket windshield for the X80. Available with or without a rain sensor. Pricing (RU market, February 2025): glass alone 5,100–7,800 RUB; installation ~3,800 RUB; total with installation 7,800–8,000 RUB (without rain sensor) or 8,000+ RUB (with sensor). Installation takes about 3 hours of adhesive-curing time and is best done indoors in warm conditions. Warranty: 14 days for factory glass defects, 10 years on the installation work itself. Contact reported by owners: ЕвроГласс in Yekaterinburg, +73433699090 (had KMK in stock; a restyle rain-sensor variant was expected the following Monday) 39404142434445464748495051. Alternative: Fuyao (China) glass, under 10,000 RUB total (RU market, February 2025), but owners note it often has optical defects (particles, poor clarity).

Windshield replacement cost reports (2025): 13,500 RUB with professional installation (RU market, April 2025), glass sourced via Avito 52. Separately, a "simplest"/base-spec windshield with installation cost 11,500 RUB (RU market, May 2025), with the glass in stock so no wait was needed 535455.

Brand/quality considerations — BOR vs. KMK vs. others: an installer warned against a windshield sold under the "BOR" (БОР) label, saying it clouds/hazes over time — but another owner disputes that "BOR" is even a real manufacturer brand, explaining that "Бор" is a Russian city (home to the Borsky Glass Factory / Asahi partner plant) where many small workshops produce glass and stamp it with a similar-looking trademark; there is no legitimate "БОР" product line for this car asahi.ru catalog 565758. One owner has run KMK glass for 2 years with "no issues" 59. Another KMK installation reported no clouding after 9+ months, but noticeable rapid sand-pitting/fine scratching from road debris, appearing as an internal dust-like haze layer after about 9 months 57. General guidance from the thread: shop by price within the same tier — "the whole auto industry uses these [glass makers]," and even OEM glass develops similar pitting/haze after a couple of years, so quality control varies by individual batch more than by brand 6061626364656667.

Windshield glass compatibility — pre-restyle vs. post-restyle: the windshield glass itself is the same between pre-restyle and post-restyle models, except for the presence/absence of the rain-sensor provision. One owner sourced a pre-restyle windshield for a post-restyle car, and it fit as a direct replacement. Sources: salvage/junk yards and dealerships 686970.

OEM glass supplier — FUYAO: FUYAO is the original-equipment glass supplier for the FAW X80. FUYAO also supplies OEM windshields for Volkswagen Group (VAG), Kia, and other brands, so earlier X80 units may carry factory-installed FUYAO glass 7172.

Aftermarket windshield durability — brittleness concerns: some aftermarket windshields are noticeably more brittle than OEM glass, with quality varying significantly between suppliers — original factory glass is reported as more durable 7374.

Community discussion resource: the Drive2.ru forum has ongoing discussions about custom windshield options for the X80, including heated and tinted variants — a useful place to search for installation sources and real-world experiences 75.

Regional availability and pre/post-restyle fitment variation: windshield replacement parts are difficult to source in some regions (St. Petersburg specifically reported as challenging). Fitment and glass specifications may differ between pre-restyle (dorest) and restyle models 76777879.

XYG glass with rain/light sensors — pricing snapshot (October 2025): a properly-fitted XYG brand windshield (model FWX80VCSLFW), with integrated rain and light sensors, costs approximately 10,825 RUB for the glass alone (RU market, as of 15 October 2025, likely higher since), plus delivery and installation bringing the total to 18,000–20,000 RUB. A substitute glass from local stock (Borskoe brand) is inferior quality — visible waves/distortion through the glass plus a misaligned rain-sensor cutout. Both FYG and XYG brands produce high-quality, straight glass without optical aberrations; Borskoe stock is the problematic option. Sourced via the drom.ru marketplace. Regional availability varies — some areas stock only the lower-quality glass and must special-order the better brands, adding wait time. Glass quality matters for technical inspection (техосмотр) — distorted glass that warps vision is a registration risk 80818283848586878889.

XYG FWX80VCSLFWX with rain/light sensors — later pricing (June 2026): a separately-reported OEM-compatible windshield part number, XYG FWX80VCSLFWX, includes integrated rain and light sensors. Cost: 12,500 RUB for the glass + 4,000 RUB installation = 16,500 RUB total (RU market, June 2026). The reporting owner confirms excellent visibility and no lens distortion 909192.

КМК brand — budget alternative, not recommended: КМК brand windshield is offered as a budget alternative, priced around 10,500 RUB with installation (RU market, June 2026) — cheaper than XYG but significantly lower quality. Multiple reports of delamination and cracking after winter weather; it's sometimes used as a temporary/cosmetic replacement specifically for reselling ("flipping") a vehicle 93949596. ⚠️ Conflict: one owner (Che Guevara) strongly warns against КМК's quality and reliability; another (Niko75) chose it anyway as the budget option; a third owner experienced cracking after a winter season. XYG is the community-preferred choice for durability.

Chip and crack repair kit: a member suggests trying a manual windshield repair kit, Best Room (one-piece white resin, 3 g), sold on Yandex Market, for chips and cracks; no price was given 97.

Item FW-X80-VCS (LFW/X) — pre-restyle only: an item coded FW-X80-VCS (LFW/X) is listed as fitting the 2013–2019 X80 and not the restyled X80 NEW; the reason is not explained and the item is not described further. Compare with the XYG glass numbers above before ordering 98.

Rear window glass 5CA063930: the rear window glass for the FAW Besturn X80 is 5CA063930, as listed by a parts shop in October 2025 99.

docs.title: Windshield tinting — legal limits (Russia)
docs.text:
Tags: #windshield · #legal

In Russia, the legal tint strip on the windshield is a maximum of 14 cm in width, measured from the top edge — this limit applies consistently across the glass area. The tint strip should be cut in a curved ("banana-shaped") pattern to follow the windshield's sphere for an even visual appearance from the driver's seat; a straight rectangular strip looks uneven due to the curve of the glass 1234567.

Factory sun-glare problem — why the tint strip is used: the underlying reason owners add the windshield tint strip: the factory design creates significant sun glare in the cabin, especially given the windshield's angle and the light factory tint on newer models. Sun visors (козырьки) are reported as insufficient on their own. Consistent with the legal-limit note above, mounting the strip along the roof edge/header minimizes visibility obstruction while still cutting glare; effectiveness varies with sun angle and time of day. As an alternative or supplement, polarized sunglasses are reported as a more reliable glare solution than tinting alone 8910111213141516.

docs.title: Windshield washer nozzles — universal fan-style upgrade
docs.text:
Tags: #wipers · #mazda-6-compat · #price

Prices and suppliers on this page are Russian-market (RUB, at the dates shown). Verify locally before relying on them in Syria.

Universal fan-style ("веерные") washer nozzles — Mazda CX-5-style, inexpensive Ozon upgrade (March 2026): a universal fan-spray washer nozzle upgrade (marketed as fitting "99% of cars," in the style of Mazda CX-5 nozzles) is available on Ozon for roughly 156 RUB (RU market, March 2026) for a 2-pack including a check valve; hoses are often included as well. See also the wiper blades card for the closely related stock wiper-blade sizing and service-mode info.

Reported benefits: wider, better spray coverage of the windshield than the stock pinhole-style nozzles.

Reported limitations and mixed community verdict: distribution at the top of the windshield is described as poor; if the spray angle is adjusted upward enough to reach the top, it instead hits the hood; at highway speed the spray performance is described as mediocre; the nozzles are adjustable but the usable adjustment range is limited. Community opinion is split: some owners find them clearly better than the stock nozzles for washing off heavy grime (though the bottom few centimeters sometimes need a second pass), while at least one owner tried them, was dissatisfied on several points — missing the top of the windshield, spray hitting the hood when adjusted to avoid that, poor performance at speed on the highway — and reverted to the original factory nozzles. Treat this as a cheap, easily-reversible experiment rather than a guaranteed upgrade 123456789101112.

docs.title: Windshield washer nozzle types
docs.text:
Tags: #part-number

Prices and suppliers on this page are Russian-market (RUB, at the dates shown). Verify locally before relying on them in Syria.

Two nozzle types are used for the washer system: (1) fan-type (веерные) — spray spreads and disperses easily but is less effective at highway speed due to wind pressure; (2) nozzles mounted on the wiper blades (поводки дворников) — more effective at highway speeds since the spray point moves with the blade. One owner attempted to replace the factory nozzles and accidentally cracked the windshield during installation — caution advised. Another owner reports the fan-type nozzles give a noticeably weak stream 123456.

No factory washer-fluid level sensor: the X80 does not have a windshield-washer fluid level sensor, unlike some other FAW models or previous cars like the Duster. Drivers must manually monitor the fluid level and refill — there's no dashboard warning indicator when it runs out. Community consensus: this feature was omitted despite the dashboard's indicator icons suggesting otherwise 7891011.

Universal fan-type nozzles with 4-way guides (DIY upgrade): universal fan-type washer nozzles with 4-way guide tubes ("поводки") give better spray coverage than the stock nozzles. Recommended part numbers: KD4567510, KD5367510. The nozzles need fine adjustment with a needle to direct the spray pattern, and should be set up at around 110 km/h for proper wind-adjusted spray. A check valve ("обратный клапан") can be added to prevent backflow to the tank while wiping 121314151617181920.

Nozzle installation on wiper-blade guides: install washer nozzles on the wiper-blade arms by routing tubing along the wiper-arm structure. Remove the hood seal strip ("жабо") to access the mounting area underneath. Route the tube through the hood-seal area and split it to both wiper blades with a T-connector; secure with mounting brackets so it doesn't interfere with wiper-blade motion 21222324252627282930313233343536.

Spray-pattern (распыл) nozzle cross-compatibility: the stock X80 nozzles spray in streams only, with no adjustable pattern. CX-5 nozzles reportedly provide a spray pattern (распыл) with adjustment capability; Mazda 6 nozzles can also be sourced for compatibility. Universal spray-type washer nozzles from Ozon are available as well (product links shared in the community). These nozzles allow fine adjustment to optimize the spray pattern for both wipers, and several owners report good results switching from the stream-only stock type to a spray-type replacement 3738394041424344.

Adjusting spray direction toward windshield center: the stock nozzles can be adjusted to redirect their spray toward the center of the windshield instead of straight down. Method: use a hard metal awl or needle to nudge the nozzle opening — a paper clip is too soft and won't work. Access is through the open hood. The nozzles are seated tightly and require firm tool pressure to adjust; one owner mentioned using an awl/pin attached to a keychain as a handy always-available tool for this 4546474849505152535455.

Mazda CX-5 fan-spray nozzle cross-fit — part numbers and adjustment technique: stock washer nozzles spray weakly. Replacement with Mazda CX-5 fan-spray nozzles — part KD53-67-510 (approx. 650–1,200 RUB per pair, RU market, June 2026) or KD4567510 (approx. 1,200 RUB; RU market, June 2026) — gives a superior fan-spray pattern that covers more of the windshield. One owner sourced Mazda CX-5 units secondhand via Avito for a lower cost, confirmed fit without modification. Installation: (1) swap in the nozzles for the factory units; (2) the spray angle is adjustable — use small tweezers to nudge the direction up/down by pivoting the outer housing, and rotate the nozzle itself for left/right spray vector; (3) do not insert tools into the slit on the nozzle's internal siphon — the plastic will crack. The internal siphon regulates pressure/volume and cannot be field-adjusted. The stock pump itself is weak, so high-quality nozzles only partially solve the problem — one user also tried a new pump but reported limited spray improvement, indicating the weakness is system-level rather than nozzle-only 56575859606162636465666768.

Spacer tip for spray-angle clearance, broader compatibility list, and price (~2,500 RUB, RU market, March 2026): further confirms the Mazda CX-5 fan-nozzle cross-fit above — the same nozzle part is also listed as compatible with Mazda 6 GJ/GL (3rd gen), CX-5 KE/KF, and CX-9 TC. If a nozzle's spray hits the wiper blade, the community recommends adding thin spacers underneath the nozzle to adjust the spray angle. Price point: ~2,500 RUB via Ozon (RU market, March 2026) 697071727374.

Fan-to-jet nozzle swap — resale value of stock fan nozzles: stock X80 washer nozzles are the fan/spray pattern type. One owner replaced them with jet-type nozzles sourced from a Mazda CX-5, reporting jet nozzles are better suited to highway use. The removed stock fan nozzles can be resold used for roughly 500 RUB per pair (RU market, June 2026) 75.

Spray-direction adjustment — needle/wire technique (earlier report): consistent with the awl/needle adjustment method above, an earlier report gives the same core technique with more procedural detail: if one nozzle hits the wiper blade and the other sprays too high (toward the roof), correct the direction using a needle or small-diameter stiff wire (not sharp). Procedure: raise the hood and the wipers, access the nozzles, rotate them slightly — moves as small as 0.5 mm are significant — test the spray on the windshield, and repeat until the desired direction is achieved. Use wire rather than sharp implements to avoid damage 767778798081.

Clearing a clogged or corroded nozzle. Washer nozzles can corrode or clog over time, reducing or blocking the spray. The tool of choice is a needle, used gently in the opening — the same tool as for aiming the spray above. A shim or thin blade is discouraged: it can bend or snap off inside the nozzle and make the clog worse (one owner who tried a shim only bent it, while a needle worked cleanly). If the nozzles are severely corroded/seized ("закисли") and needle-clearing is not reliable, some owners suggest skipping the repair and fitting ready-made fan-style spray nozzles instead (see the fan-type and Mazda CX-5 options above).828384

docs.text:
Tags: #wiper · #part-number · #restyle · #price

Prices and suppliers on this page are Russian-market (RUB, at the dates shown). Verify locally before relying on them in Syria.

Wiper arm cap: the front wiper arm cap (заглушка дворника, "крышка") is listed by Emex as part 5CA067395P1; one owner ordered one there for about 350 RUB (RU market, Oct 2026), and says Ozon sells similar caps for more (Oct 2026) 12. Another owner suggests searching for "заглушка дворника (крышка)" 3. An Ozon listing sells the cap as one piece under GS1M-67-395 (Mazda 6, CX-5, CX-7, CX-9); a member who bought it confirmed it is the right one for the X80 45. For other wiper topics see wiper system issues.

Washer reservoir (бачок омывателя) — restyle vs pre-restyle: after an accident, a replacement windscreen-washer reservoir for a restyled X80 arrived larger than the original, and the new pump did not fit its mounts 6. Another owner replaced one on a pre-restyle car where everything fitted, and suggests that the restyle and pre-restyle parts differ slightly, so fitment should be checked for the model year 7.

docs.title: Wiper blades — service mode and sizing
docs.text:
Tags: #wipers · #price

Prices and suppliers on this page are Russian-market (RUB, at the dates shown). Verify locally before relying on them in Syria.

Some advice here concerns sub-zero winters and is less relevant in a hot climate.

Service mode (pre-facelift only). To replace wiper blades on pre-facelift X80s, the wipers must be parked mid-stroke so they clear the hood/cowl edge: turn off ignition while holding the wiper stalk pulled upward to enter service mode; the wipers stop mid-stroke 123. To return to normal operation, simply turn the ignition back on 4. This mirrors the service-mode procedure used on other FAW models ("chunga-changa") and is expected to work the same way on most cars 1.

Facelift (restyled, 2020+) models have no service mode — the wiper stalk behavior differs, and blades can be changed with the wipers simply switched off, no special procedure needed 5.

Blade sizes. Factory (OEM) sizes: 600mm driver side + 400mm passenger side in front, 350mm rear 65. Larger aftermarket sizes fit reasonably well: 650mm + 430mm or 650mm + 450mm; with the 450mm passenger blade, some owners report it slightly touching the bottom windshield trim at full stroke on one side, though not a functional problem 78.

Recommended brands (community, winter conditions): - ALCA winter — good cold-weather performance, minimal squeaking around 0°C, cleans well; ~800₽/pair on OZON (RU market, Jan 2026) 910. - Miles winter — reliable for long-term use 1112. - Heyner hybrid 65-43 — ~800₽/pair (RU market, Jan 2026) 1314151617.

Avoid: stock/replacement Marshal blades — weaker than OEM, worse wiping performance than the original equipment 18.

docs.title: Wiper system — normal behavior and malfunctions
docs.text:
Tags: #wiper · #rain-sensor · #relay · #part-number

Prices and suppliers on this page are Russian-market (RUB, at the dates shown). Verify locally before relying on them in Syria.

Some advice here concerns sub-zero winters and is less relevant in a hot climate.

Rear wiper clicking is normal: the rear wiper produces a clicking/ticking sound when activated. This is the normal electromagnetic switching action of the rear wiper relay, not a malfunction 123.

Automatic rain sensor is unreliable: the automatic wiper/rain sensor operates unreliably — (1) it does not activate during heavy downpours when visibility is severely reduced; (2) it suddenly activates at excessive speed ("like a helicopter propeller") when it finally engages; (3) manual adjustment/configuration settings have minimal effect. Some owners had the sensor relocated/re-glued by a dealership without resolution; others disabled automatic mode entirely and use manual control exclusively. The issue appears to be an inherent sensor placement/calibration problem 456.

Rain sensor — additional reports (pre-facelift vs. restyle, and a successful calibration): the erratic behavior is again described as either barely triggering or running the wipers continuously "like helicopter blades." Pre-facelift (dorest) models reportedly have 3-speed rain-sensor modes that work better than the restyle version — an unconfirmed, single-report distinction. Manual control is the recommended workaround given the unreliability. One owner in Moscow reported having the sensor successfully calibrated, though the specific service/shop that did it is unknown 789.

Wiper relay intermittent malfunction: wipers can sometimes continue operating randomly for extended periods when they should stop after 3 sweeps. Workaround: pull the wiper stalk again to interrupt/reset, or restart the engine. Suspected root cause: corrosion on the steering-column relay ("подрулевое реле") electrical contacts — inspection/cleaning of the relay contacts may be needed 10.

Recommended wiper blades: Autoled-opt hybrid blades, 600/400 mm, hold up well (5–6 months of use per owner reports, good cleaning performance). SKYWAY 600/400 mm "buscane"-style blades are reported soft/flimsy with a poor clip design that cracks easily and mediocre cleaning. Winter performance varies in southern regions without salt/reagents on the roads 1112131415161718.

Wiper linkage creak/squeak: apply WD-40 to the internal wiper linkage mechanism. Requires disassembly: unclip the wiper arms, remove the mounting clips, disassemble the linkage (~15 minutes of work), spray WD-40 inside, reassemble. Some owners added supplementary springs to the linkage for extra damping 1920212223242526.

Weak wiper blade spring pressure: factory wiper-arm springs are weak and provide poor blade pressure, causing inadequate wiping. Fix: install an auxiliary spring device (available on Ozon) that clips onto the wiper-arm bracket and increases clamping force — easy to install/remove, effective per user reports. Alternative: relocate the spring's mounting point farther along the arm to increase mechanical advantage 2728293031323334353637.

Rear wiper blade — part numbers: 350 mm blade, OEM part number 5CA167330; alternative LYNX LR35E 14"/350 mm. Available on Ozon and other Russian retailers. Uses a snap-on connector (no lock in the mounting mechanism). Aftermarket brands like Aviel (400 mm) also fit. On some versions only the rubber blade element needs replacing — about 5 minutes 3839404142434445.

Rear wiper blade — removal/adjustment: the wiper arm has a release lever; the blade element slides in/out of the arm via a simple clip connection, taking 1–2 minutes to replace. If the blade doesn't make full contact with the glass center, try adjusting the spring bracket/clip tension on the arm before replacing the whole blade 464748.

Front wiper blade sizing — 65 cm (left) / 43 cm (right): recommended front wiper blade sizing is 65 cm on the left / 43 cm on the right. Root cause for needing a longer left blade: the standard 65 cm blade's curvature does not achieve full contact on the right side due to the windshield's curve, leaving a small unwiped strip on the right side and at the very top of the left blade's travel. ALCA brand wipers are reported as noticeably better quality/cleaning than cheap alternatives; no-name blades from Ozon (~410 RUB for the pair, RU market, April 2025) work but underperform compared to ALCA, especially on wider blades over time 4950515253.

Driver-side wiper cleans poorly — tension-spring booster fix: if the driver-side wiper blade cleans poorly despite good blade quality, install a wiper-tension spring/enhancer (pressure booster) — generic universal 2-piece wiper tension-spring kits, available on Ozon and other retailers, improve contact pressure and cleaning effectiveness 54555657.

Rear wiper nut cap — sourcing: a plastic cap/cover for the rear wiper's mounting nut is available on AliExpress under search terms "faw pentium x80", "besturn x80", or "bestune x80". Cost: under 1,000 RUB on AliExpress (RU market, February 2026). It's included with a complete rear-wiper assembly purchase, or can be bought separately for roughly 700 RUB (RU market, February 2026)

5859606162.

Rear wiper blade alternative — Masuma UR-14: the Masuma UR-14 rubber wiper blade is used by owners as an alternative to the OEM rear wiper blade, available from Ozon and other retailers 6364.
