docs.title: Common rattle and vibration sources
docs.text:
Tags: #rattle · #vibration · #dashboard · #window · #hood

Multiple owners independently report the same set of minor rattle/ vibration sources on the X80, suggesting these are common to the platform rather than individual defects: - Dashboard license-plate/number display panel rattles 1. - Door window glass has a slight vibration/flutter, especially noticeable at certain speeds/road surfaces 12. - Hood edge near the hinges rattles 2.

These affect perceived ride quality/refinement but are not reported as functional or safety issues — mostly a nuisance-noise/NVH characteristic of the platform.

Trunk lid squeaking/rattling from guide rails: a more detailed and fixable rattle source — squeaking/rattling from the trunk's bottom edges when opening/closing or applying pressure to the lid. Cause: the metal guide rails (which run inside rubber channels) becoming noisy, or loose hardware. Fixes, in order of effort: (1) lubricate with silicone spray — temporary relief only; (2) wedge cloth/padding into the gaps between the guide rods and the rubber seals — a more lasting fix; (3) for persistent noise, disassemble the guides to inspect for wear or loose fasteners 345678910.

docs.title: Steering column / dashboard bezel squeak
docs.text:
Tags: #squeak

The plastic bezel frame around the gauge cluster (tachometer and speedometer) can squeak due to vibration and a loose fit. Symptom: squeaking is heard when pressing the upper area of the bezel frame by hand 1.

Two fixes reported: (1) apply silicone lubricant to the contact points — Molykote 111 was specifically recommended, rated -40 to +260°C; or (2) remove the panel and re-glue it using acoustic foam tape to close the vibration gaps 12.

docs.title: Gauge-cluster fabric overlay repair
docs.text:
Tags: #dashboard · #trim · #part-number · #paint

The upper gauge-cluster fabric overlay (the trim bezel wrapped around the instrument cluster, part number 5CA059415) commonly falls off because the factory adhesive is inadequate and fails over time 123.

Fix — Cosmofen (космофен) super glue: re-attach the overlay using Cosmofen, a strong cyanoacrylate-type adhesive. Proper application technique: (1) coat the perimeter of the overlay with glue; (2) insert/ seat the overlay into position on the gauge housing; (3) for full, even contact, apply additional glue along the top edge using a syringe rather than just brushing it on. One owner tested this method with durability of roughly 1 year or more without the overlay coming loose again 3456.

Sourcing a replacement overlay: if the original overlay is damaged beyond reattachment, replacements are available on AliExpress, with reported delivery times of about 12 days 6.

Accidental spill — removing Cosmofen from paint without damage: a related follow-up in the same community, two days after the overlay fix above — Cosmofen (a polyurethane/cyanoacrylate-type adhesive) accidentally spilled onto the car's paint during a repair. It can be safely removed using pharmaceutical-grade Dimexide (dimethyl sulfoxide, "Димексид"): soak a compress/cloth in Dimexide and hold it against the affected area for several minutes; the adhesive softens and can then be wiped off with cotton or gauze. This method does not damage the clear coat or paint underneath. Mechanical alternatives (sandpaper, a nail file) can also work but risk scratching the paint, so the Dimexide method is preferred 789101112.

docs.title: Door panel interior-light pocket
docs.text:
Tags: #door-panel · #diy · #low-confidence · #aliexpress

FAW X80 door panels have a pre-molded window/pocket on the trim intended for interior-light illumination, but the factory does not install any wiring or lamp there — it's a design placeholder for an optional feature that was never wired up on production cars 123.

DIY retrofit: some owners have added their own lighting to this pocket, sourcing power from the existing door-control-button illumination circuit. No detailed step-by-step was shared (one owner who did this had no photos to share), but it confirms the pocket is wireable via the door-button illumination feed rather than needing an entirely new power run 4.

FAW-logo light insert available on AliExpress: a dedicated FAW logo illumination insert is sold on AliExpress specifically to fill this transparent placeholder window in the lower front-door trim. Community members report already having installed it in the group, but the exact mounting/wiring specifics for this particular product weren't detailed in this batch of messages (low confidence pending a step-by-step) 56.

docs.title: Door trim panel removal
docs.text:
Tags: #door-panel

To access the window regulator, glass seals ("бархатка"), and door-latch wiring, remove the door trim panel:

  1. Pry off the clips securing the trim panel to the door frame.
  2. Unclip the plastic divider/window-regulator shroud that sits alongside the window glass — this piece comes off together with the glass ("снимается вместе со стеклом").
  3. Use plastic trim tools or a flathead screwdriver to avoid damaging the clips.

Exterior chrome molding. The exterior chrome molding ("уличный молдинг") is held on with double-sided tape plus clips at the bottom. Cut the tape carefully with a utility knife while prying from the inside, to preserve the clips for reinstallation.12345678

docs.title: Eco-leather (dermantin) seat care
docs.text:
Material identification: X80 seats are eco-leather (a synthetic material, "дерматин"/dermantin), not genuine leather. This matters for choosing the correct care products — genuine-leather cleaners and conditioners are not necessarily formulated for synthetic eco-leather.

Correct care routine: maintenance requires an eco-leather-specific cleaner, followed by an eco-leather-specific conditioner, to prevent cracking over time. Whether regular (genuine) leather care products are effective on eco-leather is uncertain — community members have not confirmed cross-compatibility, so sticking to eco-leather-labeled products is the safer choice 1234.

docs.title: Floor mat attachment and securement methods
docs.text:
Tags: #clips · #price

Prices and suppliers on this page are Russian-market (RUB, at the dates shown). Verify locally before relying on them in Syria.

Some advice here concerns sub-zero winters and is less relevant in a hot climate.

Stock X80 floor mats come with adhesive tape strips and side clips. For enhanced securement, owners report: applying larger adhesive tape pieces and sewing the mats to the carpet/base along the edges with heavy-duty thread. The stock plastic clips need regular replacement — some owners report replacing them on a roughly monthly basis. Alternative: use two-sided automotive tape for full-perimeter adhesion instead of relying on the clips 1234567.

Mat material by season — EVA vs. rubber: two main floor-mat types suit different seasons. EVA mats excel in winter — water-resistant, resist moisture, easy to shake out and dry. Rubber mats work better in summer — easy to wipe clean with a damp cloth, dry quickly. Combination approach used by some owners: factory rubber mats in summer, switched to EVA in winter. BigFoot brand (autokovrik-bigfoot.ru) is recommended for quality. Note: OEM factory mats deteriorate over time as their glue/backing fails 891011121314151617.

EVO EVA floor mats — custom-cut option and pricing (May 2024): EVO EVA floor mats made specifically for the FAW X80 are available on Wildberries. Custom-fitted mats can also be ordered at local car accessory shops — professional shops cut and edge-seal EVO material to the exact floor contours, with a 2–3 hour turnaround, including anti-slip backing. Cost with professional installation: approximately 2,500 RUB (RU market, May 2024); pre-made standard mats are also sold directly on Ozon and Wildberries without custom cutting 18192021222324.

Ozon floor mats — good price/quality report: separately, another Ozon listing for FAW Besturn X80 floor mats (sourced from China) was recommended by an owner for good price and quality, with a choice of colors available at checkout: https://ozon.ru/t/gaxnwfC 2526.

EVA trunk mat. A black EVA trunk mat (коврик) for the FAW Besturn X80 (2013 onward) was listed by the Prime-avto shop in October 2025; no price was given.27

docs.title: Glovebox microlifter replacement
docs.text:
The glovebox microlifter/damper strut (опора/микролифт — the small mechanism that stops the glovebox door from dropping open too fast, see also the cabin air filter replacement card for related glovebox-damper caution) is simple to replace: (1) remove the glovebox; (2) unscrew the 6 self-tapping screws securing the old strut; (3) install the new strut in the same 6 positions. The whole procedure takes approximately 2 minutes, and no special tools are required 12.

No factory interior lighting in the glovebox: the large glove compartment does not include factory lighting in base/standard-trim FAW X80 configurations. This appears to be an intentional design choice rather than an equipment variation between trim levels. Separately, the spring mechanism that holds the lid closed can wear over time and fail to hold it shut 3456.

docs.title: Instrument panel rattle — drainage channel
docs.text:
Tags: #rattle · #dashboard · #diagnostic

Symptom: a vibrating/rattling sound coming from behind the instrument panel (щиток приборов), most noticeable over small bumps — enough vibration to trigger it — and also audible at idle while stationary. Removing the instrument panel itself found only a single air duct behind it, with nothing visually obvious that could be rattling 1.

Possible unrelated cause raised, then dismissed as off-topic: one suggestion was that an aftermarket (non-OEM) car alarm installation could have disturbed or left something unsecured in that area — offered as a general troubleshooting angle rather than a confirmed diagnosis for this specific case 2.

Likely cause — the windshield drainage channel/pocket behind the dashboard: the more targeted lead came from an owner who had previously disassembled the plastic trim behind the windshield and found a large pocket/channel there for draining water — this cavity is large enough that loose debris or the panel itself moving inside it can produce a rattle that transmits into the dashboard area, described as potentially maddening ("может тебе оттуда все мозги вынести"). Fix approach: locate and inspect this drainage channel behind the windshield trim, check that debris hasn't collected inside it, and ensure the trim/channel itself is properly seated and not loose 3.

Outcome: the owner reported he would try this lead, but no follow-up confirmation of a successful fix was recorded in this thread — treat the drainage-channel diagnosis as a strong, community-recommended starting point rather than a confirmed fix 4.

docs.title: Interior alcantara (suede) cladding installation
docs.text:
Installation. One owner successfully covered the entire interior — dashboard, headliner, and door panels — with alcantara fabric, using contact adhesive (not self-adhesive tape). The full job takes an extended amount of time to complete properly.123456789

Reported benefits. Notable noise reduction, a more premium appearance, and improved tactile quality throughout the cabin.123456789

Maintenance. Light cleaning 2–4 times per year (dusting, spot-cleaning around foot-traffic areas) is sufficient. No high-pressure washing — this can damage the alcantara or its adhesive bond.123456789

docs.title: Component locations — interior-comfort
docs.text:
Tags: #dashboard · #trunk · #part-number · #reference

Cigarette lighter / power socket — removal: the cigarette lighter (power socket) on the FAW Besturn X80 cannot be removed on its own — there's no quick-release or simple pull-out method. Removal requires disassembling the dashboard around the socket to access it from behind, since it's not designed as a user-serviceable standalone component 12.

Trunk cargo-net mounting fasteners: six special fasteners with rings (M-sized bolts with washers) mount the cargo-net attachment plates on the interior sides of the trunk. They are accessible from outside on the trunk edges. Some owners replace the OEM fasteners with stainless-steel upgrades for durability/appearance. Total part count: 6 pieces 34567891011121314.

Sun visor — driving comfort tip: keeping the sun visor lowered continuously — day and night, in all weather — reportedly improves driver comfort: it reduces glare from streetlights and traffic lights at night, reduces eye strain from direct sunlight during the day, and improves perceived visibility from a darkened cabin interior (avoiding a "fish tank" effect where the driver feels overly visible/exposed) 151617.

docs.title: Interior door handle cap and ear repair
docs.text:
Tags: #aliexpress · #conflict

Community members disagree on this topic — both positions are reported.

A replacement interior door-handle cap/plug (заглушка, sold on AliExpress) can be installed without disassembling the whole door. Installation notes: (1) the cap must be glued, not clipped — it does not snap into place on its own; (2) glue with Cosmofen adhesive mixed with a small amount of baking soda for a strong hold; (3) apply the adhesive with an insulin syringe for precision — this avoids getting glue on the paint, which hardens almost instantly on contact with air/ paint; (4) the cap needs minor filing on its interior-facing surfaces to fit properly; (5) the interior door handle must be unscrewed/ removed first to access the mounting area; (6) apply the glue to seat the cap, then run the syringe tip around the perimeter on top as a second pass for reinforcement. A Drive2 (дром) article on the X80 was consulted as an alternate reference, but it did not cover the adhesive step — the community verified the Cosmofen+soda method independently 1234567891011121314151617.

⚠️ Conflict / caveat: some users report the handle/cap detaching again 2–3 years after installation, even when glued. The reporting author still recommends the Cosmofen+soda adhesive method over any purely mechanical (clip-only) retention approach, since it has proven to be the community's most reliable fix despite the eventual-failure reports 1310111617.

Related repair — broken handle "ear" (ushko), epoxy method: a broken plastic mounting ear ("ушко") on a door handle — the small tab that anchors the handle at its attachment point — can be repaired with the same family of adhesive rather than replaced outright: (1) file the broken edge smooth; (2) apply Cosmofen epoxy adhesive (cyanoacrylate + baking-soda mix, same recipe as above) to the broken area; (3) reshape the ear while the adhesive is workable; (4) apply glue around the perimeter for reinforcement; (5) install. One owner confirmed the repaired handle held securely in testing after curing. This method is suitable for plastic handle breakage specifically at the attachment/ear point, as a cheaper alternative to sourcing a replacement handle 1819.

docs.title: Interior noises and squeaks
docs.text:
Tags: #noise

Common noise complaints (2024-05 report). X80 owners report a cluster of minor interior/mechanical noises that recur across the community: clicking/popping sounds when starting from a stop, coil spring squeaks, transmission jerking on takeoff from neutral, dashboard panel squeaks, and door panel noises. One owner at 88,000 km reported these symptoms without having replaced any major components (aside from a mid-exhaust pipe repair).

Community assessment. These noises are treated as common minor issues rather than signs of a reliability or safety problem. Regular use of the vehicle and occasional tightening of interior fasteners/trim clips helps manage and reduce the noise over time — this is consistent with the broader community principle (documented on the dedicated "importance of regular driving" card) that inactivity itself contributes to squeaks and rattles.123

Plastic knock inside the dashboard (cause not found). One owner reports a knocking sound from inside the dashboard, like a small flap-type plastic part that moves and knocks. The car was out of warranty, so the dealer had to take the panel apart to look for the source; no cause or fix was reported. Possible leads: Instrument panel rattle — drainage channel and Common rattle and vibration sources.4

docs.title: Interior sound insulation — installation guide
docs.text:
Tags: #installation · #price

Prices and suppliers on this page are Russian-market (RUB, at the dates shown). Verify locally before relying on them in Syria.

A multi-layer soundproofing system reported for the X80: (1) first layer — 4 mm vibration-damping material (SGM Альфа 4) for floor, hood, roof, doors; (2) second layer — 6 mm impact-resistant foam (SGM Silshot) for floor and trunk; (3) third layer — 2 mm thin damping (SGM Альфа 2) for doors; (4) fourth layer — 4 mm sound- absorption foam (SGM Silton) for door interiors; (5) wave foam (DreamCar 25) for door cards and around speakers; (6) anti-squeak tape at contact points and clips. Door-frame arcs and sides use a thicker Альфа 3. Around speaker cones, apply foam laminates for improved midrange response. Typical DIY material cost is reported as much lower than a 35,000–40,000 RUB (RU market, August 2024) dealer quote for the same job 123456789.

docs.title: Interior trim panels — clip-only attachment
docs.text:
Tags: #trim · #diy

A-pillar and dashboard trim panels on the X80 are attached with plastic clips only — no fasteners 12. This design allows easy removal for maintenance but requires careful handling to avoid breaking the clips 3. Some owners are concerned about panels rattling loose while driving, but the clips are designed to hold trim securely under normal conditions 4. Dashboard trim removal is a common DIY step for installing an aftermarket head unit or doing other cabin work 5.

docs.title: Interior trim removal — tools and technique
docs.text:
Tags: #tools

Prices and suppliers on this page are Russian-market (RUB, at the dates shown). Verify locally before relying on them in Syria.

Cheap plastic trim-removal tool sets (~200 RUB, RU market, September 2024) from Wildberries or Ozon work well for interior panel removal; plastic doesn't scratch trim the way metal tools do 12. These tools wear out quickly — several owners buy 10+ at a time and treat them as consumables rather than trying to make a few last 34. Tool design matters: a bent-lever shape allows proper clip engagement without damaging components, so cheaper sets with a good lever profile can outperform pricier straight ones 567. For the specific procedure of removing the dashboard panel around the factory radio, see the head-unit installation card.

A-pillar trim panel removal: the A-pillar/dashboard trim panels attach via plastic clips only — they are not bolted down. Removal: pull gently and steadily from the bottom/passenger side toward yourself; a clip-release tool (plastic pry set, available on Ozon) makes this easier if the panel resists. An easier entry point for initial leverage is via the wheel-well opening. Avoid aggressive/sudden prying, which risks breaking the clips 891011121314. Caution: specialized rigid metal-hook clip-removal tools sold for this purpose can be risky if you're not sure what type of clip is underneath — one owner warned that using such a tool on door trim (where the clip arrangement differs) can go badly if you don't already know the clips are the type that tool is meant for 1516.

Ceiling clip removal: ceiling clips (потолочные грибки) are simple mushroom-style plugs that insert into anchors set in the headliner. To remove: simply pull straight out; the anchor (дюбель) itself remains in place in the headliner 1718.

Gray trim panel removal — bolted (not just clipped) example: a gray interior trim panel (door area) is removed by unscrewing 2 bolts located on the bottom of the panel, then pulling toward you — a straightforward procedure once the bolt access points are located. Note: unlike the A-pillar and ceiling clips above (clip-only, no bolts), this particular gray trim panel does use bolts in addition to clips, so check both fastener types when working with unfamiliar trim panels 1920.

docs.title: Rear cabin dome light — removal technique
docs.text:
Tags: #led

To remove/access the rear cabin dome light (плафон): pry the lens with a small flat screwdriver from the rear side of the fixture. The fixture has small protrusions that indicate exactly where to apply leverage — insert the screwdriver at these marked spots to pop off the lens cover. A shared YouTube tutorial covers C5W LED bulb replacement for both interior and trunk-compartment dome lights using this same technique 12.

docs.title: Rear seat removal — procedure and fuel pump access
docs.text:
Tags: #fuel-pump · #removal

Prices and suppliers on this page are Russian-market (RUB, at the dates shown). Verify locally before relying on them in Syria.

Rear seat removal procedure: rear seat cushions and backrests remove easily without removing the front seats. The rear seat bottom simply lifts up; backrests can be folded down and secured with rope ties. Complete rear seat removal takes approximately 30 minutes. Rear seatbelt hardware is warranty-covered; a failed seatbelt can alternatively be sourced from salvage yards at much lower cost than the dealer warranty process (example: 800 RUB (RU market, April 2024) vs. a warranty claim process reported to take 2 years) 1234.

Fuel pump access via rear seat removal: to access the fuel pump, remove the rear bench seat by unbolting two fasteners — one per side, near the passenger's feet, at the seat-to-floor junction. Lifting the seat exposes the fuel pump area directly, without needing to remove any other interior trim 567.

Rear seat removal — bolt-under-cap procedure (reinforcing report): consistent with the fastener-based removal noted above, a separate report confirms: rear seats are secured with bolts located under plastic caps at the passenger foot area (behind the footwells) — described as two bolts on each side, a slightly higher count than the "one per side" noted in the fuel-pump-access report above (possibly reflecting a trim/generation difference, or an imprecise earlier count). Removal requires simple bolt extraction and is documented as a quick disassembly 8.

docs.title: Roof drain blockages and interior water leaks
docs.text:
Tags: #water-ingress · #sunroof · #price

Prices and suppliers on this page are Russian-market (RUB, at the dates shown). Verify locally before relying on them in Syria.

Reference guides shared by the community. Two Drive2 articles are repeatedly referenced for roof/sunroof drain problems: (1) a general roof drain inspection and maintenance guide — https://www.drive2.ru/l/534663643480982384/ — covering preventive inspection and cleaning of the roof drainage system to prevent interior water accumulation; (2) a second post specifically about water appearing under the passenger-side carpet — https://www.drive2.ru/l/684423724253850875/ — discussing drainage paths and fixes for that particular symptom.123456

Known design issue on pre-facelift ("dorest") cars. Pre-facelift X80s reportedly have an issue with the corner fittings of the sunroof drain tubes being plastic (rather than a more durable material) — this is flagged by the community as a specific weak point worth inspecting proactively, since the same failure pattern recurs across multiple owner reports.3456

Roof drain cleaning service cost — significant regional spread (2026-04, Saint Petersburg). Reported quotes for roof/sunroof drain cleaning in Saint Petersburg ranged from 6,500 to 19,000 RUB, with 19,000 RUB being the more commonly quoted price and 6,500 RUB flagged by the group as notably (suspiciously) cheap for that city. Recommendation: get quotes from multiple local services, or attempt a DIY approach with a drain-clearing brush tool, before committing to an expensive service.7891011

Full water-leak repair case — Saint Petersburg, 2Dservice (2026-04/05). One owner had a persistent water leak (water pooling under the interior carpet) diagnosed and fixed at 2Dservice, Vyborgskoye shosse, building 212V, Pargolovo settlement, Saint Petersburg (contact: +7 (981) 336-00-75; https://yandex.ru/navi/org/2dservice/197109635479). The job — drain clearing, removal of interior plastic panels, and sealant application — took 4 hours and cost 5,000 RUB (RU market, April 2026); the technician noted the source of the leak was difficult to locate initially, consistent with the "hidden drain path" nature of this fault class. A second community member commented that a competent DIYer could likely do the same job themselves in about an hour with the right approach.12131415

Second corroborating cost report — same shop, same price (2026-07, Saint Petersburg). A separate report of the identical repair — a water leak under the interior carpets — describes the same fix (removing interior trim/plastic, cleaning the drain, applying sealant) performed by the same shop, "2d service," in Saint Petersburg, for 5,000 RUB (~USD 50) (RU market, July 2026). This matches the earlier April/May 2026 case's price exactly, reinforcing 5,000 RUB (RU market, July 2026) as the going rate at this shop for this specific repair.16

Water pooled under the carpet — check the cowl drains first. One member dried out a car with water standing under the carpet. Another noted that on the pre-restyle X80 water finds its way in through all the body seams, sometimes even through the engine bulkhead, and advised checking the drains under the cowl (жабо, the plastic panel below the windshield) first. See also Water leaks — fender and cabin ingress.1718

docs.title: Electric seat — mechanical backup lever
docs.text:
Tags: #low-confidence

X80 models with electric seat adjustment have a mechanical backup adjustment built in. A long lever/tube mechanism under the seat can be pulled upward to move the seat forward when the electric system reaches its travel limit. To use: locate the mechanical lever under the front of the seat, pull it upward to unlock the seat and allow manual forward/backward movement. The electric seat motor has forward/backward travel limits; if these are insufficient for a driver's preferred position, the mechanical lever may allow slight additional adjustment — results vary by seat model 1.

docs.title: Seat covers — fitment and pricing
docs.text:
Tags: #restyle · #price

Prices and suppliers on this page are Russian-market (RUB, at the dates shown). Verify locally before relying on them in Syria.

Some advice here concerns sub-zero winters and is less relevant in a hot climate.

Generation differences: front seats are identical between restyle and pre-restyle models. Rear seats differ: pre-restyle has a split seatback (2 pieces) with a solid cushion; restyle has a solid seatback with a split cushion (2 pieces). This affects seat-cover fitment — custom covers must account for the difference 1234.

Pricing (September 2024): universal seat covers cost 7,000–9,000 RUB (RU market, September 2024); custom-fitted covers cost 13,000–15,000 RUB (RU market, September 2024) but require about a 1-month lead time. Most suppliers operate on a pre-order basis; Crimean suppliers may have some stock available. "Autopilot" was mentioned as one supplier brand 5678910.

Attachment clips are fragile: the decorative plastic clips holding rear seat-cushion covers in place are fragile with poor retention. Installing custom seat covers or cushions over the factory seats often breaks or loses these clips, requiring repeated re-seating during and after installation. Consider aftermarket locking clips or an adhesive alternative if failures keep recurring 111213.

Fur covers for climate extremes: leather-interior seats swing between painfully cold (-40°C winters) and burning hot (+40°C summers). Fur seat covers, reused from a previous vehicle for 5+ years by one owner, provide a thermal-insulation/comfort bridge between bare leather and extreme ambient temperatures — strongly recommended by owners with leather interiors 141516.

Synthetic-leather seat condensation in summer heat: the X80's synthetic leather ("кожзам") seat coverings trap moisture/sweat in hot weather, leaving the seating surface wet and clammy — the X80 has no ventilated-seat option to counter this. Community workaround: use summer seat covers/overlays on the front seats; one owner has used such covers consistently for several years as a long-term solution rather than a one-off fix 1718. An Ozon summer seat cover is also recommended for pseudo-leather seats, where the body sticks to the seat; the poster says it lifts the body off the seat 19.

Autopilot-brand covers (2019–2022 models): Autopilot-brand seat covers are made specifically for the FAW Besturn X80, model years 2019–2022, sold via shop-avtopilot.ru (a pre-facelift/"dorest" version is also listed). Owners using proper ventilated covers of this type report no sweating or mildew, even with heavy daily commuting and occasional long summer trips. Options include alcantara (suede-look) center panels with eco-leather edges — alcantara sits where the back/seat actually contacts the material, which is reported to breathe better than full eco-leather, though a simple seasonal summer overlay is a cheaper/simpler option for cloth-interior cars. Installation is straightforward, no special tools needed 202122.

Summer cooling seat covers/cushions: several fabric-based solutions reported for summer heat: (1) a cooling pad from Yandex Market, tested for 1 year by one owner, machine washable, keeps the back/seat area dry; (2) universal Ozon seat covers in breathable, durable fabric — no sweating in summer and not cold in winter, with 20mm foam padding under the seat bolsters improving fit; (3) a ventilated seat cushion with USB-powered fans — prevents sweat pooling on the seat but back perspiration still occurs, and the fans must be manually switched on each time after the car powers up (no auto-start). Wood-bead seat covers are not effective in this climate. Brute-force cooling still comes only from the A/C 2324252627282930313233343536373839.

Seat cover material selection for durability/comfort: durability depends heavily on material and how much the driver sweats. Avoid velour, micro-suede, and alcantara — these crack quickly under perspiration (as little as ~1 year of life with heavy sweating). Better options: mesh/network weave, jacquard, or quality eco-leather with perforation. Running the A/C in summer to reduce sweating slows degradation regardless of material. Premium covers (16,000+ RUB, RU market, June 2025) with reinforced clips hold up better than cheap covers (8,000 RUB), even under heavy sweating 4041424344454647.

Avtopilot eco-leather covers (diamond-quilted, perforated): eco-leather seat covers with a diamond-quilting pattern from the Avtopilot brand cost 16,000 RUB (RU market, June 2025). Perforated for heat management; durable 1+ year with no wear when installed with quality clips. In practice the perforation is less effective than expected for heat dissipation — heating (seat-heater) function is also noticeably weakened through the perforated material. The material does not crack under normal (non-soaking) sweating 4849504151435253.

Anti-sweat seat pads (grey): separate anti-sweat seat pads are available; one owner chose grey specifically to minimize solar heating. Features non-slip backing and mounting straps. Effectiveness: roughly 30% improvement in back/seat heat retention — useful but not a complete solution, and most effective in cooler seasons (winter) rather than summer heat 5455.

Budget AliExpress seat covers: seat covers available on AliExpress from 450–500 RUB (RU market, April 2024), multiple sellers offering variations — used mainly for interior protection/customization rather than climate comfort 5657585960.

Seat cushions and cooling pads (Yandex Marketplace): commercial seat cushions and covers are also available on Yandex Marketplace and similar platforms. One owner reports using summer cooling cushions year-round for comfort, not just in hot weather; these are easy to install and remove without a permanent fitted cover 6162636465.

Pre-restyle leather seat-cover upgrade with custom padding (Krasnodar shop): one owner installed aftermarket leather seat covers on a 2017 (pre-restyle) X80. Supplier: sevcovers (found via a VK community group), cost 14,000 RUB (RU market, March 2026). Installation was done at a Krasnodar upholstery shop and included custom sewing with thick padding and reinforced lumbar support — the result was professional-grade upholstery, red fabric with black trim 666768.

Sevcovers VK supplier (Simferopol-Yalta) — pricing and ordering process: custom seat covers are available from sevcovers.vk.ru (a VK group based in the Simferopol-Yalta region, Crimea). Price: ~11,000–14,000 RUB (RU market, April 2026) depending on material (alcantara diamond-stitch is more expensive). Orders must specify model year and trim (pre-facelift vs. facelift) — see the fitment-difference note below for why this matters. Delivery: 25 days standard per the manufacturer, though it can be faster (~10 days) if the production line is ready. Installation can be done DIY or by local upholsterers; some owners take the covers to a shop for final stitching/adjustment 697071727374.

Pre-facelift vs. facelift seat-cover fitment — side-bolster difference: seat profile differs between pre-facelift ("dorest") and facelift ("rest") models. Pre-facelift seats are flat; facelift seats — especially in luxury trim — have additional side bolsters. Covers must be ordered specifying the exact year/model to fit properly, since side bolsters can interfere with full-coverage covers designed for the flat pre-facelift profile. Some owners report fitting covers onto leather seats is possible but difficult. A professional upholsterer for final adjustments is recommended when doing a DIY installation 7576777879.

Cover-material comparison — leather vs. fabric vs. Alcantara, plus steering-wheel braid: seat-cover material options and their tradeoffs: leather (synthetic) can stick to skin in hot weather; fabric ("тряпка") is the most comfortable but wears faster; Alcantara performs well in summer heat and doesn't stick to skin. Separately, the steering wheel can be upgraded with a durable fiber-braid cover (340 RUB (RU market, April 2026) on AliExpress with a 54% discount, ~2 hours of labor to sew on). Seat-cover installation labor runs ~3,000 RUB (RU market, April 2026) at shops but is feasible as a DIY job with patience 808182838485868788.

Custom-molded covers from regional manufacturers (2024): custom-molded seat covers for the FAW X80 are available from manufacturers in several Russian cities — Krasnodar, Yalta, and Moscow. Prices range 9,000–16,000 RUB (RU market, June 2024) depending on manufacturer and material quality, with a typical lead time of 2–3 weeks for custom manufacturing. Pre-made/off-the-shelf covers from local markets are reported as a poor quality alternative — professional-grade custom options give a much better appearance and durability 8990919293949596979899100101.

Seat cover upgrade experience — seam failure on driver seat: one owner replaced the factory leather seats with custom leather seat covers after a seam failure on the driver's seat. Reasons for the upgrade: improved durability, better summer comfort (bare leather can get too hot, covers add cushioning), and customization options. Seat covers are noted as a functional alternative to factory leather for extending seat life without a full reupholstery job 102103104.

docs.title: Shift knob and center console
docs.text:
Tags: #manual-transmission · #automatic-transmission · #price

Prices and suppliers on this page are Russian-market (RUB, at the dates shown). Verify locally before relying on them in Syria.

Manual transmission (МКПП) shift-knob removal: the gear-shift knob on manual-transmission X80s is fixed and cannot be easily hand-unscrewed — it rotates freely in place but does not thread off. Removal requires tools; one owner's attempt to DIY-remove it without proper tools was unsuccessful, and the installation method for the replacement was not documented in detail (low-confidence, incomplete report) 123.

Center console removal and shifter access: to access or remove components in the center console area, remove the shifter knob first — it rotates off the shift lever. The top piece of the center console then slides out upward once its retaining clips are released. The flat panel with the cupholder is fully removable 456.

Shifter knob leather/vinyl coating wear and restoration: the leather/vinyl coating on the shift knob wears through at the top surface and corners over time. Full removal procedure: (1) peel off the damaged coating; (2) clean the residual adhesive with solvent and a cloth, working carefully so as not to remove the underlying paint/finish. Once bare, the plastic underneath is black, matte, and smooth — cosmetically acceptable on its own. Alternative: remove the old coating and re-wrap the knob with new leather/vinyl material. If you choose not to re-wrap, the bare plastic finish is a reasonable permanent option and avoids future peeling 7891011121314151617.

Cover peeling on the shift knob (reports and causes): on one FAW the gear-knob cover (наболдашник) was almost fully peeled at about 20,000 km 18. Victor's knob at 70,000 km peeled only slightly, and he attributes it to contact with aggressive substances such as oily hands 19. No Comments reports no sign of peeling at 220,000 km 20, while Андрей Б. says the hand wears the cover like sandpaper 21. Wear is therefore inconsistent between cars (low confidence); see the removal and re-wrap options above.

Automatic transmission (AKPP) gear-shift handle — replacement, shaft diameter, aftermarket options: the AKPP shift handle is secured with bolts, not simply threaded onto the lever 222324. The synthetic-leather/dermantin covering can be removed and rewrapped 22. Shaft diameter is ~12mm 2526; some third-party handles (e.g. Mitsubishi Outlander/ASX alternatives) have different hole sizes and need modification (tapping/drilling) to fit properly 2527282629. Replacement handles are sold on Wildberries/OZON with various materials and designs 303132. Separately, cross-brand compatible aftermarket AT gear-selector knobs (fits Suzuki Grand Vitara/SX4/Swift, Mazda, and Mitsubishi models) are available thread-mounted, no tools needed, on OZON/AliExpress: premium version ~1,600+ RUB (RU market, January 2026), budget version ~450 RUB (RU market, January 2026) (metal + faux-leather construction) 333435363738.

Manual transmission (МКПП) gear-lever boot (chekhol/dermantin) tearing — DIY fix: the leather/dermantin covering on the МКПП gear-lever boot wears and tears with use, the same failure mode as the shift-knob coating above. DIY fix: carefully remove the worn covering, clean off old adhesive residue, and leave the surface bare (looks acceptable, clean finish) — a 5-minute repair, no special tools. Alternative: a universal 10mm-diameter rubber boot is sold as a replacement 3940414243.

Professional leather-wrap labor pricing (January 2026): a shop-installed leather/faux-leather (kozzam) wrap for the shift knob costs 1,500 RUB (RU market, January 2026) labor — the same shop that does steering-wheel wraps, see the steering wheel cover card for the matching steering-wheel price 444546474849.

MKPP shift-knob rewrap — DIY paracord option: the OEM manual- transmission shift knob can become worn and slippery over time. Solutions: (1) a professional car upholsterer can completely rewrap it (see the professional leather-wrap pricing above); (2) DIY wrapping with paracord or similar material is possible without removing the knob; one user successfully wrapped their own knob this way. Multiple users report this as a common maintenance task 50515253.

USB port recovery from the center console: if the USB port falls into the center console, the same shift-knob-first disassembly above gives access to retrieve it: (1) remove the gear-shift knob by unscrewing it; (2) carefully pry the console edge up — a wire for the handle button is attached, so don't yank it; (3) disconnect the handbrake-button connector; (4) access the port from underneath to reinstall it 545556.

docs.title: Sound insulation (шумка) — mold risk
docs.text:
Tags: #trunk

Sound-damping material ("шумка") installed in the trunk or floor can trap moisture and cause fungal/mold growth if: (1) drainage holes are blocked; (2) the ventilation/return-air valve is sealed over; or (3) the material itself allows condensation to form and stay trapped. Symptoms: a mold smell, visible fungus under or around the damping material. Solution: remove the damaged шумка, dry the interior thoroughly, and reinstall with proper drainage maintained (don't seal over drain holes or ventilation valves when installing) 12345.

docs.title: Steering wheel heater — aftermarket installation
docs.text:

Prices and suppliers on this page are Russian-market (RUB, at the dates shown). Verify locally before relying on them in Syria.

An aftermarket steering wheel heating kit (available on the Ozon marketplace) can be integrated as follows: (1) locate the steering wheel connector — on the test vehicle it had 2 unused free pins; (2) solder the heating element wires to those pins; (3) mount the heating pad under the steering wheel rim; (4) rewrap the steering wheel with leather over the pad. Installation requires basic soldering and leather-upholstery skills 123456.

Alternative approach — pre-made heated steering-wheel wrap kit: rather than soldering a heating pad in as above, a complete pre-made heated steering-wheel wrap kit (sourced from AliExpress) is another viable option — it comes with its own heating element built into a wrap-style cover, along with an installation guide shared via Google Drive.
